entries.name: approximateSpline
entries.description: Compute a family of splines that approximates a family of ApproximationTargets to within a given tolerance. The resulting splines are consistently parameterized, so that, for example, lofting between them will match corresponding target positions. Note: If parameters are not specified, the magnitude of start and end derivatives in targets is ignored as well as the second component parallel with the first derivative.

parameters.name: degree
parameters.description: The desired degree of the curve. The output may have a different degree, if for example there aren't enough points.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: How far the output is allowed to deviate from the input. Must be at least 1e-8 meters.

parameters.name: isPeriodic
parameters.description: Whether the output spline is periodic.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: An array of ApproximationTargets. All targets must have the same number of positions and specify corresponding derivative information.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of numbers representing the parameters corresponding to the target points. Must be strictly increasing. If specified, the output spline at those parameters will match the target points. If specified, derivatives in approximation targets will not be rescaled.

parameters.name: maxControlPoints
parameters.description: OptionalThe maximum number of control points that will be returned by this function's output. Tolerance will not be satisfied if this limit is reached. Default is 10000.

parameters.name: interpolateIndices
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of indices into target positions that specifies which ones are to be interpolated exactly. This is currently supported only for non-periodic splines.

parameters.name: suppressInterpolationNotice
parameters.description: OptionalDon't report an info if the result is fully interpolated. Default is false.

parameters.name: array
parameters.type: An array of BSplineCurves, one for each target.

entries.name: APPROXIMATION_SAMPLES
entries.description: Number of sample taken on the curve to perform the approximation.

entries.name: bSplineSurface
entries.description: Returns a new BSplineSurface, adding knot padding and control point overlap as necessary.

parameters.name: uDegree
parameters.description: The degree of the spline in u.

parameters.name: vDegree
parameters.description: The degree of the spline in v.

parameters.name: isUPeriodic
parameters.description: Whether the spline periodic in u.

parameters.name: isVPeriodic
parameters.description: Whether the spline periodic in v.

parameters.name: controlPoints
parameters.description:
A matrix of control points. See BSplineSurface for specific detail. If u or v is periodic, you may provide the necessary overlap, or provide control points without any overlap. If no overlap is provided, degree overlapping control point rows or columns (corresponding to the first degree control point rows or columns) will be added. (unless you provide a set of knots that show no overlap is necessary). 
EXAMPLE
controlPointMatrix([
    [vector(-1, -1, -1) * inch, vector(-1, 0, 0) * inch, vector(-1, -2, 1) * inch],
    [vector( 0,  1, -1) * inch, vector( 0, 2, 0) * inch, vector( 0,  0, 1) * inch],
    [vector( 1, -1, -1) * inch, vector( 1, 0, 0) * inch, vector( 1, -2, 1) * inch]
])

parameters.name: weights
parameters.description: OptionalA matrix of weights. See BSplineSurface for specific detail.

parameters.name: uKnots
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of knots. See BSplineSurface for specific detail. If knots are not provided a uniform parameterization will be created such that the u parameterization exists on the range [0, 1]. For non-periodic u with n control point rows, you may provide the full set of n + degree + 1 knots, or you may provide n - degree + 1 knots, and multiplicity will by padded onto the ends (which has the effect of clamping the surface to the control points in the first and last rows). For periodic u with n unique control points (and optionally an additional degree overlapping control points), you may provide the full set of n + 2 * degree + 1 knots, or you may provide n + 1 knots, and the periodic knots will be padded onto the ends.

The top edge of the image is along the positive Z direction of the coordinate system projected on the cylinder.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: The minimal or maximal distance.

parameters.name: sides
parameters.description:
An array of 2 maps, containing information about where the extremum was found for each side. Each map has a:
point (Vector) : The position in world space that is closest or farthest to the other side. The distance field is measured between the two values of point.
index (integer) : the index into the line or point array or into the query results, if a query is passed in.
parameter (number or length or array of two numbers) : If the index refers to an edge, the parameter is a number between 0 and 1 (unless extend for that side was passed in). It is in the form that evEdgeTangentLine and evEdgeCurvature consume (with arcLengthParameterization set to the same value that was passed into evDistance).
If the index refers to a point, the parameter is 0.
If the index refers to a Line, the parameter is a length representing the distance along the direction.
If the index refers to a face, the parameter is a 2D Vector in the form that evFaceTangentPlane consumes. If this face is a mesh or a plane, the parameter is a 2D Vector of zeroes.
If the index refers to a Plane, the parameter is a 2D Vector representing the lengths along the plane's x and y axes.

entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)

parameters.name: neutralPlane
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is NEUTRAL_PLANE A planar face or mate connector defining both the neutral plane and pull direction of the the draft. The intersection of the drafted faces and the neutral plane remains unchanged. The pull direction of the draft will be the face normal or mate connector z-axis.

parameters.name: draftFaces
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is NEUTRAL_PLANE The faces to draft for a NEUTRAL_PLANE draft.

parameters.name: pullDirectionEntity
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is PARTING_LINE An entity defining the pull direction of the draft. This entity should conform to the ALLOWS_DIRECTION specification in QueryFilterCompound.

parameters.name: partingEdges
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is PARTING_LINE Edges defining the parting line of the draft. These edges will remain unchanged as some adjacent faces, as defined by partingLineSides, are drafted.

parameters.name: hintFaces
parameters.description: OptionalFor Onshape internal use. For PARTING_LINE draft, specifies in advance which adjacent faces of partingEdges should be treated as more along the pull direction. When unspecified, the feature will use a geometric calculation to determine this distinction.

parameters.name: partingLineSides
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is PARTING_LINE Specifies whether to draft one or both faces adjacent to the parting edges, and whether the draft should be symmetrical if drafting both faces. See PartingLineSides.

parameters.name: alongPull
parameters.description: Required if PartingLineSides is ONE_SIDED Specifies which face will be drafted in a ONE_SIDED PARTING_LINE draft. If true, the face which is more along the pull direction from the perspective of the parting edge is drafted. If false, the face which is more away from the pull direction from the perspective of the parting edge is drafted.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description:
The draft angle, must be between 0 and 89.9 degrees. 
EXAMPLE
3 * degree

parameters.name: pullDirection
parameters.description: OptionalWhether the pull direction of the draft should be reversed. In equivalent terms, whether the draft should use -angle as the draft angle (true), or angle as the draft angle (false). Default is false.

parameters.name: secondAngle
parameters.description:
Required if PartingLineSides is TWO_SIDED The second draft angle for a TWO_SIDED PARTING_LINE draft. Must be between 0 and 89.9 degrees. Note that when using TWO_SIDED, angle will be applied to faces that are away from the pull direction, from the perspective of the edge. secondAngle will be applied to faces that are along the pull direction, from the perspective of the edge. 
EXAMPLE
3 * degree

parameters.name: secondPullDirection
parameters.description: OptionalWhether the pull direction of the draft should be reversed for the second angle of a TWO_SIDED draft. In equivalent terms, whether the draft should use -secondAngle as the second draft angle (true), or secondAngle as the second draft angle (false). Default is false.

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: OptionalFor a NEUTRAL_PLANE draft, true to propagate draft across tangent faces. Default is false.

parameters.name: referenceEdgePropagation
parameters.description: OptionalFor a PARTING_LINE draft, true to extend the parting line across connected edges of already included faces and tangent faces. Default is false.

parameters.name: reFillet
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to attempt to defillet draft faces before the draft and reapply the fillets after. Default is false.

entries.name: evApproximateBSplineCurve
entries.description: Given a query for a curve, return its approximation (or exact representation if possible) as a B-spline. The options forceCubic and forceNonRational may be used to restrict the type of spline that is returned, but even if these options are false, a cubic non-rational spline may be returned.

parameters.name: edge
parameters.description: The curve to approximate.

parameters.name: forceNonRational
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, a non-rational spline will be returned. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: OptionalSpecifies the desired approximation tolerance: the maximum distance (in meters) between the original curve and the returned spline representation. Default is 1e-6, minimum is 1e-8, and maximum is 1e-2.

entries.name: evApproximateBSplineSurface
entries.description: Given a query for a face, return its approximation as a B-spline, including trim boundaries. The options forceCubic and forceNonRational may be used to restrict the type of spline that is returned for the surface, but even if these options are false, a cubic non-rational spline may be returned.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: The curve to approximate.

parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the returned surface will be a cubic spline. This does not affect the trim curves. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: forceNonRational
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the returned surface will be non-rational. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: OptionalSpecifies the desired approximation tolerance: the maximum distance (in meters) between the original face and the returned spline representation. Default is 1e-6, minimum is 1e-8, and maximum is 1e-4. The tolerance for trim curves is 10x the specified value.

parameters.description: Description

entries.description: Find the centroid of an entity or group of entities. This is equivalent to the center of mass for a constant density object. entries.name: evApproximateMassProperties
entries.description: Calculates approximate mass properties of an entity or group of entities. Returns mass, centroid, inertia tensor, and volume/area/length/count for bodies/faces/edges/vertices, respectively. Warning: These are approximate values and it is not recommended to use them for modeling purposes that will be negatively affected in case the approximation changes.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: The entities of which to compute mass properties. Only entities of the highest dimensionality will be considered.

parameters.name: density
parameters.description:
The density of the entities, with appropriate units. 
EXAMPLE
1 * kilogram / meter ^ 3 could be the density of 3D solid bodies EXAMPLE
1 * kilogram / meter ^ 2 could be the density of 2D faces or sheet bodies EXAMPLE
1 * kilogram / meter could be the density of 1D edges or wire bodies EXAMPLE
1 * kilogram could be the mass of each 0D vertex or point body

parameters.name: referenceFrame
parameters.description: OptionalOptional coordinate system. Defaults to the centroid with world axes for the inertia tensor, and world coordinates for the centroid.

entries.name: evArea
entries.description: Return the total area of all the entities. If no matching 2D faces are found the total area will be zero.

entries.name: evAxis
entries.description: If the query finds one entity with an axis -- a line, circle, cylinder, cone, sphere, torus, mate connector, or revolved surface -- return the axis. Otherwise throw an exception.

entries.name: evBox3d
entries.description: Find a bounding box around an entity, optionally with respect to a given coordinate system. There is also an option to use a faster but less accurate method.

parameters.name: topology
parameters.description: The entity to find the bounding box of.

parameters.name: cSys
parameters.description: OptionalThe coordinate system to use (if not the standard coordinate system).

parameters.name: tight
parameters.description:
OptionalGet the tightest possible bounding box. Defaults to true. 
EXAMPLE
true for a bounding box precisely at the extents of the given entities (and no bigger). EXAMPLE
false for a bounding box at least as big as the given entities, using a faster algorithm.

entries.name: evCollision
entries.description: Find collisions between tools and targets. Each collision is a map with field type of type ClashType and fields target, targetBody, tool, and toolBody of type Query.

entries.name: evCornerType
entries.description: Return the type of corner found at a vertex of a sheet metal model

parameters.name: Return
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: primaryVertex
parameters.description: the vertex that defines the corner

parameters.name: allVertices
parameters.description: array of transient queries for all definition vertices associated with the corner

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.BAD_GEOMETRY
parameters.type: The query does not evaluate to a single vertex

entries.name: evCurveDefinition
entries.description: Given a query for a curve, return a Circle, Ellipse, Line, or BSplineCurve value for the curve. If the curve is none of these types, return a map with unspecified contents.

parameters.name: edge
parameters.description: The curve to evaluate.

parameters.name: returnBSplinesAsOther
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, do not return B-spline curves (to avoid the associated time cost). Default is false.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.INVALID_INPUT
parameters.type: The first resolved entity was not an edge.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.CANNOT_RESOLVE_ENTITIES
parameters.type: Input entities are invalid or there are no input entities.

entries.name: evDistance
entries.description: Computes the minimum or maximum distance between geometry on side0 and geometry on side1. "Geometry" means entities, points, or lines. When the minimum or the maximum is not uniquely defined, ties will be broken arbitrarily.

parameters.name: side0
parameters.description:
One of the following: A query, or a point (3D Length Vector), or a Line, or a Plane, or an array of points, or an array of Lines, or an array of Planes. 
EXAMPLE
qNthElement(qEverything(EntityType.FACE), 0) or vector(1, 2, 3) * meter or line(vector(1, 0, 1) * meter, vector(1, 1, 1) or plane(vector(1,1,1) * meter, vector(0,0,1), vector(1,0,0)).

parameters.name: extendSide0
parameters.description: OptionalIf true and side0 is a query, bodies will be ignored and edges and faces extended to their possibly infinite underlying surfaces. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: side1
parameters.description: Like side0.

parameters.name: extendSide1
parameters.description: OptionalLike extendSide0.

parameters.name: maximum
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, compute the maximum instead of the minimum. Defaults to false. Not allowed to be true if a line is passed in in either side or if either extend is true.

entries.name: evEdgeConvexity
entries.description: Return the convexity type of the given edge, CONVEX, CONCAVE, SMOOTH, or VARIABLE. If the edge is part of a body with inside and outside convex and concave have the obvious meanings.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.TOO_MANY_ENTITIES_SELECTED
parameters.type: The query evaluates to more than one entity

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.BAD_GEOMETRY
parameters.type: The query does not evaluate to a single edge.

entries.name: evEdgeCurvature
entries.description: Return a Frenet frame along an edge, with curvature. If the curve has zero curvature at an evaluated point then the returned normal and binormal are arbitrary and only the tangent is significant.

parameters.name: edge
parameters.description:
The curve to use 
EXAMPLE
qNthElement(qEverything(EntityType.EDGE), 1)

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description: A number in the range 0..1 indicating the point along the curve to evaluate the frame at.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: OptionalIf present, the edge orientation used is such that walking along the edge with "up" being the face normal will keep face to the left. Must be adjacent to edge.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.NO_TANGENT_LINE
parameters.type: A frame could not be calculated for the specified input.

entries.name: evEdgeCurvatureDerivative
entries.description: Evaluate the derivative of the curvature vector with respect to arc length, that is, the third derivative of the curve with respect to arc length.

parameters.name: edge
parameters.description:
The curve to use 
EXAMPLE
qNthElement(qEverything(EntityType.EDGE), 1)

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description: A number in the range 0..1 indicating a point along the curve to evaluate the tangent at.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.NO_TANGENT_LINE
parameters.type: The curvature derivative could not be evaluated for the given query.

entries.name: evFaceCurvature
entries.description: Given a face, calculate and return principal curvatures at a point on that face, specified by its parameter-space coordinates.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description:
The face on which to evaluate the curvature. The face cannot be a mesh. 
EXAMPLE
qNthElement(qEverything(EntityType.FACE), 1)

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description:
a 2d unitless parameter-space vector specifying the location on the face. The coordinates are relative to the parameter-space bounding box of the face. 
EXAMPLE
vector(0.5, 0.5)

entries.name: evFaceCurvatureDerivative
entries.description: Given a face, calculate and return the derivative of the second fundamental form of the face in a given direction.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description:
The face on which to evaluate the curvature. The face cannot be a mesh. 
EXAMPLE
qNthElement(qEverything(EntityType.FACE), 1)

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description:
a 2d unitless parameter-space vector specifying the location on the face. The coordinates are relative to the parameter-space bounding box of the face. 
EXAMPLE
vector(0.5, 0.5)

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: a 3d unitless vector specifying a direction in the tangent plane of the face. It should be a unit vector perpendicular to the face's normal at the given point.

parameters.name: MatrixWithUnits
parameters.type: A 3x3 matrix with units of length ^ -2.

entries.name: evFaceCurvatures
entries.description: Given a face, calculate and return an array of principal curvatures at points on that face, specified by its parameter-space coordinates.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description:
A single face on which to evaluate the curvatures. The face cannot be a mesh. 
EXAMPLE
qNthElement(qEverything(EntityType.FACE), 1)

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description:
an array of 2d unitless parameter-space vectors specifying locations on the face. The coordinates are relative to the parameter-space bounding box of the face. 
EXAMPLE
[ vector(0.5, 0.5), vector(0, 1) ]

entries.name: evFaceNormalAtEdge
entries.description: Return the surface normal of a face at a position on one of its edges.

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description: A number in the range 0..1 indicating a point along the edge to evaluate the tangent at.

parameters.name: usingFaceOrientation
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the edge orientation used is such that walking along the edge with "up" being the face normal will keep face to the left. If false, use the default orientation of the edge, which is the same orientation used by evEdgeTangentLine. Default is false.

entries.name: evFacePeriodicity
entries.description: Return the periodicity in primary and secondary direction of a face, returned in an array of booleans.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: The face on which to evaluate periodicity

parameters.name: trimmed
parameters.description: OptionalIf true (default), return trimmed face periodicity instead of the underlying surface's.

entries.name: evFaceTangentPlane
entries.description: Given a face, calculate and return a Plane tangent to that face, where the plane's origin is at the point specified by its parameter-space coordinates.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description:
The face to evaluate. The face cannot be a mesh. 
EXAMPLE
qNthElement(qEverything(EntityType.FACE), 1)

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description:
2d unitless parameter-space vector specifying the location of tangency on the face. The coordinates are relative to the parameter-space bounding box of the face. 
EXAMPLE
vector(0.5, 0.5) places the origin at the bounding box's center.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.NO_TANGENT_PLANE
parameters.type: Could not find a tangent plane or there was a problem with face parameterization.

entries.name: evFaceTangentPlaneAtEdge
entries.description: Return a Plane tangent to face at a position on one of its edges.

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description: A number in the range 0..1 indicating a point along the edge to evaluate the tangent at.

parameters.name: usingFaceOrientation
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the edge orientation used is such that walking along the edge with "up" being the face normal will keep face to the left. If false, use the default orientation of the edge, which is the same orientation used by evEdgeTangentLine. Default is false.

entries.name: evFaceTangentPlanes
entries.description: Given a face, calculate and return an array of Planes tangent to that face, where each plane's origin is located at the point specified by its parameter-space coordinates.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description:
The face to evaluate. The face cannot be a mesh. 
EXAMPLE
qNthElement(qEverything(EntityType.FACE), 1)

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description:
an array of 2d unitless parameter-space vectors specifying locations of tangency on the face. The coordinates are relative to the parameter-space bounding box of the face. 
EXAMPLE
[ vector(0.5, 0.5), vector(0, 1) ]

parameters.name: returnUndefinedOutsideFace
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the function will only return a plane if vector is on the face, otherwise returns undefined. Default is false.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.NO_TANGENT_PLANE
parameters.type: Could not find a tangent plane or there was a problem with face parameterization.

entries.name: evFaceTangentPlanesAtEdge
entries.description: Return an array of Planes tangent to a face at an array of parameters on one of its edges. The x-direction of the plane is oriented with the tangent of the edge with respect to usingFaceOrientation.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: An array of numbers in the range 0..1 indicating points along the edge to evaluate the tangent at.

parameters.name: usingFaceOrientation
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the edge orientation used is such that walking along the edge with "up" being the face normal will keep face to the left. If false, use the default orientation of the edge, which is the same orientation used by evEdgeTangentLine. Default is false.

entries.name: evFilletRadius
entries.description: Given a face of a constant radius fillet, return the radius of fillet.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.BAD_GEOMETRY
parameters.type: The first resolved entity was not a filleted face.

entries.name: evLength
entries.description: Return the total length of all the entities (if they are edges) and edges belonging to entities (if they are bodies). If no edges are found the total length will be zero.

entries.name: evLine
entries.description: If the edge is a line, return a Line value for the given edge.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.INVALID_INPUT
parameters.type: The first resolved entity was not a line.

entries.name: evMateConnector
entries.description: Gets the coordinate system of the given mate connector

parameters.name: mateConnector
parameters.description: The mate connector to evaluate.

entries.name: evMaxPathDeviation
entries.description: Returns the max deviation between two paths.

parameters.name: side1
parameters.description: Bodies and/or edges forming a single continuous path.

parameters.name: side2
parameters.description: Bodies and/or edges forming a single continuous path.

parameters.name: showDeviation
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, will display a magenta comb for each deviation sample and a red line with a star for the maximum deviation. Default is false.

parameters.name: Return
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: deviation
parameters.description: value of the max deviation between side1 and side2.

parameters.name: side1Point
parameters.description: position on side1 where side1 is deviation away from side2.

parameters.name: side2Point
parameters.description: position on side2 where side2 is deviation away from side1.

entries.name: evMeshPoints
entries.description: Returns the positions of all the points of the input mesh bodies/faces.

parameters.name: meshes
parameters.description: Mesh faces and bodies to evaluate.

parameters.name: array
parameters.type: An array of positions of all the vertices of the given meshes

entries.name: evOwnerSketchPlane
entries.description: Return the plane of the sketch that created the given entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The sketch entity. May be a vertex, edge, face, or body.

parameters.name: checkAllEntities
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the function will only return a plane if all entities queried under 'entity' share coplanar sketch planes. Otherwise, the plane will only be evaluated for the first entity in the query. Default is false.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.CANNOT_RESOLVE_PLANE
parameters.type: Entities were not created by a sketch or do not share the same sketch plane.

entries.name: evPathLength
entries.description: The total length of the Path.

parameters.name: ValueWithUnits
parameters.type: The total length of the Path.

entries.name: evPathTangentLines
entries.signature: (context is Context, path is Path, parameters is array, referenceGeometry)
entries.description: Return tangent lines to a Path using arc length parameterization. By default, the 0 parameter of the Path will be the start of the Path. If evaluating a closed path, providing reference geometry will alter the 0 parameter to be the closest point on the Path to the reference geometry. Providing reference geometry for a non-closed Path will not change the parameterization of the Path

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The Path to use.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: An array of numbers in the range 0..1 indicating where along the Path to evaluate tangents.

parameters.name: referenceGeometry
parameters.description: A geometry Query to determine the 0 parameter of the Path, or undefined. If an empty Query or undefined is specified, the tangents will be evaluated starting at the beginning of the path.

parameters.name: Return
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: tangentLines
parameters.description: The tangent Lines corresponding to each parameter

parameters.name: edgeIndices
parameters.description: The indices of the edges in the Path corresponding to each parameter

parameters.name: pathDistanceInformation
parameters.description: A map containing the distance from the remapped 0 parameter to the center of the bounding box of referenceGeometry and whether the remapped 0 parameter falls inside that bounding box. Only valid if the path is closed.

entries.name: evPlanarEdge
entries.description: If the edge lies in a plane, return a Plane it lies in.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.CANNOT_RESOLVE_PLANE
parameters.type: The first resolved entity was not a planar edge.

entries.name: evPlanarEdges
entries.description: If all the edges in a query share the same plane, return a Plane they lie in.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.CANNOT_RESOLVE_PLANE
parameters.type: Edges in the query were either not planar or do not share the same plane.

entries.name: evPlane
entries.description: If the face is a planar face or a mate connector, return the Plane it represents.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.CANNOT_RESOLVE_PLANE
parameters.type: The first resolved entity was not a planar face or mate connector.

entries.name: evPointsDeviation
entries.description: Returns the deviation between the input points and the input topologies.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Points to measure the deviation from.

parameters.name: topologies
parameters.description: Bodies/faces/edges/vertices to measure the deviation to. The deviation will be between each point and the closest element of topologies

parameters.name: allDeviations
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, will return a deviation value for each point in points. If false, will only return the maximum deviation. Default is false.

parameters.name: showDeviation
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, show all deviations/the max deviation depending on the value of allDeviations. Default is false.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: OptionalDo not show deviations less than this value. No effect if showDeviation is false. Default is 0 meter.

parameters.name: array
parameters.type: If allDeviations is true, an array of maps, with one map per element in points; if it is false an array of a single map. Each map has a: deviation (ValueWithUnits) : The deviation between the given point and the elements of topologies. pointPoint (Vector) : The position of the given point. topologyPoint (Vector) : The closest position in topologies.

entries.name: evRaycast
entries.description: Detect intersections between a ray and the given entities.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: A query for target entities. If bodies are provided, the result will contain intersections for individual entities owned by the body.

parameters.name: ray
parameters.description:
The ray to intersect the entities. Because the passed-in Line is interpreted as a ray, by default, intersections with entities "behind" the ray origin are not detected. includeIntersectionsBehind can be set to true if those intersections are desired. 
EXAMPLE
line(vector(0, 0, 0) * inch, vector(1, 0, 0)) specifies the positive x-axis

parameters.name: closest
parameters.description: OptionalGet only the closest intersection with any of the entities. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: includeIntersectionsBehind
parameters.description: OptionalReturn intersections that are behind the ray origin. Defaults to false. Cannot be set to true if closest is true.

parameters.name: array
parameters.type: An array of RaycastResults for each intersection in front of the ray, ordered from closest to farthest.

entries.name: evSurfaceDefinition
entries.description: Return a descriptive value for a face, or the first face if the query finds more than one. Return a Cone, Cylinder, Plane, Sphere, Torus, or BSplineSurface as appropriate for the face, or an unspecified map value if the face is none of these with surfaceType filled of type SurfaceType

parameters.name: returnBSplinesAsOther
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, do not return B-spline surfaces (to avoid the associated time cost). Default is false.

parameters.name: "GBTErrorStringEnum.CANNOT_RESOLVE_PLANE"
parameters.type: The first result is not a face.

entries.name: evTessellatedLoftMatches
entries.description: Creates matching information for opTessellatedLoft.

parameters.name: profileSubqueries
parameters.description: A two element array containing edge or vertex profiles to loft between.

parameters.name: chordalTolerance
parameters.description: The maximum distance a chord can deviate from the path. Default is 0.005 meters

parameters.name: connections
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps to define multiple profile alignments. Each connection map should contain:
(1) connectionEntities query describing an array of vertices or edges (one per profile),
(2) connectionEdges an array of individual queries for edges in connectionEntities. The order of individual edge queries should be synchronized with connectionEdgeParameters.
(3) connectionEdgeParameters array - an ordered and synchronized array of parameters on edges in connectionEdgeQueries

parameters.name: frontThickness
parameters.description: The front thickness of the sheet metal.

parameters.name: backThickness
parameters.description: The back thickness of the sheet metal.

parameters.name: bendRadius
parameters.description: The bend radius of the sheet metal.

parameters.name: Return
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: matches
parameters.description: An array of arrays where each inner item is a map representing a point on the profile. Each inner item has a vector field position for its position in 3D space. If the point corresponds to a vertex, it will have a Query field vertex. If the point corresponds to an edge, it will have a Query field edge along with a number field parameter for the position on the edge.

parameters.name: isClosed
parameters.description: Whether the tessellated loft is periodic.

entries.name: evVertexPoint
entries.description: Return the coordinates of a point, or the origin of a mate connector.

entries.name: evVolume
entries.description: Return the total volume of all the entities. If no matching 3D bodies are found, the total volume will be zero.

entries.name: exp

entries.name: exp2

entries.description: Bounding type used with extend.

entries.description: Return an enlarged bounding box. The box is scaled by 1 + factor around its midpoint, and then each face is moved outward by absoluteValue (inward if absoluteValue is negative).

parameters.name: factor

entries.description: Defines what type of body a body-creating feature (extrude, revolve, etc.) should create.

entries.name: ExtendEndType

entries.name: ExtendSheetShapeType
entries.description: See opExtendSheetBody.

entries.name: extrude
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Create an extrude, as used in Onshape's extrude feature.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description:
Required if bodyType is SOLIDThe planar faces and/or sketch regions to extrude. 
EXAMPLE
qSketchRegion(id + "sketch1") specifies all sketch regions of a given sketch.

parameters.name: surfaceEntities
parameters.description:
Required if bodyType is SURFACEThe sketch curves to extrude. 
EXAMPLE
qCreatedBy(id + "sketch1", EntityType.EDGE)

parameters.name: endBound
parameters.description: OptionalThe end bounding condition for the extrude. Default is BLIND.

parameters.name: oppositeDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to flip the direction of the extrude to point opposite the face/sketch normal.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description:
Required if endBound is BLINDA length specifying the extrude depth. For a blind extrude, specifies the depth of the first extrude direction. For a symmetric extrude, specifies the full extrude depth. 
EXAMPLE
0.5 * inch

parameters.name: endBoundEntityFace
parameters.description: Required if endBound is UP_TO_SURFACESpecifies the face or surface to bound the extrude.

parameters.name: endBoundEntityBody
parameters.description: Required if endBound is UP_TO_BODYSpecifies the surface or solid body to bound the extrude.

parameters.name: endBoundEntityVertex
parameters.description: Required if endBound is UP_TO_VERTEXSpecifies the vertex to bound the extrude.

parameters.name: hasOffset
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to add a translational offset from the selected face, surface, solid body or vertex.

parameters.name: offsetDistance
parameters.description:
Required if offset is trueThe translational distance between the selected face, surface, solid body or vertex and the cap of the extrude. 
EXAMPLE
0.5 * inch

parameters.name: offsetOppositeDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
false to offset away from the selected end bound (default) EXAMPLE
true to offset into the selected end bound

parameters.name: hasDraft
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to add a draft to the extrude.

parameters.name: draftAngle
parameters.description:
Required if hasDraft is trueThe angle, as measured from the extrude direction, at which to draft. 
EXAMPLE
10 * degree

parameters.name: draftPullDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
false to draft outwards (default) EXAMPLE
true to draft inwards

parameters.name: hasSecondDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to specify a second direction.

parameters.name: secondDirectionBound
parameters.description: OptionalThe bounding type of the second direction. Can be different from the bounding type of the first direction.

parameters.name: secondDirectionOppositeDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true will flip the second end direction to align opposite the plane/face's normal.

parameters.name: secondDirectionDepth
parameters.description: Required if secondDirectionBound is BLINDA length specifying the second direction's extrude depth.

parameters.name: secondDirectionBoundEntityFace
parameters.description: Required if secondDirectionBound is UP_TO_SURFACEspecifies the face or surface to bound the extrude.

parameters.name: secondDirectionBoundEntityBody
parameters.description: Required if secondDirectionBound is UP_TO_BODYspecifies the surface or solid body to bound the extrude.

parameters.name: secondDirectionBoundEntityVertex
parameters.description: Required if secondDirectionBound is UP_TO_VERTEXspecifies the vertex to bound the extrude.

parameters.name: hasSecondDirectionOffset
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to add a translational offset from the selected face, surface, solid body or vertex.

parameters.name: secondDirectionOffsetDistance
parameters.description:
Required if offset is trueThe translational distance between the selected face, surface, solid body or vertex and the cap of the extrude. 
EXAMPLE
0.5 * inch

parameters.name: secondDirectionOffsetOppositeDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
false to offset away from the selected second direction end bound (default) EXAMPLE
true to offset into the selected second direction end bound

parameters.name: hasSecondDirectionDraft
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to add a draft to the second direction extrude.

parameters.name: secondDirectionDraftPullDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
false to draft the second direction outwards (default) EXAMPLE
true to draft the second direction inwards

parameters.name: defaultScope
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to merge with all other bodies EXAMPLE
false to merge with booleanScope

parameters.name: booleanScope

entries.name: HoleDefinition
entries.description: Describes the shape of a hole using a series of HoleProfiles.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: An array of HoleProfiles which define the shape of the hole. The profiles are interpreted in order, from the top to the bottom of the hole. The final profile must have a radius of 0. Each profile must specify a unique name, or all of the profiles must leave their name field undefined. If two or more adjacent profiles in the list end up being identical (in the same position with the same radius) when their final placement is determined in opHole, the identical profiles will be collapsed into a single profile, which uses the name of the first of the identical profiles.

parameters.name: faceNames
parameters.description: OptionalA list of names to assign to the faces created by opHole. Should be the same length as the profiles array, where faceNames[i] is the name of the face created between profiles i - 1 and i, and faceNames[0] is the name of the top cap face (the face before profile 0). If any profiles are collapsed, the names of the faces between the collapsed profiles are skipped. Supplying faceNames allows for the querying of faces by name when using qOpHoleFace.

entries.name: HoleEndStyle
entries.description: Defines the end bound for the hole cut.

parameters.name: BLIND
parameters.type: Cut holes to a specific depth.

parameters.name: BLIND_IN_LAST
parameters.type: Cut holes through all parts but the last, then cut to a specific depth in the last part.

parameters.name: THROUGH
parameters.type: Cut holes with a through-all extrude.

entries.name: HoleEndStyleV2
entries.description: Defines the end bound for the hole cut.

parameters.name: BLIND
parameters.type: Cut holes to a specific depth.

parameters.name: THROUGH
parameters.type: Cut holes with a through-all extrude.

entries.name: HolePositionReference
entries.description: For a HoleProfile, a reference point along the hole axis to which the position of the profile is relative. To calculate these references, the cylinder of the hole is intersected with the targets of the hole. If the hole cylinder encounters a slanted or otherwise irregular face at the intersection with the target, the reference may by a range rather than a single point. Users may specify that they want the end of this range by using a holeProfile, or the beginning of this range by using a holeProfileBeforeReference; or they may control this behavior directly by setting the beforeReference flag of the HoleProfile.

parameters.name: AXIS_POINT
parameters.type: When calling opHole, the user will supply one or more axes defining where the holes are to be placed. When using this reference, the position of the profile will be in reference to the origin of the axis Line of the hole.

parameters.name: TARGET_START
parameters.type: When using this reference, the position of the profile will be in reference to the closest intersection of the hole cylinder with any target.

parameters.name: LAST_TARGET_START
parameters.type: For each target, find the first intersection of the hole cylinder into the target. When using this reference, the position of the profile will be in reference to the furthest of those intersections. Notably, this means that if certain targets are geometrically constructed such that the hole cylinder enters and exits the target multiple times, only the first of the entrances into the target is considered.

parameters.name: LAST_TARGET_END
parameters.type: When using this reference, the position of the profile will be in reference to the furthest exit of the hole cylinder from any target.

parameters.name: LAST_TARGET_START_IN_DEPTH
parameters.type: For each target, find the first intersection of the hole cylinder into the target. When using this reference, the position of the profile will be in reference to the furthest of those intersections within the hole depth.

entries.name: HoleProfile
entries.description: Describes a single profile for a HoleDefinition.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: positionReference
parameters.description: The reference along the hole axis to which this profile is relative.

parameters.name: beforeReference
parameters.description: OptionalWhether the position of the profile should reference the start or end of the given positionReference. See holeProfileBeforeReference for more detail. Default is false if not provided. Only considered when profileType is POSITIONED, ignored otherwise.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Required if profileType is POSITIONEDThe position of the profile along the hole axis, relative to the given positionReference.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The radius of the profile. Can be 0 to specify that the profile forms a point.

parameters.name: targetMustDifferFromPrevious
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, instructs opHole to skip the construction of any holes in which the target referenced by this profile's positionReference is not different than the target reference by the previous profile's positionReference. entries.name: makeWrapSurface
entries.signature: (context is Context, face is Query, anchorPoint is Vector, spin is ValueWithUnits)
entries.description: Make a WrapSurface for opWrap defined by a planar, cylindrical or conical face.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: A face to use as the definition face for the WrapSurface.

parameters.name: anchorPoint
parameters.description: The anchor point of the WrapSurface. See WrapSurface documentation.

parameters.name: spin
parameters.description:
For a planar face: Angle of a counter-clockwise spin to apply to the plane's x axis about its positive z axis, which is then used as the anchorDirection. For a cylindrical face: Angle of a counter-clockwise spin to apply to the cylinder's canonical anchorDirection at the given anchorPoint about the direction vector from the cylinder axis to the anchorPoint. The canonical anchorDirection at the given anchorPoint is defined as the "rightward" direction when looking at the cylinder in the direction from the anchorPoint to the cylinder axis with the cylinder's zAxis up. In other words: cross(cylinder z axis, direction vector from cylinder axis to anchorPoint). This spun direction is then used as the anchorDirection. For a conical face: Angle of a counter-clockwise spin to apply to the cone's canonical anchorDirection at the given anchorPoint about the normal at anchorPoint. The canonical anchorDirection at the given anchorPoint is defined as the "rightward" direction when looking at the cone from the normal.

entries.description: Generates isoparametric curves of faces. That is, for each specified surface parameter value, creates a new wire body following the curve which keeps the surface parameter at that constant value.

parameters.name: curveDefinition
parameters.description: An array of CurveOnFaceDefinitions that describe group of curves per face.

parameters.name: showCurves
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to display isoparameteric curves in color in the preview.

parameters.name: skipTrim
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to skip trimming of curves by the face boundaries. Lines and arcs are always trimmed.

entries.name: opCreateIsocline
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Creates wires corresponding to the given faces's isocline edges. Each isocline follows a path along a face with a constant angle in the (-90, 90) degree range (e.g., lines of latitude on a sphere). This angle is the face tangent plane's angle with respect to the direction with its sign determined by the dot product of direction and the face normal, and is analogous to the angle used in draft analysis. Depending on the face geometry, there may be zero, one, or multiple isoclines on each face.

parameters.name: faces
parameters.description: The faces on which to imprint isoclines.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: A reference direction.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The isocline angle with respect to the direction in the (-90, 90) degree range.

entries.name: opDeleteBodies
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Deletes bodies from the context.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Entities to delete. Passing in entities other than bodies deletes their owning bodies.

entries.name: opDeleteFace
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: This is a direct editing operation that attempts to delete faces of a solid body and extend other faces to fill the hole.

parameters.name: deleteFaces
parameters.description: Faces to delete.

parameters.name: includeFillet
parameters.description: true to also delete fillets adjacent to the input faces.

parameters.name: capVoid
parameters.description: If capVoid is true and the deleted face cannot be filled by extending the surrounding faces, will attempt to replace the face with a planar face.

parameters.name: leaveOpen
parameters.description: OptionalIf leaveOpen is true the void from deleting faces is left open, potentially creating a surface out of a solid body. Default is false.

entries.name: opDraft
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Applies a given draft angle to faces.

parameters.name: draftFaces
parameters.description: Required if draftType is REFERENCE_SURFACE The faces to draft for a REFERENCE_SURFACE draft.

parameters.name: referenceSurface
parameters.description: Required if draftType is REFERENCE_SURFACE A face or plane that defines the neutral surface for a REFERENCE_SURFACE draft. draftFaces will remain unchanged where they intersect referenceSurface. Can be either a Query or a Plane.

parameters.name: referenceEntityDraftOptions
parameters.description: Required if draftType is REFERENCE_ENTITY An array of maps of the form ("face", "references", "angle"). "face" should be a Query for exactly one face. "references" should be a Query for at least one edge attached to the face. The "face" will be drafted while the geometry of the "references" remains unchanged. "angle" is an optional ValueWithUnits parameter between -89.9 and 89.9 degrees which overrides the default angle parameter.

parameters.name: pullVec
parameters.description:
The 3d direction relative to which the draft is applied. 
EXAMPLE
vector(0, 0, 1) .

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description:
The draft angle, must be between 0 and 89.9 degrees. 
EXAMPLE
3 * degree

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: OptionalFor a REFERENCE_SURFACE draft, true to propagate draft across tangent faces. Default is false.

parameters.name: referenceEntityPropagation
parameters.description: OptionalFor a REFERENCE_ENTITY draft, true to collect new reference entities and faces by pulling in edges connected to the specified reference edges. Connected edges on the same face or on tangent connected faces will be pulled in. Default is false.

parameters.name: reFillet
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to attempt to defillet draft faces before the draft and reapply the fillets after. Default is false.

entries.name: opDropCurve
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Projects curves on a face.

parameters.name: tools
parameters.description: The edges to project.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: The faces/bodies the edges are to be projected onto.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: OptionalThe direction in which to project the curve. Required if projectionType is ProjectionType.DIRECTION.

entries.name: opEnclose
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Takes in a set of bodies and faces and creates solid bodies for the enclosed regions.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Bodies and faces for enclosure.

entries.name: opExtractWires
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Generates wire bodies from the supplied edges. If the edges are disjoint multiple wires will be returned. If the edges overlap or cross, or more than two meet at a point, the function will fail.

parameters.name: edges
parameters.description: The edges to be extracted.

entries.name: opExtrude
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Extrudes one or more edges or faces in a given direction with one or two end conditions. Faces get extruded into solid bodies and edges get extruded into sheet bodies.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Edges and faces to extrude.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
The 3d direction in which to extrude. 
EXAMPLE
evOwnerSketchPlane(context, {"entity" : entities}).normal to extrude perpendicular to the owner sketch EXAMPLE
evPlane(context, {"face" : entities}).normal to extrude perpendicular to the first planar entity

parameters.name: endBound
parameters.description:
The type of bound at the end of the extrusion. Cannot be SYMMETRIC or UP_TO_VERTEX. 
EXAMPLE
BoundingType.BLIND

parameters.name: endDepth
parameters.description:
Required if endBound is BLIND.How far from the entities to extrude. 
EXAMPLE
1 * inch

parameters.name: endBoundEntity
parameters.description: Required if endBound is UP_TO_SURFACE or UP_TO_BODY.The face or body that provides the bound.

parameters.name: endTranslationalOffset
parameters.description: OptionalThe translational offset between the extrude end cap and the end bound entity. The direction vector for this is the same as direction: negative values pull the end cap away from the bound entity when endDepth is positive. endOffset will only have an effect if endBound is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.

parameters.name: startBound
parameters.description: OptionalThe type of start bound. Default is for the extrude to start at entities. Cannot be SYMMETRIC or UP_TO_VERTEX.

parameters.name: isStartBoundOpposite
parameters.description: Required if is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.Whether the startBound extends in the opposite direction from the profile as the endBound. Defaults to true if not supplied.

parameters.name: startDepth
parameters.description: Required if startBound is BLIND.How far from the entities to start the extrude. The direction vector for this is the negative of direction: positive values make the extrusion longer when endDepth is positive.

parameters.name: startBoundEntity
parameters.description: Required if startBound is UP_TO_SURFACE or UP_TO_BODY.The face or body that provides the bound.

parameters.name: startTranslationalOffset
parameters.description: OptionalThe translational offset between the extrude start cap and the start bound entity. The direction vector for this is the negative of direction: negative values pull the end cap away from the bound entity when startDepth is positive. startOffset will only have an effect if startBound is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.

entries.name: opFaceBlend
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Performs a face blend between two walls of faces.

parameters.name: side1
parameters.description: First set of faces, must belong to the same body.

parameters.name: side2
parameters.description: Second set of faces, must belong to the same body.

parameters.name: flipSide1Normal
parameters.description: Wether to flip side 1's normal.

parameters.name: flipSide2Normal
parameters.description: Wether to flip side 2's normal.

parameters.name: propagation
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to propagate the blend.

parameters.name: propagationAngle
parameters.description: OptionalMaximum angle between faces for propagation. Used if propagationType is FaceBlendPropagation.CUSTOM. Default is 0 * radian.

parameters.name: crossSection
parameters.description: The cross section type of the blend.

parameters.name: spine
parameters.description: Required if crossSection is DISC.The spine of the blend. The blend's cross section will be orthogonal to the spine.

parameters.name: crossSectionShape
parameters.description: What shape the cross section of the blend will be.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Required if blendControlType is RADIUS.The radius of the cross section.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Required if blendControlType is WIDTH.The width of the blend.

parameters.name: asymmetric
parameters.description: OptionalWether the radius or width is the same on each wall.

parameters.name: secondRadius
parameters.description: Required if blendControlType is RADIUS and asymmetric is true.The radius of the cross section from side 2.

parameters.name: widthRatio
parameters.description: Required if blendControlType is WIDTH and asymmetric is true.How the blend will be divided between the walls. If widthRatio < 1, it will be wider towards side 1. If widthRatio > 1, it will be wider towards side 2.

parameters.name: rho
parameters.description: Required if crossSectionShape is CONICParameter of the conic cross section shape.

parameters.name: magnitude
parameters.description: Required if crossSectionShape is CURVATUREParameter of the curvature cross section shape.

parameters.name: tangentHoldLines
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of tangentEdges and inverseTangentEdges.

parameters.name: tangentEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as tangent hold lines.

parameters.name: inverseTangentEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as inverse tangent hold lines.

parameters.name: conicHoldLines
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of conicEdges and inverseConicEdges.

parameters.name: conicEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as conic hold lines.

parameters.name: inverseConicEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as inverse conic hold lines.

parameters.name: hasCliffEdges
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of cliffEdges.

parameters.name: cliffEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as cliff edges.

parameters.name: hasCaps
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of caps.

parameters.name: caps
parameters.description: OptionalEntities and flip flags to use as caps. Each map should contain an entity Query element and a flip boolean element.

parameters.name: hasLimits
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of limitPlane1, limitPlane2, faceLimits and edgeLimit.

parameters.name: limitPlane1
parameters.description: OptionalFirst plane to limit the blend.

parameters.name: limitPlane1Flip
parameters.description: Whether to flip the first plane normal. Defines which side of the plane the blend will be.

parameters.name: limitPlane2
parameters.description: OptionalSecond plane to limit the blend.

parameters.name: limitPlane2Flip
parameters.description: Whether to flip the first plane normal. Defines which side of the plane the blend will be.

parameters.name: faceLimits
parameters.description: OptionalFaces to use as limits to the blend.

parameters.name: edgeLimit
parameters.description: OptionalEdges and adjacent faces to use as limits. Each map should contain an edge Query element and an edgeLimitSide query element.

parameters.name: hasHelpPoint
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of helpPoint.

parameters.name: helpPoint
parameters.description: OptionalVertex or mate connector to use as help point. In case the blend parameters create several blends, only the blend closest to the help point will be kept.

parameters.name: trim
parameters.description: OptionalHow to trim the blend.

parameters.name: detach
parameters.description: OptionalWhether not to attach the blend(s) to the sides, creating new sheet bodies.

parameters.name: showIsocurves
parameters.description: OptionalShow graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves of the created surface. Default false.

parameters.name: curveCount
parameters.description: OptionalWhen showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of the grid. Default 10.

entries.name: opFillet
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: For edges, performs a fillet on the edge. For faces, performs a fillet on all edges adjacent to the face.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Edges and faces to fillet.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description:
The fillet radius. 
EXAMPLE
1 * inch

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to propagate the fillet along edges tangent to those passed in. Default is false.

parameters.name: crossSection
parameters.description: OptionalFillet cross section. One of CIRCULAR, CONIC, CURVATURE. Default is CIRCULAR.

parameters.name: rho
parameters.description:
Required if crossSection is CONIC.A number between 0 and 1, specifying the Rho value of a conic fillet 
EXAMPLE
0.01 creates a flat, nearly-chamfered shape. EXAMPLE
0.99 creates a pointed, nearly-unchanged shape.

parameters.name: magnitude
parameters.description: Required if crossSection is CURVATURE.A number between 0 and 1, specifying the magnitude of curvature match.

parameters.name: partialFilletBounds
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps representing the boundaries of a partial fillet. Each map should contain a boundaryEdge query, a boundaryParameter value, a isFlipped boolean 
EXAMPLE
[{ "boundaryEdge" : edgeQuery0, "boundaryParameter" : 0.3, "isFlipped" : false }, { "boundaryEdge" : edgeQuery1, "boundaryParameter" : 0.6, "isFlipped" : true }]

parameters.name: isVariable
parameters.description: OptionalFillet controls can be varied at vertices via vertexSettings. Default is false.

parameters.name: vertexSettings
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps representing fillet settings at specified vertices. Each map should contain a vertex query, a vertexRadius value, a variableMagnitude if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CURVATURE, and a variableRho if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CONIC. 
EXAMPLE
[{ "vertex" : vertexQuery0, "vertexRadius" : 1 * inch, "variableRho" : 0.2 }, { "vertex" : vertexQuery1, "vertexRadius" : 2 * inch, "variableRho" : 0.8 }]

parameters.name: pointOnEdgeSettings
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps representing fillet settings at specified points on edges. Each map should contain an edge query, an edgeParameter value, a pointOnEdgeRadius value, a pointOnEdgeVariablMagnitude if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CURVATURE, and a pointOnEdgeVariableRho if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CONIC. 
EXAMPLE
[{ "edge" : edgeQuery0, "edgeParameter" : 0.3, "pointOnEdgeRadius" : 1 * inch }, { "edge" : edgeQuery1, "edgeParameter" : 0.6, "pointOnEdgeRadius" : 2 * inch }]

parameters.name: smoothTransition
parameters.description: Required if isVariable is true Whether to create a smoother transition between each vertex.

parameters.name: allowEdgeOverflow
parameters.description: OptionalAllow opFillet to modify nearby edges to maintain the fillet profile. Default is true.

parameters.name: keepEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges you do not want opFillet to modify if allowEdgeOverflow is true.

parameters.name: smoothCorners
parameters.description: OptionalAllow opFillet to smooth all suitable corners and prevent creation of sharp edges. Default is false.

parameters.name: smoothCornerExceptions
parameters.description: OptionalVertices you do not want opFillet to smooth if smoothCorners is true.

parameters.name: createDetachedSurface
parameters.description: OptionalOperation does not modify the body of the selected edges, but results in surface geometry of fillet. Default is false.

entries.name: opFillSurface
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Generates a surface body from supplied boundary and internal constraints. The boundaries are defined as edge queries for each continuity constraint. The internal constraints may be defined as a set of support vertices.

parameters.name: edgesG0
parameters.description: The edges with position constraints.

parameters.name: edgesG1
parameters.description: The edges with tangency constraints.

parameters.name: edgesG2
parameters.description: The edges with curvature constraints.

parameters.name: guideVertices
parameters.description: The vertices the resulting surface is expected to interpolate.

parameters.name: showIsocurves
parameters.description: OptionalShow graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves of the created surface. Default false.

parameters.name: curveCount
parameters.description: OptionalWhen showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of the grid. Default 10.

entries.name: opFitSpline
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Creates a 3D cubic spline curve through an array of 3D points.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description:
An array of Vectors with length units for the spline to interpolate. If the first point is the same as the last point, the spline is closed. 
EXAMPLE
[
    vector( 1,  1,  1) * inch,
    vector(-1,  1, -1) * inch,
    vector( 1, -1, -1) * inch,
    vector(-1, -1,  1) * inch,
    vector( 1,  1,  1) * inch
]

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of doubles, parameters corresponding to the points.

parameters.name: startDerivative
parameters.description: OptionalA Vector with length units that specifies the derivative at the start of the resulting spline (according to the arcLengthParameterization set to false).

parameters.name: endDerivative
parameters.description: OptionalA Vector with length units that specifies the derivative at the end of the resulting spline. Ignored if spline is closed.

parameters.name: start2ndDerivative
parameters.description: OptionalA Vector with length units that specifies the second derivative at the start of the resulting spline. Ignored if spline is closed, or if startDerivative is not defined

parameters.name: end2ndDerivative
parameters.description: OptionalA Vector with length units that specifies the second derivative at the end of the resulting spline. Ignored if spline is closed, or if endDerivative is not defined

parameters.name: derivatives
parameters.description: OptionalA map of derivatives at non-end points. Entries should be index : derivative, where index is an integer between 1 and size(points) - 2 and derivative is a Vector that specifies the derivative at points[index].

entries.name: opFlipOrientation
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Reverses the orientation of sheet bodies.

parameters.name: bodies
parameters.description: Sheet bodies whose orientation should be flipped.

entries.name: opFullRoundFillet
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Creates a full round fillet, replacing the center face(s) with circular profile face(s) of varying radius, joining the selected side faces.

parameters.name: side1Face
parameters.description: A face on one side of the blend.

parameters.name: side2Face
parameters.description: A face on another side of the blend.

parameters.name: centerFaces
parameters.description: The face(s) to be replaced.

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to propagate the fillet across side face tangencies. Default is true.

entries.name: opHelix
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Creates a helical and possibly spiral curve.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
The direction of the helix axis. 
EXAMPLE
vector(0, 0, 1)

parameters.name: axisStart
parameters.description:
A point on the helix axis. 
EXAMPLE
vector(0, 0, 0) * inch

parameters.name: startPoint
parameters.description:
The start point of the infinite helix. Must be off the axis. This is the point at which the created curve would actually start if the first number of interval is 0. 
EXAMPLE
vector(1, 0, 0) * inch

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description:
An array of two numbers denoting the interval of the helix in terms of revolution counts. 
EXAMPLE
[0, 10] will create a curve with 10 revolutions.

parameters.name: clockwise
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
true if this is a clockwise helix when viewed along direction.

parameters.name: helicalPitch
parameters.description:
Distance along the axis between successive revolutions. 
EXAMPLE
0.1 * inch will create a helix with 10 revolutions per inch. EXAMPLE
0 * inch produces a planar Archimedean spiral.

parameters.name: spiralPitch
parameters.description:
Change in radius between successive revolutions. 
EXAMPLE
0 * inch produces a helix that lies on a cylinder.

entries.name: opHole
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Creates hole tools referencing a set of targets, optionally subtracting the tools from the targets. If some tools cannot be built, the operation will still succeed and indicate in its return value which holes failed to build. If no tools can be built, the operation will fail.

parameters.name: holeDefinition
parameters.description:
The definition of the shape of the desired holes. 
EXAMPLE
holeDefinition([holeProfile(HolePositionReference.AXIS_POINT, 0 * inch, 0.1 * inch), holeProfile(HolePositionReference.AXIS_POINT, 1 * inch, 0 * inch)])

parameters.name: axes
parameters.description:
An array of Lines each of whose origin represents the start position of a hole, and whose direction represents the drill direction of the hole. 
EXAMPLE
[line(vector(-1, -1, 0) * inch, vector(0, 0, -1)), line(vector(1, 1, 0) * inch, vector(0, 0, -1))]

parameters.name: identities
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of queries, one per axis in axes, used to disambiguate each of the created holes. Each query should resolve to exactly one entity. Providing this information does not change the geometric outcome, but stabilizes references to the holes with respect to upstream changes to the model.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: Required if holeDefinition contains any profiles that do not reference HolePositionReference.AXIS_POINT, or if subtractFromTargets is true A set of bodies to target. The shape of the produced holes is dependent on the shape of these targets (as specified in the supplied HoleDefinition), so the full set of targeted bodies should always be supplied, even if subtractFromTargets is false.

parameters.name: subtractFromTargets
parameters.description: Optionaltrue if the hole geometry should be subtracted from the targets. false if the targets should not be modified, and the hole tools should be outputted as new solid bodies. Default is true. To subtract from a subset of targets, set this to true and supply a set of excluded targets as targetsToExcludeFromSubtraction. Removing the set of excluded targets from targets instead of using targetsToExcludeFromSubtraction is not the correct way to call this interface, and may result in the shape of the hole changing.

parameters.name: targetsToExcludeFromSubtraction
parameters.description: OptionalIf supplied and subtractFromTargets is true, the given targets are excluded from the subtraction. Ignored if subtractFromTargets is false

parameters.name: keepTools
parameters.description: OptionalIf subtractFromTargets is true, controls whether the hole tools should be outputted as new solid bodies. Default is false. Ignored if subtractFromTargets is false; in that case hole tools are always outputted as new solid bodies.

parameters.name: array

entries.name: opImportForeign
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Brings foreign geometry into the context. This function is used for importing uploaded parts.

parameters.name: blobData
parameters.description: Reference to a blob element hosting uploaded CAD data.

parameters.name: flatten
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to flatten assemblies; defaults to false.

parameters.name: yAxisIsUp
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the y axis in the import maps to the z axis and z maps to -y. If false (default), the coordinates are unchanged.

parameters.name: isModifiable
parameters.description: OptionalWhether the imported data is modifiable (default) or not.

entries.name: opIntersectFaces
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Intersect two faces, creating curves appropriately.

parameters.name: tools
parameters.description: First array of faces to intersect.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: Second array of faces to intersect.

entries.name: opLoft
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Creates a surface or solid loft fitting an ordered set of profiles, optionally constrained by guide curves.

parameters.name: profileSubqueries
parameters.description:
An ordered array of queries for the profiles. For a solid loft, these must be sheet bodies, faces, or vertices. For a surface loft, these could be wire bodies, sheet bodies, faces, edges, or vertices. 
EXAMPLE
[ profileQuery1, profileQuery2 ]

parameters.name: guideSubqueries
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of queries for guide curves. Each guide curve should intersect each profile once.

parameters.name: connections
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps to define multiple profile alignments. Each connection map should contain:
(1) connectionEntities query describing an array of vertices or edges (one per profile),
(2) connectionEdges an array of individual queries for edges in connectionEntities. The order of individual edge queries should be synchronized with connectionEdgeParameters.
(3) connectionEdgeParameters array - an ordered and synchronized array of parameters on edges in connectionEdgeQueries 
EXAMPLE
[ {"connectionEntities" : qVertexAndEdge1, "connectionEdges" : [qEdge1], "connectionEdgeParameters" : [0.25]} {"connectionEntities" : qVertexAndEdge2, "connectionEdges" : [qEdge2], "connectionEdgeParameters" : [0.75]}]

parameters.name: makePeriodic
parameters.description: OptionalDefaults to false. A closed guide creates a periodic loft regardless of this option.

parameters.name: trimGuidesByProfiles
parameters.description: OptionalIf false (default) use full length of guides. If true restrict resulting surface by the first and last profile. Meaningful only for non-periodic surface loft.

parameters.name: trimProfiles
parameters.description: OptionalIf false (default) use full length of profiles. If true restrict resulting surface by the first and last guide or connection. Meaningful only for surface loft with open profiles.

parameters.name: derivativeInfo
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps that contain shape constraints at start and end profiles. Each map entry is required to have a profileIndex that refers to the affected profile. Optional fields include a vector to match surface tangent to, a magnitude, and booleans for matching tangents or curvature derived from faces adjacent to affected profile. 
EXAMPLE
[ { "profileIndex" : 0, "vector" : vector(1, 0, 0), "magnitude" : 2., "tangentToPlane" : true}, { "profileIndex" : 1, "matchCurvature" : true, "adjacentFaces" : qFaces } ] The first map would constrain the resulting loft at the start profile to be tangent to plane with normal vector(1,0,0) and magnitude 2. The second map constrains the loft at the end profile to match the curvature of faces defined by the query qFaces.

parameters.name: showIsocurves
parameters.description: OptionalShow graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves on each face of the created loft. Default false.

parameters.name: curveCount
parameters.description: OptionalWhen showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of each face's grid. Default 10.

parameters.name: loftTopology
parameters.description: OptionalSpecifies topology of lofted body. Default is MINIMAL.

parameters.name: addSections
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to add a path. Default is false.

parameters.name: spine
parameters.description: OptionalQuery to specify the edge for the path.

parameters.name: sectionCount
parameters.description: OptionalNumber of sections to add. Required if addSections=true.

entries.name: opMateConnector
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Creates a mate connector, which represents a coordinate system in the context. Currently it is a special type of point body.

parameters.name: coordSystem
parameters.description: The mate connector coordinate system.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The owner body of the mate connector: when the owner is brought into an assembly, owned mate connectors will be brought in and move rigidly with it. If the query resolves to multiple bodies, the first is taken as the owner.

entries.name: opMergeContexts
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Bring all of the information from contextFrom into context. This is used, for example, for the Derived feature.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: The target context.

parameters.name: contextFrom
parameters.description:
The source context. It is rendered unusable by this operation. 
EXAMPLE
MyPartStudio::build()

parameters.name: trackThroughMerge
parameters.description: OptionalArray of queries to map evaluation result in contextFrom to context post-merge

parameters.name: array
parameters.type: Returns array of the same size as trackThroughMerge with evaluation results for each query(array of arrays of transient queries).

entries.name: opModifyCompositePart
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Modifies a composite part.

parameters.name: composite
parameters.description: Existing composite part to modify.

parameters.name: toAdd
parameters.description: Bodies to add to the composite part.

parameters.name: toRemove
parameters.description: Bodies to remove from the composite part.

entries.name: opModifyFillet
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
