entries.name: opSplitByIsocline
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Split the given faces by isocline edges. Each isocline follows a path along a face with a constant angle in the (-90, 90) degree range (e.g., lines of latitude on a sphere). This angle is the face tangent plane's angle with respect to the direction with its sign determined by the dot product of direction and the face normal, and is analogous to the angle used in draft analysis. Depending on the face geometry, there may be zero, one, or multiple isoclines on each face. The isocline edges are created as new edges which split the provided faces. The resulting faces are either steep (i.e., the angle is less than the input angle) or non-steep. To instead leave the original faces intact, you can first extract the faces with opExtractSurface(), and create isoclines on the resulting surfaces. The isocline edges can be queried for with qCreatedBy. The split orientation is consistent such that the non-steep faces are always in "front" of the split, and can be reliably queried for with qSplitBy:

parameters.name: faces
parameters.description: The faces on which to imprint isoclines.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: A reference direction.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The isocline angle with respect to the direction in the (-90, 90) degree range.

entries.name: opSplitBySelfShadow
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Splits the faces of the given bodies into visible and invisible regions with respect to the given viewDirection, creating shadow curves as necessary. A shadow curve represents the transition of one face from visible to invisible. Depending on the geometry, there may be zero, one, or more shadow curves per face. The shadow curve edges are created as new edges which split the faces of the provided bodies. Each of the resulting faces is wholly visible or wholly invisible. Edge-on faces are considered invisible. The shadow curve edges can be queried for with qCreatedBy. The split orientation is consistent such that the visible faces are always in "front" of the split, and can be reliably queried for with qSplitBy:

parameters.name: bodies
parameters.description: The bodies which cast shadows and on which to imprint shadow curves.

parameters.name: viewDirection
parameters.description: The viewing direction.

entries.name: opWrap

entries.description: Wraps or unwraps faces from one surface onto another. The location and orientation of the wrapped faces on the destination surface are controlled by the anchorPoint and anchorDirection of the source and destination WrapSurfaces. The entities of the operation are not affected, the result of this operation is a new set of surface bodies or imprinted edges representing the wrapped or unwrapped faces. Faces that are topologically connected will remain topologically connected in the result body for WrapType.SIMPLE and WrapType.TRIM. This operation currently supports wrapping from a plane onto a cylinder or a cone, and unwrapping from a cylinder or a cone onto a plane.

parameters.name: orientWithDestination
parameters.description: OptionalIf true (default), the normals of the resulting surface will point in the same direction as the destination. If false, the normals of the resulting surface will point in the opposite direction. For the purpose of this parameter, the normals of a WrapSurface defined by an infinite Cylinder are always pointing outwards.

entries.name: pointsManipulator

parameters.name: index

entries.name: prepareInitialArcSketch
entries.signature: (wrapAroundFront is boolean, modelParameters is map, innerRadius is ValueWithUnits, angle is ValueWithUnits)

entries.name: println

entries.name: processNewBodyIfNeeded
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map, reconstructOp is function)
entries.description: This function is designed to be used by body-creating features (like extrude) as a boolean post-processing step with options from booleanStepTypePredicate and booleanStepScopePredicate in the case where the preceding operations of the feature have created new solid or surface bodies. On top of the regular boolean operation, converts the operationType and creates error bodies on failure.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: identifier of the main feature

parameters.name: reconstructOp
parameters.description:
A function which takes in an Id, and reconstructs the input to show to the user as error geometry in case the input is problematic or the boolean itself fails. 
EXAMPLE
function() {} . For a more elaborate example see the source code of revolve feature in the Standard Library.

parameters.name: defaultScope
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true indicates merge scope of "everything else" (default) EXAMPLE
false indicates merge scope is specified in booleanScope

parameters.name: booleanScope
parameters.description: targets to use if defaultScope is false

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: OptionalIf set, will be included in the tools section of the boolean.

parameters.name: mergeScopeExclusion
parameters.description: OptionalIf set, will be excluded from the targets section of the boolean.

entries.name: processSubfeatureStatus
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, options is map)
entries.description: Propagate the status of a subfeature to a feature.

parameters.name: subfeatureId

parameters.name: overrideStatus
parameters.description: OptionalA status enum to use instead of the subfeature status enum if the subfeature has an info, warning, or error status.

parameters.name: propagateErrorDisplay
parameters.description: OptionalUse subfeature error display when present. Default is false.

parameters.name: additionalErrorEntities
parameters.description: OptionalAdditional error entities to display if the subfeature has an info, warning, or error status.

parameters.name: LOCK_FACES

parameters.name: LOCK_DIRECTION

entries.name: project

entries.name: projectCurves
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Feature creating projected curves.

parameters.name: sketchEdges2
parameters.description: Required if curveProjectionType is TWO_SKETCHES Edges from a single sketch that will be extruded to perform an intersection.

parameters.name: dropTools
parameters.description: Required if curveProjectionType is CURVE_TO_FACE Edges that will be projected onto targets.

parameters.name: directionQuery
parameters.description: Required if projectionType is DIRECTION Specifies the direction of projection.

parameters.name: oppositeDirection
parameters.description: Required if projectionType is DIRECTION If true, negates the direction supplied by directionQuery.

parameters.name: targets

entries.name: ProjectionType
entries.description: See opDropCurve.

entries.name: PropertyType
entries.description: Defines the type of property that is being applied to a part.

parameters.name: CUSTOM
parameters.type: Requires a custom property id to specify fully.

entries.name: qActiveSheetMetalFilter
entries.description: A query for all entities in queryToFilter belonging to an active sheet metal part.

entries.name: qAdjacent
entries.signature: (seed is Query, adjacencyType is AdjacencyType, entityType is EntityType)
entries.description: A query for entities that are adjacent to the given seed entities.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: One or more entities whose adjacent neighbors are queried. The result does not include the original seed entities (unless they are adjacent to other seed entities)

entries.name: qAllModifiableSolidBodies
entries.description: A query for all modifiable solid bodies, including mesh-containing bodies.

entries.name: qAllModifiableSolidBodiesNoMesh
entries.description: A query for all solid bodies that do not have mesh geometry or in context geometry, i.e. every non-mesh-containing part displayed in the Part Studio's "Parts" list.

entries.name: qAllNonMeshSolidBodies
entries.description: A query for all solid bodies that do not have mesh geometry.

entries.name: qAllSolidBodies
entries.description: A query for all solid bodies.

entries.name: qAttributeFilter
entries.description: Note: This query is used only for legacy unnamed attributes, which are still supported but no longer reccommended. See the Attributes module for details.

parameters.name: attributePattern
parameters.description:
Will only resolve to queries whose legacy unnamed attributes match the type (and possibly the values) of this pattern.
If attributePattern has a type tag, will only match attributes with that same type tag. 
EXAMPLE
{} as MyCustomType will match all attributes with type tag MyCustomTypeIf the attribute has no type tag (i.e. it is a standard type like string or map), will match all attributes with that same standard type. 
EXAMPLE
"asdf" will match all string attributes. EXAMPLE
{} will match all map attributes.If the attribute is a map, will only match maps which have identical values for every key-value pair in the pattern 
EXAMPLE
{ "odd" : true } matches all unnamed map attributes that have a field "odd" whose value is true. EXAMPLE
{ "odd" : true } as MyCustomType matches all unnamed map attributes with the that have a field "odd" whose value is true.

entries.name: qAttributeQuery
entries.description: Note: This query is used only for legacy unnamed attributes, which are still supported but no longer reccommended. See the Attributes module for details.

entries.name: qAxis
entries.description: A query that filters edges and faces into axis-symmetric ones (lines, circles, cylinders, cones, tori, revolved, mate connectors) that have the given axis. The sign of the axis direction does not matter.

entries.name: qBodiesWithFormAttribute
entries.description: Query for all bodies in queryToFilter marked with a FormAttribute and value exactly equal to attribute

entries.name: qBodiesWithFormAttributes
entries.description: Query for all bodies in queryToFilter marked with a FormAttribute and value exactly equal to one of the attributes

entries.name: qBodyType
entries.description: A query for all entities in queryToFilter which are bodies of the a specified BodyType, or are owned by bodies with the specified BodyType

entries.name: qCapEntity
entries.signature: (featureId is Id, capType is CapType, entityType is EntityType)
entries.description: A query for start/end cap vertex, edge, and face entities created by featureId. Cap entities are produced by extrude, revolve, sweep, loft and thicken features

entries.name: qClosestTo
entries.description: A query for the entity in queryToFilter closest to a point.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: A position vector for the point to find entities closest to.

entries.name: qCoincidesWithPlane
entries.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges, or points) in queryToFilter coinciding with a specified infinite plane.

parameters.name: plane
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
plane(vector(0, 0, 0) * meter, vector(0, 0, 1))

entries.name: qCompositePartsContaining
entries.description: A query for each composite part of the given type containing bodies.

entries.name: qCompositePartTypeFilter
entries.description: A query for all bodies in queryToFilter which are either open or closed composite parts, depending on the second parameter.

entries.name: qConcaveConnectedFaces
entries.description: A query for a set of faces connected to seed via concave edges, flood-filling across any number of concave edges.

entries.name: qConstructionFilter
entries.description: A query for all construction entities or all non-construction entities in queryToFilter.

entries.name: qConsumed
entries.description: A query for all entities in queryToFilter which are consumed by any closed composite part, or all entities of queryToFilter which are not consumed by any closed composite part.

entries.name: qContainedInCompositeParts
entries.description: A query for each part contained in compositeParts.

entries.name: qContainsPoint
entries.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges, or points) in queryToFilter containing a specified point.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: A 3D point, in world space.

entries.name: qConvexConnectedFaces
entries.description: A query for a set of faces connected to seed via convex edges, flood-filling across any number of convex edges.

entries.name: qCorrespondingInFlat
entries.description: A query for entities in sheet metal flattened body corresponding to any entitiesInFolded which are part of 3D sheet metal bodies

entries.name: qCreatedBy
entries.description: A query for all the entities created by a feature or operation. The feature is given by its feature id, which was passed into the the operation function in order to create the feature.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description:
The Id of the specified feature. 
EXAMPLE
id + "extrude1"

entries.name: qDefaultBodies
entries.description: A query for all default created bodies in a context, that is, the top, right, front planes and the origin point.

entries.name: qDependency
entries.description: A query for the true dependency of the given dependentEntities. For instance, the true dependency of the extruded body will be the face or sketch edges of the profile from which it is extruded.

entries.name: qEdgeAdjacent
entries.description: Deprecated: Use qAdjacent with AdjacencyType.EDGE

entries.name: qEdgeConvexityTypeFilter
entries.description: A query that filters given edges by convexity.

entries.name: qEdgeTopologyFilter
entries.description: A query for edges in a queryToFilter which match a given EdgeTopology.

entries.name: qEdgeVertex
entries.description: A query for the start or end vertices of edges.

entries.name: qEntityFilter
entries.description: A query for entities in a queryToFilter which match a given EntityType.

entries.name: qEverything
entries.description: A query for all entities of a specified EntityType in the context.

entries.name: qFaceOrEdgeBoundedFaces
entries.description: Given a seed face and bounding entities, matches all adjacent faces inside the bounding entities, expanding from the seed face.

parameters.name: faceAndBoundingEntities
parameters.description: A Query for the seed face, followed by any boundary faces or edges. The seed face must be first, so a qUnion should be used to guarantee the order.

entries.name: qFacesParallelToDirection
entries.description: A query for all faces in queryToFilter that are parallel to the given direction vector e.g. if it is a planar face, the plane normal is perpendicular to direction if it is a cylindrical face, the axis is parallel to direction if it is an extruded face, the extrude direction is parallel to direction

entries.name: qFarthestAlong
entries.description: A query for the entity in queryToFilter farthest along a direction in world space. In the case of a tie, resolves to all entities within TOLERANCE.zeroLength of being the farthest.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: A vector for the direction to find the entity farthest away.

entries.name: qFilletFaces
entries.description: A query for fillet faces of radius equal to, less than or equal to, or greater than or equal to the input faces. If facesToCompareTo does not match one or more fillet faces, the resulting query will not match any faces. Will find the fillet radius from each face and compare to find faces of all fillets on that body that satisfy the compareType.

entries.name: qFlattenedCompositeParts
entries.description: A query for non-composite entities in entities and constituents of composite parts in entities.

entries.name: qFrontPlane
entries.description: A query for the front plane.

entries.name: qGeometry
entries.description: A query for all entities in queryToFilter with a specified GeometryType.

entries.name: qHasAttribute
entries.description: Query for all entities in queryToFilter marked with an attribute with name name

entries.name: qHasAttributeWithValue
entries.signature: (queryToFilter is Query, name is string, value)
entries.description: Query for all entities in queryToFilter marked with an attribute with name name and value exactly equal to value

entries.name: qHasAttributeWithValueMatching
entries.signature: (queryToFilter is Query, name is string, attributePattern is map)
entries.description: Query for all entities in queryToFilter marked with an attribute with name name and a map value matching every key-value pair in the provided attributePattern map.

parameters.name: attributePattern

entries.name: qHoleFaces
entries.description: Given a single face inside a hole or hole-like geometry, returns all faces of that hole.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: A query for a single face inside the hole.

entries.name: qInFrontOfPlane
entries.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges, or points) in queryToFilter in front of a specified infinite plane. Entities intersecting the plane will not be resolved. Only entities completely on one side or coincident with the plane will be selected. Use flip(plane) to query entities on the other side of the plane. For example, for the XY plane through the origin with the normal (0, 0, 1), qInFrontOfPlane will resolve the vertices (1, 1, 0) and (1, 1, 1) but not the vertex (1, 1, -1).

parameters.name: plane
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
plane(vector(0, 0, 0) * meter, vector(0, 0, 1))

entries.name: qIntersectsLine
entries.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges, or points) in queryToFilter touching a specified infinite line.

entries.name: qIntersectsPlane
entries.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges, or points) in queryToFilter touching a specified infinite plane.

parameters.name: plane
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
plane(vector(0, 0, 0) * meter, vector(0, 0, 1))

entries.name: qLaminarDependency
entries.description: A query for the true dependency of the given dependentEntities, specifically for use with wire edges that have been created from laminar edges. If the immediate dependency is not laminar then it will track back until it reaches a laminar dependency (if there is one).

entries.name: qLargest
entries.description: A query to find the largest entity (by length, area, or volume) in queryToFilter.

entries.name: qLoopBoundedFaces
entries.description: Given a face and an edge, query for all faces bounded by the given face, on the side of the given edge.

parameters.name: faceAndEdge
parameters.description: Should match a face and an edge. If multiple faces and edges match, used the first face and the first edge.

entries.name: qLoopEdges
entries.description: A query for a set of edges defining a loop. If the seed has laminar edges, this query will extend to include all laminar loops that contain any seed edges. If the seed has faces, the result will include the loops forming the outer boundary of the joined faces.

entries.name: qMatching
entries.description: Matches any faces or edges within owner bodies of entities in referenceEntities which are geometrically identical (same size and shape) to the face or edge in referenceEntities.

entries.name: qMateConnectorsOfParts
entries.description: A query for all mate connectors owned by parts.

entries.name: qMeshGeometryFilter
entries.description: A query for all mesh entities or all non-mesh entities in queryToFilter.

entries.name: qModifiableEntityFilter
entries.description: A query for all modifiable entities in queryToFilter.

entries.name: qNonCapEntity
entries.description: A query for vertex, edge, and face entities created by featureId that are not cap entities. Cap entities are produced by extrude, revolve, sweep, loft and thicken features

entries.name: qNothing
entries.description: An empty query, which does not resolve to any entities.

entries.name: qNthElement
entries.description: A query for one entity in queryToFilter at a specified index. The order of entities resolved by a query is deterministic but arbitrary.

parameters.name: queryToFilter
parameters.description: A query which resolves to at least n+1 entities

parameters.name: n
parameters.description:
Zero-based index of entity in queryToFilter. 
EXAMPLE
0 indicates the first entity EXAMPLE
-1 indicates the last entity

entries.name: qOpHoleFace
entries.description: A query for the hole faces created by an opHole operation.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description:
The Id of the specified operation. 
EXAMPLE
id + "hole1"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: OptionalFilter the query for faces with a given name. See faceNames field of HoleDefinition.

parameters.name: identity
parameters.description: OptionalFilter the query for the hole associated with the given identity entity. See identities parameter of opHole.

entries.name: qOpHoleProfile
entries.description: A query for the profile edges or vertices created by an opHole operation.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description:
The Id of the specified operation. 
EXAMPLE
id + "hole1"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: OptionalFilter the query for profiles with a given name. See name field of HoleProfile.

parameters.name: identity
parameters.description: OptionalFilter the query for the hole associated with the given identity entity. See identities parameter of opHole.

entries.name: qOrigin
entries.description: A query for the origin point.

entries.name: qOwnedByBody
entries.description: A query for all of the entities (faces, vertices, edges, and bodies) in a context which belong to a specified body or bodies.

entries.name: qOwnerBody
entries.description: A query for each body that any of the given entities belong to.

entries.name: qParallelEdges
entries.description: A query to find all linear edges in queryToFilter which are parallel (or anti-parallel) to any linear edge in edges.

entries.name: qParallelPlanes
entries.signature: (queryToFilter is Query, normal is Vector, allowAntiparallel is boolean)
entries.description: A query for all planar face entities in queryToFilter that are parallel to a plane specified by the normal vector.

parameters.name: normal
parameters.description: The normal vector to reference when checking for parallelism.

parameters.name: allowAntiparallel
parameters.description: Whether to also return entities that are antiparallel.

entries.name: qPartsAttachedTo
entries.description: A query for parts to which sheetMetalEntities are attached (e.g. sheet metal bend line entities are attached to a flattened sheet metal part)

entries.name: qPatternInstances
entries.signature: (featureId is Id, instanceNames is array, entityType is EntityType)
entries.description: A query for entities created by a specific instance or instances of an opPattern operation.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description:
The Id of the specified feature. 
EXAMPLE
id + "pattern1"

parameters.name: instanceNames
parameters.description: The names of the instances to query for, a subset of the instanceNames passed into the opPattern operation.

entries.name: qPlanesParallelToDirection
entries.description: A query for all planar faces in queryToFilter that are parallel to the given direction vector (i.e., the plane normal is perpendicular to direction).

entries.name: qRightPlane
entries.description: A query for the right plane.

entries.name: qSheetMetalFlatFilter
entries.description: A query for all entities in queryToFilter belonging to a flattened sheet metal part.

entries.name: qSheetMetalFormFilter
entries.description: A query for all entities in queryToFilter that are artifacts of a sheet metal form feature on flat pattern.

entries.name: qSketchFilter
entries.description: A query for all sketch entities, or all non-sketch entities in queryToFilter.

entries.name: qSketchRegion
entries.description: A query for all fully enclosed, 2D regions created by a sketch.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The feature id of the Sketch being queried.

parameters.name: filterInnerLoops
parameters.description: OptionalSpecifies whether to exclude sketch regions fully contained in other sketch regions. A region whose border has a vertex or edge on the outside boundary is not considered "contained." Default is false.

entries.name: qSmallest
entries.description: A query to find the smallest entity (by length, area, or volume) in queryToFilter.

entries.name: qSMDefinitionEntityFilter
entries.description: A query for sheet metal definition entities in a queryToFilter which match a given EntityType.

entries.name: qSMFlatFilter
entries.description: Deprecated: Use qSheetMetalFlatFilter

entries.name: qSourceMesh
entries.description: A query for each mesh element that any selectedMeshVertices belong to. selectedMeshVertices should be the point bodies created when a user selects a mesh vertex. Mesh vertices which have not been selected cannot be queried in FeatureScript

parameters.name: selectedMeshVertices
parameters.description: One or more mesh vertices whose owning elements are queried.

entries.name: qSplitBy
entries.signature: (featureId is Id, entityType, backBody is boolean)
entries.description: Given the id of a split feature, get entities of a given EntityType on the front or the back side of the split. For a split by face or part, the front denotes the body in the direction of the split tool's surface normal, and the back denotes the body opposite the normal. For a split by isocline, the front denotes non-steep faces and edges, and the back denotes steep entities.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
id + "split1"

parameters.name: backBody
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
false indicates the entities in the front. EXAMPLE
true indicates the entities in the back.

entries.name: qSubtraction
entries.description: A query for entities which match query1, but do not match query2. qSubtraction preserves the order of query1.

entries.name: qSymmetricDifference
entries.description: A query for entities which match either query1 or query2, but not both.

entries.name: qTangentConnectedEdges
entries.description: A query for a chain of tangent edges connected to seed via tangent vertices, chaining across any number of tangent vertices.

entries.name: qTangentConnectedFaces
entries.description: A query for a set of faces connected to seed via tangent edges, flood-filling across any number of tangent edges.

entries.name: qTopPlane
entries.description: A query for the top plane.

entries.name: Query
entries.description: A Query identifies a specific subset of a context's entities (points, lines, planes, and bodies).

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

entries.name: QueryFilterCompound
entries.description: A set of convenience filters, which are expanded during precondition processing. Can be used as a filter on query parameters, just like their corresponding expansions:

parameters.name: ALLOWS_AXIS
parameters.type: Equivalent to GeometryType.LINE || GeometryType.CIRCLE || GeometryType.ARC || GeometryType.CYLINDER || BodyType.MATE_CONNECTOR and can be processed with evAxis

parameters.name: ALLOWS_DIRECTION
parameters.type: Equivalent to GeometryType.LINE || GeometryType.CIRCLE || GeometryType.ARC || GeometryType.CYLINDER || GeometryType.PLANE and can be processed with extractDirection

parameters.name: ALLOWS_PLANE
parameters.type: Equivalent to GeometryType.PLANE || BodyType.MATE_CONNECTOR and can be processed with evPlane

parameters.name: ALLOWS_VERTEX
parameters.type: Equivalent to EntityType.VERTEX || BodyType.MATE_CONNECTOR and can be processed with evVertexPoint

entries.name: queryVariable
entries.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
entries.description: Feature to create a query variable via calling setQueryVariable. This variable may be used in featurescript via call getQueryVariable or in the UI by clicking the "Variable selection" dropdown in the feature dialog or by selecting the query variable feature in the feature list.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the feature. Must not belong to a non-query variable feature. If a query variable feature with this name exists, it will be overwritten after this feature.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of the variable. Maximum length of 256 characters.

parameters.name: selectionQuery
parameters.description: If selectionType is SELECTION, query that will be contained in the variable.

parameters.name: createdByFeatures
parameters.description: If selectionType is CREATED_BY, features whose created entities will be contained in the variable.

parameters.name: seedBodies
parameters.description: If selectionType is OWNED_BY or EDGE_CONVEXITY, bodies owning the entities that will be contained in the variable.

parameters.name: seedFaces
parameters.description: If selectionType is PROTRUSION or POCKET or HOLE or FILLETS or BOUNDED_FACES, or TANGENT_CONNECTED or MATCHING and seedType is FACE, faces from which the selection is created.

parameters.name: seedEdgesOrFaces
parameters.description: If selectionType is LOOP_CHAIN_CONNECTED, faces or edges from which the loops are computed.

parameters.name: boundedFacesBounds
parameters.description: If selectionType is BOUNDED_FACES, the faces or edges bounding the selection.

parameters.name: addAdditionalQueries
parameters.description: Whether to include addition queries in the variable.

parameters.name: additionalQueries
parameters.description: An array of additional queries to include. Each item's content is analogous to what is contained in the original query. It also contains a booleanOperation field determining how to combine the additional query with the current query.

parameters.name: evaluateOnUse
parameters.description: Whether to evaluate the variable when it is created or when it is used.

parameters.name: showSelection
parameters.description: Whether to highlight the entities contained in the created variable.

entries.name: qUnion
entries.signature: (query1 is Query, query2 is Query, query3 is Query, query4 is Query)

entries.name: qUniqueVertices
entries.description: A query that filters out duplicate vertices. When duplicates are found, the vertex with the lowest deterministic ID is used.

entries.name: qVertexAdjacent
entries.description: Deprecated: Use qAdjacent with AdjacencyType.VERTEX

entries.name: qWithinRadius
entries.signature: (queryToFilter is Query, point is Vector, radius is ValueWithUnits)
entries.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges or points) in queryToFilter that are within a specified radius from a point.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: The point from which to check distance from.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The distance away from the point.

entries.name: radian
entries.description: A constant equal to 1 radian.

entries.name: radianPerSecond
entries.description: A constant equal to 1 radian per second.

entries.name: range
entries.description: Return an array of numbers, (of type number or ValueWithUnits), in a range. Note: before FeatureScript 372 this function received as input the step size instead of the number of steps

entries.name: RaycastResult
entries.description: Map containing the results of one collision between a ray and an entity.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: A query for the entity hit by the ray.

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description: Parameters for where the ray hit the entity. A unitless 2-vector for a face, a number for an edge, else undefined.

parameters.name: intersection
parameters.description: Intersection point.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Distance of the intersection point from the ray origin.

entries.name: RealBoundSpec
entries.description: A spec to be used with the isReal predicate to define allowable real numbers and customize UI behaviors for feature dialog parameters that take in a real number.

entries.name: reciprocal
entries.description: Inverts a value, including units.

entries.name: RecordPatternType
entries.description: Allows differentiation of patterns in computed data

entries.name: ReferenceType
entries.description: Point reference types.

entries.name: regenError
entries.signature: (customMessage is string, faultyParameters is array, entities is Query)
entries.description: An array of strings that correspond to keys in the feature definition map. Throwing a regenError with faultyParameters will highlight them in red inside the feature dialog.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: A query for entities to highlight in the Part Studio. Multiple queries can be combined and highlighted using the qUnion function. The entities are only highlighted when the feature dialog is open.

entries.name: REGEX_NUMBER

entries.name: setDimensionedEntities
entries.description: Tolerant dimensions require multiple pieces of information. This function specifies all of the information required for a dimension that cannot be specified in a tolerant quantity. Tolerant quantities are commonly declared in a feature using the UIHint.CAN_BE_TOLERANT or UIHint.CAN_BE_TOLERANT_DIAMETER UI hints in the annotation of the quantity parameter.

parameters.name: parameterId
parameters.description: The id of the tolerant quantity parameter in the feature definition.

parameters.name: queries
parameters.description: An array of one query (for a radius or diameter dimension) or two queries (for other dimensions). The queries can evaluate to more than one face, but in that case each face should lie on the same underlying surface. See extrude and fillet for examples.

parameters.name: facePairs
parameters.description: Required if queries is undefinedAn array of pairs of queries (a pair is an array of two queries). Used for features where mulitple face pairs are subject to the same constraint but they are not all coincident, for example, a thin extrusion of a square where the thickness is tolerant.

parameters.name: measuresSolidAngle
parameters.description: OptionalUsed to specify which part of a circle an angle dimension refers to. The angle between two planes can be defined by two possible numbers that sum to 360 degrees. If this option is SOLID, then the angle is measured from the first face, in to the part. If this option is VOID, then the angle is measured from the first face, out of the part. If this option is not set for an angle, then the result is consistent but undefined. It is recommended that an option is always provided for angle dimensions.

parameters.name: measurementDirection
parameters.description: OptionalUsed with dimensions of type FeatureDimensionType.AXIS_DISTANCE. If this option is not set then the dimension measures the shortest distance between the axes. If this option is set then the dimension measures the distance between the axes in this direction.

parameters.name: schemaClass
parameters.description: OptionalOn regeneration a dimension with a quantity with tolerance type ToleranceType.DEFAULT will set its tolerances given the nominal value and any default tolerances specified on the part. If this field is not set then the rule used will be either the default linear or angular rule, depending on the dimension type. If this field is set then the dimension will use the custom rule corresponding to the value. This field can also be a ToleranceSchemaClass to use a predefined class from the standard library. For example, you can set this to ToleranceSchemaClass.FILLET_RADIUS to use the same tolerance rules as Onshape's official fillet feature.

parameters.name: tolerances
parameters.description: OptionalContains tolerance and precision information for the specified parameter. This cannot be set if the parameter has been marked tolerant by the user.

parameters.name: nominal
parameters.description: Required if tolerances is not undefinedRequired if setting tolerances, for either an existing or new parameter. For an existing feature parameter, this is usually the value of that parameter.

entries.name: UIHint
entries.description: List of available UI Hints, which control how a parameter input is displayed in the feature dialog.

parameters.name: OPPOSITE_DIRECTION
parameters.type: For a boolean parameter, display as a toggle button with arrow next to the previous parameter.

parameters.name: ALWAYS_HIDDEN
parameters.type: Do not display this parameter or allow a user to edit it (useful for parameters changed only in editing logic or manipulator change functions).

parameters.name: SHOW_CREATE_SELECTION
parameters.type: For a query parameter, include a button to open the "Create selection" dialog.

parameters.name: NO_PREVIEW_PROVIDED
parameters.type: For a feature, hide the preview slider which controls before/after transparency, and only show the final version.

parameters.name: REMEMBER_PREVIOUS_VALUE
parameters.type: When a user makes a new instance of this feature, set this parameter's default value to the value they set the last time they used this feature.

parameters.name: DISPLAY_SHORT
parameters.type: Two consecutive boolean or quantity parameters marked as DISPLAY_SHORT may be placed on the same line.

parameters.name: SHOW_EXPRESSION
parameters.type: If an expression (like #foo or 1/4 in) is entered, always show the expression, and never the resulting value.

parameters.name: OPPOSITE_DIRECTION_CIRCULAR
parameters.type: Like OPPOSITE_DIRECTION, but with circular arrows.

parameters.name: SHOW_LABEL
parameters.type: Show a label above an enum parameter.

parameters.name: HORIZONTAL_ENUM
parameters.type: Display an enum as a horizontal list of clickable text, rather than the default select control

parameters.name: MATCH_LAST_ARRAY_ITEM
parameters.type: Inside an array parameter, set the default value on a new item to match what is set on the last item.

parameters.name: COLLAPSE_ARRAY_ITEMS
parameters.type: For an array parameter, create new items (and items in a newly opened dialog) as collapsed by default.

parameters.name: INITIAL_FOCUS_ON_EDIT
parameters.type: When an existing feature is edited, the first visible parameter with this UI hint will get focus.

parameters.name: INITIAL_FOCUS
parameters.type: When creating or editing, the first visible parameter with this UI hint will get focus (but when editing, a parameter with INITIAL_FOCUS_ON_EDIT takes precedence).

parameters.name: READ_ONLY
parameters.type: Prevent changes to the parameter from the feature dialog. A read-only parameter can be modified by the editing logic function.

parameters.name: PREVENT_CREATING_NEW_MATE_CONNECTORS
parameters.type: For a query parameter allowing BodyType.MATE_CONNECTOR, only allow preexisting mate connectors, and don't provide a button to allow creating new mate connectors specificaly for this parameter.

parameters.name: FIRST_IN_ROW
parameters.type: Guarantee that, regardless of other layout requirements, this parameter will always be the first parameter in its displayed row.

parameters.name: ALLOW_QUERY_ORDER
parameters.type: Enable reordering of queries in a query parameter.

parameters.name: PREVENT_ARRAY_REORDER
parameters.type: Disable reordering of items in an array parameter.

parameters.name: FOCUS_INNER_QUERY
parameters.type: When adding a new item to an array parameter, focus the driving inner QLV if the parameter is selection-driven, and focus the first inner QLV otherwise.

parameters.name: SHOW_TOLERANCE
parameters.type: For a boolean parameter, display as a toggle button with tolerance icon next to the previous parameter.

parameters.name: ALLOW_ARRAY_FOCUS
parameters.type: Allow focusing an array parameter with no driving or inner QLV, as if it were selection-driven.

parameters.name: SHOW_INLINE_CONFIG_INPUTS
parameters.type: Inline the configuration parameters in the configure dialog for the feature.

parameters.name: FOCUS_ON_VISIBLE
parameters.type: For a query parameter, selects it when it becomes visible during editing.

parameters.name: CAN_BE_TOLERANT
parameters.type: For a quantity parameter, specifies that the quantity can be tolerant.

parameters.name: CAN_BE_TOLERANT_DIAMETER
parameters.type: For a quantity parameter that represents a diameter, specifies that the quantity can be tolerant and should display options to specify hole or shaft fit classes.

parameters.name: PLUS_MINUS
parameters.type: Like OPPOSITE_DIRECTION but indicating whether the associated quantity is positive or negative.

parameters.name: ALWAYS_USE_DEPENDENCIES
parameters.type: Always use the content of this parameter to determine feature dependencies.

parameters.name: NO_QUERY_VARIABLE

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: The minimal or maximal distance.

parameters.name: sides
parameters.description:
An array of 2 maps, containing information about where the extremum was found for each side. Each map has a:
point (Vector) : The position in world space that is closest or farthest to the other side. The distance field is measured between the two values of point.
index (integer) : the index into the line or point array or into the query results, if a query is passed in.
parameter (number or length or array of two numbers) : If the index refers to an edge, the parameter is a number between 0 and 1 (unless extend for that side was passed in). It is in the form that evEdgeTangentLine and evEdgeCurvature consume (with arcLengthParameterization set to the same value that was passed into evDistance).
If the index refers to a point, the parameter is 0.
If the index refers to a Line, the parameter is a length representing the distance along the direction.
If the index refers to a face, the parameter is a 2D Vector in the form that evFaceTangentPlane consumes. If this face is a mesh or a plane, the parameter is a 2D Vector of zeroes.
If the index refers to a Plane, the parameter is a 2D Vector representing the lengths along the plane's x and y axes.

parameters.description: Description

If two or more adjacent profiles in the list end up being identical (in the same position with the same radius) when their final placement is determined in opHole, the identical profiles will be collapsed into a single profile, which uses the name of the first of the identical profiles.

Should be the same length as the profiles array, where faceNames[i] is the name of the face created between profiles i - 1 and i, and faceNames[0] is the name of the top cap face (the face before profile 0). If any profiles are collapsed, the names of the faces between the collapsed profiles are skipped. Supplying faceNames allows for the querying of faces by name when using qOpHoleFace.

function.name: approximateSpline
function.description: Compute a family of splines that approximates a family of ApproximationTargets to within a given tolerance. The resulting splines are consistently parameterized, so that, for example, lofting between them will match corresponding target positions. Note: If parameters are not specified, the magnitude of start and end derivatives in targets is ignored as well as the second component parallel with the first derivative.

parameters.name: degree
parameters.description: The desired degree of the curve. The output may have a different degree, if for example there aren't enough points.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: How far the output is allowed to deviate from the input. Must be at least 1e-8 meters.

parameters.name: isPeriodic
parameters.description: Whether the output spline is periodic.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: An array of ApproximationTargets. All targets must have the same number of positions and specify corresponding derivative information.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of numbers representing the parameters corresponding to the target points. Must be strictly increasing. If specified, the output spline at those parameters will match the target points. If specified, derivatives in approximation targets will not be rescaled.

parameters.name: maxControlPoints
parameters.description: OptionalThe maximum number of control points that will be returned by this function's output. Tolerance will not be satisfied if this limit is reached. Default is 10000.

parameters.name: interpolateIndices
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of indices into target positions that specifies which ones are to be interpolated exactly. This is currently supported only for non-periodic splines.

parameters.name: suppressInterpolationNotice
parameters.description: OptionalDon't report an info if the result is fully interpolated. Default is false.

parameters.name: array
parameters.type: An array of BSplineCurves, one for each target.

function.name: bSplineSurface
function.description: Returns a new BSplineSurface, adding knot padding and control point overlap as necessary.

parameters.name: uDegree
parameters.description: The degree of the spline in u.

parameters.name: vDegree
parameters.description: The degree of the spline in v.

parameters.name: isUPeriodic
parameters.description: Whether the spline periodic in u.

parameters.name: isVPeriodic
parameters.description: Whether the spline periodic in v.

parameters.name: controlPoints
parameters.description:
A matrix of control points. See BSplineSurface for specific detail. If u or v is periodic, you may provide the necessary overlap, or provide control points without any overlap. If no overlap is provided, degree overlapping control point rows or columns (corresponding to the first degree control point rows or columns) will be added. (unless you provide a set of knots that show no overlap is necessary). 
EXAMPLE
controlPointMatrix([
    [vector(-1, -1, -1) * inch, vector(-1, 0, 0) * inch, vector(-1, -2, 1) * inch],
    [vector( 0,  1, -1) * inch, vector( 0, 2, 0) * inch, vector( 0,  0, 1) * inch],
    [vector( 1, -1, -1) * inch, vector( 1, 0, 0) * inch, vector( 1, -2, 1) * inch]
])

parameters.name: weights
parameters.description: OptionalA matrix of weights. See BSplineSurface for specific detail.

parameters.name: uKnots
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of knots. See BSplineSurface for specific detail. If knots are not provided a uniform parameterization will be created such that the u parameterization exists on the range [0, 1]. For non-periodic u with n control point rows, you may provide the full set of n + degree + 1 knots, or you may provide n - degree + 1 knots, and multiplicity will by padded onto the ends (which has the effect of clamping the surface to the control points in the first and last rows). For periodic u with n unique control points (and optionally an additional degree overlapping control points), you may provide the full set of n + 2 * degree + 1 knots, or you may provide n + 1 knots, and the periodic knots will be padded onto the ends.

parameters.name: vKnots
parameters.description: OptionalSee uKnots.

function.name: draft
function.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
function.description: Feature performing an opDraft.

parameters.name: neutralPlane
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is NEUTRAL_PLANE A planar face or mate connector defining both the neutral plane and pull direction of the the draft. The intersection of the drafted faces and the neutral plane remains unchanged. The pull direction of the draft will be the face normal or mate connector z-axis.

parameters.name: draftFaces
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is NEUTRAL_PLANE The faces to draft for a NEUTRAL_PLANE draft.

parameters.name: pullDirectionEntity
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is PARTING_LINE An entity defining the pull direction of the draft. This entity should conform to the ALLOWS_DIRECTION specification in QueryFilterCompound.

parameters.name: partingEdges
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is PARTING_LINE Edges defining the parting line of the draft. These edges will remain unchanged as some adjacent faces, as defined by partingLineSides, are drafted.

parameters.name: hintFaces
parameters.description: OptionalFor Onshape internal use. For PARTING_LINE draft, specifies in advance which adjacent faces of partingEdges should be treated as more along the pull direction. When unspecified, the feature will use a geometric calculation to determine this distinction.

parameters.name: partingLineSides
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is PARTING_LINE Specifies whether to draft one or both faces adjacent to the parting edges, and whether the draft should be symmetrical if drafting both faces. See PartingLineSides.

parameters.name: alongPull
parameters.description: Required if PartingLineSides is ONE_SIDED Specifies which face will be drafted in a ONE_SIDED PARTING_LINE draft. If true, the face which is more along the pull direction from the perspective of the parting edge is drafted. If false, the face which is more away from the pull direction from the perspective of the parting edge is drafted.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description:
The draft angle, must be between 0 and 89.9 degrees. 
EXAMPLE
3 * degree

parameters.name: pullDirection
parameters.description: OptionalWhether the pull direction of the draft should be reversed. In equivalent terms, whether the draft should use -angle as the draft angle (true), or angle as the draft angle (false). Default is false.

parameters.name: secondAngle
parameters.description:
Required if PartingLineSides is TWO_SIDED The second draft angle for a TWO_SIDED PARTING_LINE draft. Must be between 0 and 89.9 degrees. Note that when using TWO_SIDED, angle will be applied to faces that are away from the pull direction, from the perspective of the edge. secondAngle will be applied to faces that are along the pull direction, from the perspective of the edge. 
EXAMPLE
3 * degree

parameters.name: secondPullDirection
parameters.description: OptionalWhether the pull direction of the draft should be reversed for the second angle of a TWO_SIDED draft. In equivalent terms, whether the draft should use -secondAngle as the second draft angle (true), or secondAngle as the second draft angle (false). Default is false.

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: OptionalFor a NEUTRAL_PLANE draft, true to propagate draft across tangent faces. Default is false.

parameters.name: referenceEdgePropagation
parameters.description: OptionalFor a PARTING_LINE draft, true to extend the parting line across connected edges of already included faces and tangent faces. Default is false.

parameters.name: reFillet
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to attempt to defillet draft faces before the draft and reapply the fillets after. Default is false.

function.name: makeWrapSurface
function.signature: (context is Context, face is Query, anchorPoint is Vector, spin is ValueWithUnits)
function.description: Make a WrapSurface for opWrap defined by a planar, cylindrical or conical face.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: A face to use as the definition face for the WrapSurface.

parameters.name: anchorPoint
parameters.description: The anchor point of the WrapSurface. See WrapSurface documentation.

parameters.name: spin
parameters.description:
For a planar face: Angle of a counter-clockwise spin to apply to the plane's x axis about its positive z axis, which is then used as the anchorDirection. For a cylindrical face: Angle of a counter-clockwise spin to apply to the cylinder's canonical anchorDirection at the given anchorPoint about the direction vector from the cylinder axis to the anchorPoint. The canonical anchorDirection at the given anchorPoint is defined as the "rightward" direction when looking at the cylinder in the direction from the anchorPoint to the cylinder axis with the cylinder's zAxis up. In other words: cross(cylinder z axis, direction vector from cylinder axis to anchorPoint). This spun direction is then used as the anchorDirection. For a conical face: Angle of a counter-clockwise spin to apply to the cone's canonical anchorDirection at the given anchorPoint about the normal at anchorPoint. The canonical anchorDirection at the given anchorPoint is defined as the "rightward" direction when looking at the cone from the normal.
See WrapSurface documentation for a description of anchorDirection.

OptionalAn array of maps that contain shape constraints at start and end profiles. Each map entry is required to have a profileIndex that refers to the affected profile. Optional fields include a vector to match surface tangent to, a magnitude, and booleans for matching tangents or curvature derived from faces adjacent to affected profile.

The direction vector for this is the negative of direction: negative values pull the end cap away from the bound entity when startDepth is positive. startOffset will only have an effect if startBound is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.

function.description: Creates a surface or solid loft fitting an ordered set of profiles, optionally constrained by guide curves.

parameters.name: profileSubqueries
parameters.description:

OptionalAn array of maps to define multiple profile alignments. Each connection map should contain:

(2) connectionEdges an array of individual queries for edges in connectionEntities. The order of individual edge queries should be synchronized with connectionEdgeParameters.
(3) connectionEdgeParameters array - an ordered and synchronized array of parameters on edges in connectionEdgeQueries 
EXAMPLE
[ {"connectionEntities" : qVertexAndEdge1, "connectionEdges" : [qEdge1], "connectionEdgeParameters" : [0.25]} {"connectionEntities" : qVertexAndEdge2, "connectionEdges" : [qEdge2], "connectionEdgeParameters" : [0.75]}]

parameters.name: trimProfiles
parameters.description: OptionalIf false (default) use full length of profiles. If true restrict resulting surface by the first and last guide or connection. Meaningful only for surface loft with open profiles.

parameters.name: derivativeInfo
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps that contain shape constraints at start and end profiles. Each map entry is required to have a profileIndex that refers to the affected profile. Optional fields include a vector to match surface tangent to, a magnitude, and booleans for matching tangents or curvature derived from faces adjacent to affected profile. 
EXAMPLE
[ { "profileIndex" : 0, "vector" : vector(1, 0, 0), "magnitude" : 2., "tangentToPlane" : true}, { "profileIndex" : 1, "matchCurvature" : true, "adjacentFaces" : qFaces } ] The first map would constrain the resulting loft at the start profile to be tangent to plane with normal vector(1,0,0) and magnitude 2. function.name: opSplitByIsocline
function.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
function.description: Split the given faces by isocline edges. Each isocline follows a path along a face with a constant angle in the (-90, 90) degree range (e.g., lines of latitude on a sphere). This angle is the face tangent plane's angle with respect to the direction with its sign determined by the dot product of direction and the face normal, and is analogous to the angle used in draft analysis. Depending on the face geometry, there may be zero, one, or multiple isoclines on each face. The isocline edges are created as new edges which split the provided faces. The resulting faces are either steep (i.e., the angle is less than the input angle) or non-steep. To instead leave the original faces intact, you can first extract the faces with opExtractSurface(), and create isoclines on the resulting surfaces. The isocline edges can be queried for with qCreatedBy. The split orientation is consistent such that the non-steep faces are always in "front" of the split, and can be reliably queried for with qSplitBy:

parameters.name: faces
parameters.description: The faces on which to imprint isoclines.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: A reference direction.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The isocline angle with respect to the direction in the (-90, 90) degree range.

function.description: Splits the faces of the given bodies into visible and invisible regions with respect to the given viewDirection, creating shadow curves as necessary. A shadow curve represents the transition of one face from visible to invisible. Depending on the geometry, there may be zero, one, or more shadow curves per face. The shadow curve edges are created as new edges which split the faces of the provided bodies. Each of the resulting faces is wholly visible or wholly invisible. Edge-on faces are considered invisible. The shadow curve edges can be queried for with qCreatedBy. The split orientation is consistent such that the visible faces are always in "front" of the split, and can be reliably queried for with qSplitBy:

parameters.name: bodies
