Context.name: Context
Context.description: A Context is a builtin that stores modeling data, including bodies (solids, sheets, wires, and points), their constituent topological entities (faces, edges, and vertices), variables, feature error states, etc.

isAtInitialMixedModelingReleaseVersionOr.name: isAtInitialMixedModelingReleaseVersionOrLater
isAtInitialMixedModelingReleaseVersionOr.description: Returns true if at or after mixed modeling release version.

Id.name: Id
Id.description: An Id identifies a feature or operation in a context. Each feature, subfeature, and operation must have a unique id. Ids are used in queries, error reporting, and accessing data associated with features.

makeId.name: makeId
makeId.description: Returns an id specified by the given string.

isTopLevelId.name: isTopLevelId
isTopLevelId.description: True if the Id represents a top-level feature or default geometry (i.e. if the Id has length 1)

ANY_ID.name: ANY_ID
ANY_ID.description: The string literal "*", which matches any id inside certain queries.

unstableIdComponent.name: unstableIdComponent
unstableIdComponent.description: Marks a given id component as "unstable" causing queries to treat it as a wildcard. This is useful for when the id component is not expected to be robust, such as an index into the results of an evaluated query.

setVariable.name: setVariable
setVariable.signature: (context is Context, name is string, value, description is string)
setVariable.description: Attach a variable with a description to the context, which can be retrieved by another feature defined later. If a variable of the same name already exists, this function will overwrite it.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Can be any value, including an array or map with many elements.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A string describing the use or purpose of the variable.

getVariable.name: getVariable
getVariable.signature: (context is Context, name is string, defaultValue)
getVariable.description: Retrieve a variable attached to the context by name. If variable by the given name is not found, returns defaultValue

libraryLanguageVersion.name: libraryLanguageVersion
libraryLanguageVersion.description: Returns the language version of the library. Note: this function calls @getLanguageVersion internally, but if you call @getLanguageVersion directly, you may get a different result. That is because @getLanguageVersion returns the language version of the module making the call (which, for a module in std will coincide with the version of std.)

opMoveCurveBoundary.name: opMoveCurveBoundary
opMoveCurveBoundary.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opMoveCurveBoundary.description: Trims or extends a wire body to an entity or by a distance.

parameters.name: wires
parameters.description: The wire bodies to modify.

parameters.name: trimTo
parameters.description: Required if moveBoundaryType is TRIM.Single entity to trim wires to.

parameters.name: endCondition
parameters.description: OptionalIf moveBoundaryType is EXTEND defines whether to extend wires by a distance of to an entity. Default is BLIND.

parameters.name: extensionDistance
parameters.description: Required if endCondition is BLINDDistance to extend wires.

parameters.name: extendTo
parameters.description: Required if endCondition is BLINDSingle entity to extend wires to.

parameters.name: extensionShape
parameters.description: OptionalSpecifies how to transition into the curve extensions. Default is SOFT.

parameters.name: helpPoint
parameters.description: Required if endCondition is BLINDSpecifies vertex used to choose a solution. If this is not provided, the closest vertex to the bounding entity will be used.

parameters.name: flipHeuristics
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, will trim or extend from the opposite end of wires. Default is false.

opBodyDraft.name: opBodyDraft
opBodyDraft.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opBodyDraft.description: Apply draft to a part by adding material. The material is added between reference edges and a parting object. These reference edges can be supplied directly, or they can be inferred from face or part queries.

parameters.name: topEdges
parameters.description: Required if selectionType is EDGESEdges to draft above parting entity.

parameters.name: bottomEdges
parameters.description: Required if selectionType is EDGES and bothSides is trueEdges to draft with angleBelow.

parameters.name: faces
parameters.description: Required if selectionType is FACESFaces to draft. This will split the face with isoclines those for the draft. Additionally, any existing edges bounding faces will be used if they mark a transition from steep faces to non-steep faces for the given pull direction and draft angle.

parameters.name: bodies
parameters.description: Required if selectionType is PARTSParts to draft. This is equivalent to supplying all faces of the part in faces.

parameters.name: excludeFaces
parameters.description: OptionalFaces of bodies to exclude from drafting.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The draft angle above the parting object.

parameters.name: bothSides
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, draft on both sides of the parting object. Default is false.

parameters.name: pullDirection
parameters.description: The pull direction.

parameters.name: draftOnSelf
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, then using the drafted part as the parting object. Default is false.

parameters.name: partingObject
parameters.description: Required if draftOnSelf is falseA surface from surfaceGeometry.fs or a query to a face or sheet body.

parameters.name: matchFacesAtParting
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, then additional material will be added to make the top and bottom of the draft align. Default is false.

parameters.name: concaveRepair
parameters.description: OptionalHow to resolve intersecting draft faces. Default is NONE.

parameters.name: concaveRepairRadius
parameters.description: Required if concaveRepair is RADIUS or MIX.The radius for intersection repair.

parameters.name: keepMaterial
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, an attempt will be made to keep the regions of the part protruding from the tapered faces. Default is false.

parameters.name: showRefs
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, then debug data will be generated to show the parting surface and draft edges.

opBoolean.name: opBoolean
opBoolean.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opBoolean.description: Performs a boolean operation on multiple solid and surface bodies.

parameters.name: tools
parameters.description: The tool bodies.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: Required if OperationType is SUBTRACTION or SUBTRACT_COMPLEMENT, or if targetsAndToolsNeedGrouping is true.The target bodies.

parameters.name: targetsAndToolsNeedGrouping
parameters.description: OptionalThis option is for adjusting the behavior to be more suitable for doing the boolean as part of a body-creating feature (such as extrude). Default is false.

parameters.name: keepTools
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the tools do not get consumed by the operation. Default is false.

parameters.name: makeSolid
parameters.description: OptionalIn case of surface union try to join surfaces into a solid. Default is false.

opBoundarySurface.name: opBoundarySurface
opBoundarySurface.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opBoundarySurface.description: Creates a boundary surface fitting two ordered sets of profiles.

parameters.name: uProfileSubqueries
parameters.description:
An ordered array of two or fewer queries for the profiles in the u direction. These can be edges or wire bodies. 
EXAMPLE
[ profileQuery1, profileQuery2 ]

parameters.name: vProfileSubqueries
parameters.description:
OptionalAn ordered array of two or fewer queries for the profiles in the v direction. These can be edges or wire bodies. 
EXAMPLE
[ profileQuery1, profileQuery2 ]

parameters.name: uDerivativeInfo
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps that contain shape constraints at start and end profiles. Each map entry is required to have a profileIndex that refers to the affected profile. Optional fields include a vector to match surface tangent to, a magnitude, and booleans for matching tangents or curvature derived from faces adjacent to affected profile. 
EXAMPLE
[ { "profileIndex" : 0, "vector" : vector(1, 0, 0), "magnitude" : 2., "tangentToPlane" : true}, { "profileIndex" : 1, "adjacentFaces" : qFaces } ] The first map would constrain the resulting boundary surface at the first u profile to be tangent to plane with normal vector(1,0,0) and magnitude 2. The second map constrains the boundary surface at the second u profile to match tangents of faces defined by the query qFaces.

parameters.name: vDerivativeInfo
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of maps analogous to uDerivativeInfo, but for v profiles.

parameters.name: showIsocurves
parameters.description: OptionalShow graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves on each face of the created boundary surface. Default false.

parameters.name: curveCount
parameters.description: OptionalWhen showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of each face's grid. Default 10.

opCreateBSplineCurve.name: opCreateBSplineCurve
opCreateBSplineCurve.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opCreateBSplineCurve.description: Generates a wire body given a BSplineCurve definition. The spline must have dimension of 3 and be G1-continuous.

parameters.name: bSplineCurve
parameters.description: The definition of the spline.

opCreateBSplineSurface.name: opCreateBSplineSurface
opCreateBSplineSurface.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opCreateBSplineSurface.description: Generates a sheet body given a BSplineSurface definition. The spline must have dimension of 3 and be G1-continuous.

parameters.name: bSplineSurface
parameters.description: The definition of the spline surface.

parameters.name: boundaryBSplineCurves
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of BSplineCurves defined in the parameter space of bSplineSurface to use as the boundary of the created sheet body. The boundary must form a single closed loop on the surface. The dimension of each curve must be 2, as the boundaries are being defined in UV space of the created surface. If no boundary is supplied, the created sheet body will cover the full parameter range of bSplineSurface.

parameters.name: makeSolid
parameters.description: OptionalWhen set to true, the operation will produce a solid instead of a sheet if the surface encloses a region. Default is false.

opCreateCompositePart.name: opCreateCompositePart
opCreateCompositePart.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)

parameters.name: bodies
parameters.description: Bodies from which to create the composite part. .

parameters.name: closed
parameters.description: OptionalA closed composite part consumes its constituent bodies, so that they are not available interactively for individual selection. Default is false.

opModifyCompositePart.name: opModifyCompositePart
opModifyCompositePart.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)

parameters.name: composite
parameters.description: Existing composite part to modify.

parameters.name: toAdd
parameters.description: Bodies to add to the composite part.

parameters.name: toRemove
parameters.description: Bodies to remove from the composite part.

opChamfer.name: opChamfer
opChamfer.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opChamfer.description: Adds a chamfer to given edges and faces.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Edges and faces to chamfer.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description:
Required if chamferType is EQUAL_OFFSETS or OFFSET_ANGLE.EXAMPLE
0.2 * inch

parameters.name: width1
parameters.description: Required if chamferType is TWO_OFFSETS.

parameters.name: width2
parameters.description: Required if chamferType is TWO_OFFSETS.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: Required if chamferType is OFFSET_ANGLE.

parameters.name: oppositeDirection
parameters.description: Required if chamferType is OFFSET_ANGLE or TWO_OFFSETS.true to reverse the two edges.

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to propagate the chamfer along edges tangent to those passed in. Defaults to false.

opConstrainedSurface.name: opConstrainedSurface
opConstrainedSurface.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opConstrainedSurface.description: Creates a constrained surface from the points.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: An array of maps containing: point (Vector) : The position of the point we want the surface to pass through. normal (Vector) (Optional) : The direction of the normal of the surface at this point.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: OptionalThe distance the surface is allowed to deviate from the given points. Default is 1e-6 meter.

parameters.name: smooth
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the surface will be optimized for smoothness. If false, it will be optimized for performance. Default is false.

parameters.name: references
parameters.description: OptionalFor Onshape internal use.

CurveOnFaceDefinition.name: CurveOnFaceDefinition
CurveOnFaceDefinition.description: Describes a set of isoparametric curves on a face.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face the curves are meant to lie on.

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: An array of distinct non-empty strings to identify the curves created.

parameters.name: nCurves
parameters.description: Required if creationType is DIR1_AUTO_SPACED_ISO or DIR2_AUTO_SPACED_ISONumber of curves.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: Required if creationType is DIR1_ISO or DIR2_ISOParameters to create curves at.

curveOnFaceDefinition.signature: (face is Query, creationType is FaceCurveCreationType, names is array, nCurves is number)

opCreateCurvesOnFace.name: opCreateCurvesOnFace
opCreateCurvesOnFace.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opCreateCurvesOnFace.description: Generates isoparametric curves of faces. That is, for each specified surface parameter value, creates a new wire body following the curve which keeps the surface parameter at that constant value.

parameters.name: curveDefinition
parameters.description: An array of CurveOnFaceDefinitions that describe group of curves per face.

parameters.name: showCurves
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to display isoparameteric curves in color in the preview.

parameters.name: skipTrim
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to skip trimming of curves by the face boundaries. Lines and arcs are always trimmed.

opDeleteBodies.name: opDeleteBodies
opDeleteBodies.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Entities to delete. Passing in entities other than bodies deletes their owning bodies.

opDeleteFace.name: opDeleteFace
opDeleteFace.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opDeleteFace.description: This is a direct editing operation that attempts to delete faces of a solid body and extend other faces to fill the hole.

parameters.name: deleteFaces
parameters.description: Faces to delete.

parameters.name: includeFillet
parameters.description: true to also delete fillets adjacent to the input faces.

parameters.name: capVoid
parameters.description: If capVoid is true and the deleted face cannot be filled by extending the surrounding faces, will attempt to replace the face with a planar face.

parameters.name: leaveOpen
parameters.description: OptionalIf leaveOpen is true the void from deleting faces is left open, potentially creating a surface out of a solid body. Default is false.

opEnclose.name: opEnclose
opEnclose.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opEnclose.description: Takes in a set of bodies and faces and creates solid bodies for the enclosed regions.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Bodies and faces for enclosure.

opDraft.name: opDraft
opDraft.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opDraft.description: Applies a given draft angle to faces.

parameters.name: draftFaces
parameters.description: Required if draftType is REFERENCE_SURFACE The faces to draft for a REFERENCE_SURFACE draft.

parameters.name: referenceSurface
parameters.description: Required if draftType is REFERENCE_SURFACE A face or plane that defines the neutral surface for a REFERENCE_SURFACE draft. draftFaces will remain unchanged where they intersect referenceSurface. Can be either a Query or a Plane.

parameters.name: referenceEntityDraftOptions
parameters.description: Required if draftType is REFERENCE_ENTITY An array of maps of the form ("face", "references", "angle"). "face" should be a Query for exactly one face. "references" should be a Query for at least one edge attached to the face. The "face" will be drafted while the geometry of the "references" remains unchanged. "angle" is an optional ValueWithUnits parameter between -89.9 and 89.9 degrees which overrides the default angle parameter.

parameters.name: pullVec
parameters.description:
The 3d direction relative to which the draft is applied. 
EXAMPLE
vector(0, 0, 1) .

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description:
The draft angle, must be between 0 and 89.9 degrees. 
EXAMPLE
3 * degree

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: OptionalFor a REFERENCE_SURFACE draft, true to propagate draft across tangent faces. Default is false.

parameters.name: referenceEntityPropagation
parameters.description: OptionalFor a REFERENCE_ENTITY draft, true to collect new reference entities and faces by pulling in edges connected to the specified reference edges. Connected edges on the same face or on tangent connected faces will be pulled in. Default is false.

parameters.name: reFillet
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to attempt to defillet draft faces before the draft and reapply the fillets after. Default is false.

opExtractWires.name: opExtractWires
opExtractWires.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opExtractWires.description: Generates wire bodies from the supplied edges. If the edges are disjoint multiple wires will be returned. If the edges overlap or cross, or more than two meet at a point, the function will fail.

parameters.name: edges
parameters.description: The edges to be extracted.

opExtrude.name: opExtrude
opExtrude.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opExtrude.description: Extrudes one or more edges or faces in a given direction with one or two end conditions. Faces get extruded into solid bodies and edges get extruded into sheet bodies.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Edges and faces to extrude.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
The 3d direction in which to extrude. 
EXAMPLE
evOwnerSketchPlane(context, {"entity" : entities}).normal to extrude perpendicular to the owner sketch EXAMPLE
evPlane(context, {"face" : entities}).normal to extrude perpendicular to the first planar entity

parameters.name: endBound
parameters.description:
The type of bound at the end of the extrusion. Cannot be SYMMETRIC or UP_TO_VERTEX. 
EXAMPLE
BoundingType.BLIND

parameters.name: endDepth
parameters.description:
Required if endBound is BLIND.How far from the entities to extrude. 
EXAMPLE
1 * inch

parameters.name: endBoundEntity
parameters.description: Required if endBound is UP_TO_SURFACE or UP_TO_BODY.The face or body that provides the bound.

parameters.name: endTranslationalOffset
parameters.description: OptionalThe translational offset between the extrude end cap and the end bound entity. The direction vector for this is the same as direction: negative values pull the end cap away from the bound entity when endDepth is positive. endOffset will only have an effect if endBound is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.

parameters.name: startBound
parameters.description: OptionalThe type of start bound. Default is for the extrude to start at entities. Cannot be SYMMETRIC or UP_TO_VERTEX.

parameters.name: isStartBoundOpposite
parameters.description: Required if is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.Whether the startBound extends in the opposite direction from the profile as the endBound. Defaults to true if not supplied.

parameters.name: startDepth
parameters.description: Required if startBound is BLIND.How far from the entities to start the extrude. The direction vector for this is the negative of direction: positive values make the extrusion longer when endDepth is positive.

parameters.name: startBoundEntity
parameters.description: Required if startBound is UP_TO_SURFACE or UP_TO_BODY.The face or body that provides the bound.

parameters.name: startTranslationalOffset
parameters.description: OptionalThe translational offset between the extrude start cap and the start bound entity. The direction vector for this is the negative of direction: negative values pull the end cap away from the bound entity when startDepth is positive. startOffset will only have an effect if startBound is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.

opFaceBlend.name: opFaceBlend
opFaceBlend.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opFaceBlend.description: Performs a face blend between two walls of faces.

parameters.name: side1
parameters.description: First set of faces, must belong to the same body.

parameters.name: side2
parameters.description: Second set of faces, must belong to the same body.

parameters.name: flipSide1Normal
parameters.description: Wether to flip side 1's normal.

parameters.name: flipSide2Normal
parameters.description: Wether to flip side 2's normal.

parameters.name: propagation
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to propagate the blend.

parameters.name: propagationAngle
parameters.description: OptionalMaximum angle between faces for propagation. Used if propagationType is FaceBlendPropagation.CUSTOM. Default is 0 * radian.

parameters.name: crossSection
parameters.description: The cross section type of the blend.

parameters.name: spine
parameters.description: Required if crossSection is DISC.The spine of the blend. The blend's cross section will be orthogonal to the spine.

parameters.name: crossSectionShape
parameters.description: What shape the cross section of the blend will be.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Required if blendControlType is RADIUS.The radius of the cross section.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Required if blendControlType is WIDTH.The width of the blend.

parameters.name: asymmetric
parameters.description: OptionalWether the radius or width is the same on each wall.

parameters.name: secondRadius
parameters.description: Required if blendControlType is RADIUS and asymmetric is true.The radius of the cross section from side 2.

parameters.name: widthRatio
parameters.description: Required if blendControlType is WIDTH and asymmetric is true.How the blend will be divided between the walls. If widthRatio < 1, it will be wider towards side 1. If widthRatio > 1, it will be wider towards side 2.

parameters.name: rho
parameters.description: Required if crossSectionShape is CONICParameter of the conic cross section shape.

parameters.name: magnitude
parameters.description: Required if crossSectionShape is CURVATUREParameter of the curvature cross section shape.

parameters.name: tangentHoldLines
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of tangentEdges and inverseTangentEdges.

parameters.name: tangentEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as tangent hold lines.

parameters.name: inverseTangentEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as inverse tangent hold lines.

parameters.name: conicHoldLines
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of conicEdges and inverseConicEdges.

parameters.name: conicEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as conic hold lines.

parameters.name: inverseConicEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as inverse conic hold lines.

parameters.name: hasCliffEdges
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of cliffEdges.

parameters.name: cliffEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges to use as cliff edges.

parameters.name: hasCaps
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of caps.

parameters.name: caps
parameters.description: OptionalEntities and flip flags to use as caps. Each map should contain an entity Query element and a flip boolean element.

parameters.name: hasLimits
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of limitPlane1, limitPlane2, faceLimits and edgeLimit.

parameters.name: limitPlane1
parameters.description: OptionalFirst plane to limit the blend.

parameters.name: limitPlane1Flip
parameters.description: Whether to flip the first plane normal. Defines which side of the plane the blend will be.

parameters.name: limitPlane2
parameters.description: OptionalSecond plane to limit the blend.

parameters.name: limitPlane2Flip
parameters.description: Whether to flip the first plane normal. Defines which side of the plane the blend will be.

parameters.name: faceLimits
parameters.description: OptionalFaces to use as limits to the blend.

parameters.name: edgeLimit
parameters.description: OptionalEdges and adjacent faces to use as limits. Each map should contain an edge Query element and an edgeLimitSide query element.

parameters.name: hasHelpPoint
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to use the content of helpPoint.

parameters.name: helpPoint
parameters.description: OptionalVertex or mate connector to use as help point. In case the blend parameters create several blends, only the blend closest to the help point will be kept.

parameters.name: trim
parameters.description: OptionalHow to trim the blend.

parameters.name: detach
parameters.description: OptionalWhether not to attach the blend(s) to the sides, creating new sheet bodies.

parameters.name: showIsocurves
parameters.description: OptionalShow graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves of the created surface. Default false.

parameters.name: curveCount
parameters.description: OptionalWhen showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of the grid. Default 10.

opFillet.name: opFillet
opFillet.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opFillet.description: For edges, performs a fillet on the edge. For faces, performs a fillet on all edges adjacent to the face.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Edges and faces to fillet.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description:
The fillet radius. 
EXAMPLE
1 * inch

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to propagate the fillet along edges tangent to those passed in. Default is false.

parameters.name: crossSection
parameters.description: OptionalFillet cross section. One of CIRCULAR, CONIC, CURVATURE. Default is CIRCULAR.

parameters.name: rho
parameters.description:
Required if crossSection is CONIC.A number between 0 and 1, specifying the Rho value of a conic fillet 
EXAMPLE
0.01 creates a flat, nearly-chamfered shape. EXAMPLE
0.99 creates a pointed, nearly-unchanged shape.

parameters.name: magnitude
parameters.description: Required if crossSection is CURVATURE.A number between 0 and 1, specifying the magnitude of curvature match.

parameters.name: partialFilletBounds
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps representing the boundaries of a partial fillet. Each map should contain a boundaryEdge query, a boundaryParameter value, a isFlipped boolean 
EXAMPLE
[{ "boundaryEdge" : edgeQuery0, "boundaryParameter" : 0.3, "isFlipped" : false }, { "boundaryEdge" : edgeQuery1, "boundaryParameter" : 0.6, "isFlipped" : true }]

parameters.name: isVariable
parameters.description: OptionalFillet controls can be varied at vertices via vertexSettings. Default is false.

parameters.name: vertexSettings
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps representing fillet settings at specified vertices. Each map should contain a vertex query, a vertexRadius value, a variableMagnitude if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CURVATURE, and a variableRho if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CONIC. 
EXAMPLE
[{ "vertex" : vertexQuery0, "vertexRadius" : 1 * inch, "variableRho" : 0.2 }, { "vertex" : vertexQuery1, "vertexRadius" : 2 * inch, "variableRho" : 0.8 }]

parameters.name: pointOnEdgeSettings
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps representing fillet settings at specified points on edges. Each map should contain an edge query, an edgeParameter value, a pointOnEdgeRadius value, a pointOnEdgeVariablMagnitude if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CURVATURE, and a pointOnEdgeVariableRho if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CONIC. 
EXAMPLE
[{ "edge" : edgeQuery0, "edgeParameter" : 0.3, "pointOnEdgeRadius" : 1 * inch }, { "edge" : edgeQuery1, "edgeParameter" : 0.6, "pointOnEdgeRadius" : 2 * inch }]

parameters.name: smoothTransition
parameters.description: Required if isVariable is true Whether to create a smoother transition between each vertex.

parameters.name: allowEdgeOverflow
parameters.description: OptionalAllow opFillet to modify nearby edges to maintain the fillet profile. Default is true.

parameters.name: keepEdges
parameters.description: OptionalEdges you do not want opFillet to modify if allowEdgeOverflow is true.

parameters.name: smoothCorners
parameters.description: OptionalAllow opFillet to smooth all suitable corners and prevent creation of sharp edges. Default is false.

parameters.name: smoothCornerExceptions
parameters.description: OptionalVertices you do not want opFillet to smooth if smoothCorners is true.

parameters.name: createDetachedSurface
parameters.description: OptionalOperation does not modify the body of the selected edges, but results in surface geometry of fillet. Default is false.

opFillSurface.name: opFillSurface
opFillSurface.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opFillSurface.description: Generates a surface body from supplied boundary and internal constraints. The boundaries are defined as edge queries for each continuity constraint. The internal constraints may be defined as a set of support vertices.

parameters.name: edgesG0
parameters.description: The edges with position constraints.

parameters.name: edgesG1
parameters.description: The edges with tangency constraints.

parameters.name: edgesG2
parameters.description: The edges with curvature constraints.

parameters.name: guideVertices
parameters.description: The vertices the resulting surface is expected to interpolate.

parameters.name: showIsocurves
parameters.description: OptionalShow graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves of the created surface. Default false.

parameters.name: curveCount
parameters.description: OptionalWhen showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of the grid. Default 10.

opFitSpline.name: opFitSpline
opFitSpline.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opFitSpline.description: Creates a 3D cubic spline curve through an array of 3D points.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description:
An array of Vectors with length units for the spline to interpolate. If the first point is the same as the last point, the spline is closed. 
EXAMPLE
[
    vector( 1,  1,  1) * inch,
    vector(-1,  1, -1) * inch,
    vector( 1, -1, -1) * inch,
    vector(-1, -1,  1) * inch,
    vector( 1,  1,  1) * inch
]

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of doubles, parameters corresponding to the points.

parameters.name: startDerivative
parameters.description: OptionalA Vector with length units that specifies the derivative at the start of the resulting spline (according to the arcLengthParameterization set to false).

parameters.name: endDerivative
parameters.description: OptionalA Vector with length units that specifies the derivative at the end of the resulting spline. Ignored if spline is closed.

parameters.name: start2ndDerivative
parameters.description: OptionalA Vector with length units that specifies the second derivative at the start of the resulting spline. Ignored if spline is closed, or if startDerivative is not defined

parameters.name: end2ndDerivative
parameters.description: OptionalA Vector with length units that specifies the second derivative at the end of the resulting spline. Ignored if spline is closed, or if endDerivative is not defined

parameters.name: derivatives
parameters.description: OptionalA map of derivatives at non-end points. Entries should be index : derivative, where index is an integer between 1 and size(points) - 2 and derivative is a Vector that specifies the derivative at points[index].

opFlipOrientation.description: Reverses the orientation of sheet bodies.

opFullRoundFillet.description: Creates a full round fillet, replacing the center face(s) with circular profile face(s) of varying radius, joining the selected side faces.

parameters.name: side2Face

parameters.name: centerFaces
parameters.description: The face(s) to be replaced.

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to propagate the fillet across side face tangencies. Default is true.

opHelix.name: opHelix
opHelix.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opHelix.description: Creates a helical and possibly spiral curve.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
The direction of the helix axis. 
EXAMPLE
vector(0, 0, 1)

parameters.name: axisStart
parameters.description:
A point on the helix axis. 
EXAMPLE
vector(0, 0, 0) * inch

parameters.name: startPoint
parameters.description:
The start point of the infinite helix. Must be off the axis. This is the point at which the created curve would actually start if the first number of interval is 0. 
EXAMPLE
vector(1, 0, 0) * inch

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description:
An array of two numbers denoting the interval of the helix in terms of revolution counts. 
EXAMPLE
[0, 10] will create a curve with 10 revolutions.

parameters.name: clockwise
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
true if this is a clockwise helix when viewed along direction.

parameters.name: helicalPitch
parameters.description:
Distance along the axis between successive revolutions. 
EXAMPLE
0.1 * inch will create a helix with 10 revolutions per inch. EXAMPLE
0 * inch produces a planar Archimedean spiral.

parameters.name: spiralPitch
parameters.description:
Change in radius between successive revolutions. 
EXAMPLE
0 * inch produces a helix that lies on a cylinder.

opHole.name: opHole
opHole.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opHole.description: Creates hole tools referencing a set of targets, optionally subtracting the tools from the targets. If some tools cannot be built, the operation will still succeed and indicate in its return value which holes failed to build. If no tools can be built, the operation will fail.

parameters.name: holeDefinition
parameters.description:
The definition of the shape of the desired holes. 
EXAMPLE
holeDefinition([holeProfile(HolePositionReference.AXIS_POINT, 0 * inch, 0.1 * inch), holeProfile(HolePositionReference.AXIS_POINT, 1 * inch, 0 * inch)])

parameters.name: axes
parameters.description:
An array of Lines each of whose origin represents the start position of a hole, and whose direction represents the drill direction of the hole. 
EXAMPLE
[line(vector(-1, -1, 0) * inch, vector(0, 0, -1)), line(vector(1, 1, 0) * inch, vector(0, 0, -1))]

parameters.name: identities
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of queries, one per axis in axes, used to disambiguate each of the created holes. Each query should resolve to exactly one entity. Providing this information does not change the geometric outcome, but stabilizes references to the holes with respect to upstream changes to the model.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: Required if holeDefinition contains any profiles that do not reference HolePositionReference.AXIS_POINT, or if subtractFromTargets is true A set of bodies to target. The shape of the produced holes is dependent on the shape of these targets (as specified in the supplied HoleDefinition), so the full set of targeted bodies should always be supplied, even if subtractFromTargets is false.

parameters.name: subtractFromTargets
parameters.description: Optionaltrue if the hole geometry should be subtracted from the targets. false if the targets should not be modified, and the hole tools should be outputted as new solid bodies. Default is true. To subtract from a subset of targets, set this to true and supply a set of excluded targets as targetsToExcludeFromSubtraction. Removing the set of excluded targets from targets instead of using targetsToExcludeFromSubtraction is not the correct way to call this interface, and may result in the shape of the hole changing.

parameters.name: targetsToExcludeFromSubtraction
parameters.description: OptionalIf supplied and subtractFromTargets is true, the given targets are excluded from the subtraction. Ignored if subtractFromTargets is false

parameters.name: keepTools
parameters.description: OptionalIf subtractFromTargets is true, controls whether the hole tools should be outputted as new solid bodies. Default is false. Ignored if subtractFromTargets is false; in that case hole tools are always outputted as new solid bodies.

parameters.name: array

parameters.name: yAxisIsUp

parameters.name: isModifiable

opCreateIsocline.name: opCreateIsocline
opCreateIsocline.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opCreateIsocline.description: Creates wires corresponding to the given faces's isocline edges. Each isocline follows a path along a face with a constant angle in the (-90, 90) degree range (e.g., lines of latitude on a sphere). This angle is the face tangent plane's angle with respect to the direction with its sign determined by the dot product of direction and the face normal, and is analogous to the angle used in draft analysis. Depending on the face geometry, there may be zero, one, or multiple isoclines on each face.

parameters.name: faces
parameters.description: The faces on which to imprint isoclines.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: A reference direction.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The isocline angle with respect to the direction in the (-90, 90) degree range.

opLoft.name: opLoft
opLoft.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opLoft.description: Creates a surface or solid loft fitting an ordered set of profiles, optionally constrained by guide curves.

parameters.name: profileSubqueries
parameters.description:
An ordered array of queries for the profiles. For a solid loft, these must be sheet bodies, faces, or vertices. For a surface loft, these could be wire bodies, sheet bodies, faces, edges, or vertices. 
EXAMPLE
[ profileQuery1, profileQuery2 ]

parameters.name: guideSubqueries
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of queries for guide curves. Each guide curve should intersect each profile once.

parameters.name: connections
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps to define multiple profile alignments. Each connection map should contain:
(1) connectionEntities query describing an array of vertices or edges (one per profile),
(2) connectionEdges an array of individual queries for edges in connectionEntities. The order of individual edge queries should be synchronized with connectionEdgeParameters.
(3) connectionEdgeParameters array - an ordered and synchronized array of parameters on edges in connectionEdgeQueries 
EXAMPLE
[ {"connectionEntities" : qVertexAndEdge1, "connectionEdges" : [qEdge1], "connectionEdgeParameters" : [0.25]} {"connectionEntities" : qVertexAndEdge2, "connectionEdges" : [qEdge2], "connectionEdgeParameters" : [0.75]}]

parameters.name: makePeriodic
parameters.description: OptionalDefaults to false. A closed guide creates a periodic loft regardless of this option.

parameters.name: trimGuidesByProfiles
parameters.description: OptionalIf false (default) use full length of guides. If true restrict resulting surface by the first and last profile. Meaningful only for non-periodic surface loft.

parameters.name: trimProfiles
parameters.description: OptionalIf false (default) use full length of profiles. If true restrict resulting surface by the first and last guide or connection. Meaningful only for surface loft with open profiles.

parameters.name: derivativeInfo
parameters.description:
OptionalAn array of maps that contain shape constraints at start and end profiles. Each map entry is required to have a profileIndex that refers to the affected profile. Optional fields include a vector to match surface tangent to, a magnitude, and booleans for matching tangents or curvature derived from faces adjacent to affected profile. 
EXAMPLE
[ { "profileIndex" : 0, "vector" : vector(1, 0, 0), "magnitude" : 2., "tangentToPlane" : true}, { "profileIndex" : 1, "matchCurvature" : true, "adjacentFaces" : qFaces } ] The first map would constrain the resulting loft at the start profile to be tangent to plane with normal vector(1,0,0) and magnitude 2. The second map constrains the loft at the end profile to match the curvature of faces defined by the query qFaces.

parameters.name: showIsocurves
parameters.description: OptionalShow graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves on each face of the created loft. Default false.

parameters.name: curveCount
parameters.description: OptionalWhen showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of each face's grid. Default 10.

parameters.name: loftTopology
parameters.description: OptionalSpecifies topology of lofted body. Default is MINIMAL.

parameters.name: addSections
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to add a path. Default is false.

parameters.name: spine
parameters.description: OptionalQuery to specify the edge for the path.

parameters.name: sectionCount
parameters.description: OptionalNumber of sections to add. Required if addSections=true.

opMateConnector.name: opMateConnector
opMateConnector.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)

opSplitByIsocline.name: opSplitByIsocline
opSplitByIsocline.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opSplitByIsocline.description: Split the given faces by isocline edges. Each isocline follows a path along a face with a constant angle in the (-90, 90) degree range (e.g., lines of latitude on a sphere). This angle is the face tangent plane's angle with respect to the direction with its sign determined by the dot product of direction and the face normal, and is analogous to the angle used in draft analysis. Depending on the face geometry, there may be zero, one, or multiple isoclines on each face. The isocline edges are created as new edges which split the provided faces. The resulting faces are either steep (i.e., the angle is less than the input angle) or non-steep. To instead leave the original faces intact, you can first extract the faces with opExtractSurface(), and create isoclines on the resulting surfaces. The isocline edges can be queried for with qCreatedBy. The split orientation is consistent such that the non-steep faces are always in "front" of the split, and can be reliably queried for with qSplitBy:

parameters.name: faces
parameters.description: The faces on which to imprint isoclines.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: A reference direction.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The isocline angle with respect to the direction in the (-90, 90) degree range.

SplitBySelfShadowResult.name: SplitBySelfShadowResult
SplitBySelfShadowResult.description: Map containing the results of splitting bodies by their shadow curves. Some faces may have been split, others may have been left intact.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: invisibleFaces

opSplitBySelfShadow.name: opSplitBySelfShadow
opSplitBySelfShadow.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opSplitBySelfShadow.description: Splits the faces of the given bodies into visible and invisible regions with respect to the given viewDirection, creating shadow curves as necessary. A shadow curve represents the transition of one face from visible to invisible. Depending on the geometry, there may be zero, one, or more shadow curves per face. The shadow curve edges are created as new edges which split the faces of the provided bodies. Each of the resulting faces is wholly visible or wholly invisible. Edge-on faces are considered invisible. The shadow curve edges can be queried for with qCreatedBy. The split orientation is consistent such that the visible faces are always in "front" of the split, and can be reliably queried for with qSplitBy:

parameters.name: bodies
parameters.description: The bodies which cast shadows and on which to imprint shadow curves.

parameters.name: viewDirection
parameters.description: The viewing direction.

opWrap.name: opWrap
opWrap.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
opWrap.description: Wraps or unwraps faces from one surface onto another. The location and orientation of the wrapped faces on the destination surface are controlled by the anchorPoint and anchorDirection of the source and destination WrapSurfaces. The entities of the operation are not affected, the result of this operation is a new set of surface bodies or imprinted edges representing the wrapped or unwrapped faces. Faces that are topologically connected will remain topologically connected in the result body for WrapType.SIMPLE and WrapType.TRIM. This operation currently supports wrapping from a plane onto a cylinder or a cone, and unwrapping from a cylinder or a cone onto a plane.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Faces to wrap from source to destination.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The surface to wrap from. All entities must lie on this surface.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: The surface to wrap onto. Must be defined using the face field for WrapType.TRIM or WrapType.IMPRINT.

parameters.name: orientWithDestination
parameters.description: OptionalIf true (default), the normals of the resulting surface will point in the same direction as the destination. If false, the normals of the resulting surface will point in the opposite direction. For the purpose of this parameter, the normals of a WrapSurface defined by an infinite Cylinder are always pointing outwards.

qAllNonMeshSolidBodies.description: A query for all solid bodies that do not have mesh geometry.

qAllSolidBodies.name: qAllSolidBodies
qAllSolidBodies.description: A query for all solid bodies.

qAllModifiableSolidBodiesNoMesh.name: qAllModifiableSolidBodiesNoMesh
qAllModifiableSolidBodiesNoMesh.description: A query for all solid bodies that do not have mesh geometry or in context geometry, i.e. every non-mesh-containing part displayed in the Part Studio's "Parts" list.

qAllModifiableSolidBodies.name: qAllModifiableSolidBodies
qAllModifiableSolidBodies.description: A query for all modifiable solid bodies, including mesh-containing bodies.

qNthElement.name: qNthElement
qNthElement.description: A query for one entity in queryToFilter at a specified index. The order of entities resolved by a query is deterministic but arbitrary.

parameters.name: queryToFilter
parameters.description: A query which resolves to at least n+1 entities

parameters.name: n
parameters.description:
Zero-based index of entity in queryToFilter. 
EXAMPLE
0 indicates the first entity EXAMPLE
-1 indicates the last entity

qEntityFilter.name: qEntityFilter
qEntityFilter.description: A query for entities in a queryToFilter which match a given EntityType.

qHasAttribute.name: qHasAttribute
qHasAttribute.description: Query for all entities in queryToFilter marked with an attribute with name name

qHasAttributeWithValue.name: qHasAttributeWithValue
qHasAttributeWithValue.signature: (queryToFilter is Query, name is string, value)
qHasAttributeWithValue.description: Query for all entities in queryToFilter marked with an attribute with name name and value exactly equal to value

qHasAttributeWithValueMatching.name: qHasAttributeWithValueMatching
qHasAttributeWithValueMatching.signature: (queryToFilter is Query, name is string, attributePattern is map)
qHasAttributeWithValueMatching.description: Query for all entities in queryToFilter marked with an attribute with name name and a map value matching every key-value pair in the provided attributePattern map.

parameters.name: attributePattern

qAttributeFilter.name: qAttributeFilter
qAttributeFilter.description: Note: This query is used only for legacy unnamed attributes, which are still supported but no longer reccommended. See the Attributes module for details.

parameters.name: attributePattern
parameters.description:
Will only resolve to queries whose legacy unnamed attributes match the type (and possibly the values) of this pattern.
If attributePattern has a type tag, will only match attributes with that same type tag. 
EXAMPLE
{} as MyCustomType will match all attributes with type tag MyCustomTypeIf the attribute has no type tag (i.e. it is a standard type like string or map), will match all attributes with that same standard type. 
EXAMPLE
"asdf" will match all string attributes. EXAMPLE
{} will match all map attributes.If the attribute is a map, will only match maps which have identical values for every key-value pair in the pattern 
EXAMPLE
{ "odd" : true } matches all unnamed map attributes that have a field "odd" whose value is true. EXAMPLE
{ "odd" : true } as MyCustomType matches all unnamed map attributes with the that have a field "odd" whose value is true.

qAttributeQuery.name: qAttributeQuery
qAttributeQuery.description: Note: This query is used only for legacy unnamed attributes, which are still supported but no longer reccommended. See the Attributes module for details.

qCreatedBy.name: qCreatedBy
qCreatedBy.description: A query for all the entities created by a feature or operation. The feature is given by its feature id, which was passed into the the operation function in order to create the feature.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description:
The Id of the specified feature. 
EXAMPLE
id + "extrude1"

qCapEntity.name: qCapEntity
qCapEntity.signature: (featureId is Id, capType is CapType, entityType is EntityType)
qCapEntity.description: A query for start/end cap vertex, edge, and face entities created by featureId. Cap entities are produced by extrude, revolve, sweep, loft and thicken features

qNonCapEntity.name: qNonCapEntity
qNonCapEntity.description: A query for vertex, edge, and face entities created by featureId that are not cap entities. Cap entities are produced by extrude, revolve, sweep, loft and thicken features

qOpHoleProfile.name: qOpHoleProfile
qOpHoleProfile.description: A query for the profile edges or vertices created by an opHole operation.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description:
The Id of the specified operation. 
EXAMPLE
id + "hole1"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: OptionalFilter the query for profiles with a given name. See name field of HoleProfile.

parameters.name: identity
parameters.description: OptionalFilter the query for the hole associated with the given identity entity. See identities parameter of opHole.

qOpHoleFace.name: qOpHoleFace
qOpHoleFace.description: A query for the hole faces created by an opHole operation.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description:
The Id of the specified operation. 
EXAMPLE
id + "hole1"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: OptionalFilter the query for faces with a given name. See faceNames field of HoleDefinition.

parameters.name: identity
parameters.description: OptionalFilter the query for the hole associated with the given identity entity. See identities parameter of opHole.

qUnion.name: qUnion
qUnion.signature: (query1 is Query, query2 is Query, query3 is Query, query4 is Query)

qSubtraction.name: qSubtraction
qSubtraction.description: A query for entities which match query1, but do not match query2. qSubtraction preserves the order of query1.

qSymmetricDifference.name: qSymmetricDifference
qSymmetricDifference.description: A query for entities which match either query1 or query2, but not both.

qOwnedByBody.name: qOwnedByBody
qOwnedByBody.description: A query for all of the entities (faces, vertices, edges, and bodies) in a context which belong to a specified body or bodies.

qOwnerBody.name: qOwnerBody
qOwnerBody.description: A query for each body that any of the given entities belong to.

qContainedInCompositeParts.name: qContainedInCompositeParts
qContainedInCompositeParts.description: A query for each part contained in compositeParts.

qCompositePartsContaining.name: qCompositePartsContaining
qCompositePartsContaining.description: A query for each composite part of the given type containing bodies.

qFlattenedCompositeParts.name: qFlattenedCompositeParts
qFlattenedCompositeParts.description: A query for non-composite entities in entities and constituents of composite parts in entities.

qConsumed.name: qConsumed
qConsumed.description: A query for all entities in queryToFilter which are consumed by any closed composite part, or all entities of queryToFilter which are not consumed by any closed composite part.

qCompositePartTypeFilter.name: qCompositePartTypeFilter
qCompositePartTypeFilter.description: A query for all bodies in queryToFilter which are either open or closed composite parts, depending on the second parameter.

qSourceMesh.name: qSourceMesh
qSourceMesh.description: A query for each mesh element that any selectedMeshVertices belong to. selectedMeshVertices should be the point bodies created when a user selects a mesh vertex. Mesh vertices which have not been selected cannot be queried in FeatureScript

parameters.name: selectedMeshVertices
parameters.description: One or more mesh vertices whose owning elements are queried.

qAdjacent.name: qAdjacent
qAdjacent.signature: (seed is Query, adjacencyType is AdjacencyType, entityType is EntityType)
qAdjacent.description: A query for entities that are adjacent to the given seed entities.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: One or more entities whose adjacent neighbors are queried. The result does not include the original seed entities (unless they are adjacent to other seed entities)

qEdgeTopologyFilter.name: qEdgeTopologyFilter
qEdgeTopologyFilter.description: A query for edges in a queryToFilter which match a given EdgeTopology.

qEdgeVertex.name: qEdgeVertex
qEdgeVertex.description: A query for the start or end vertices of edges.

qGeometry.name: qGeometry
qGeometry.description: A query for all entities in queryToFilter with a specified GeometryType.

qBodyType.name: qBodyType
qBodyType.description: A query for all entities in queryToFilter which are bodies of the a specified BodyType, or are owned by bodies with the specified BodyType

qConstructionFilter.name: qConstructionFilter
qConstructionFilter.description: A query for all construction entities or all non-construction entities in queryToFilter.

qActiveSheetMetalFilter.name: qActiveSheetMetalFilter
qActiveSheetMetalFilter.description: A query for all entities in queryToFilter belonging to an active sheet metal part.

qSheetMetalFlatFilter.name: qSheetMetalFlatFilter
qSheetMetalFlatFilter.description: A query for all entities in queryToFilter belonging to a flattened sheet metal part.

qSheetMetalFormFilter.name: qSheetMetalFormFilter
qSheetMetalFormFilter.description: A query for all entities in queryToFilter that are artifacts of a sheet metal form feature on flat pattern.

qPartsAttachedTo.name: qPartsAttachedTo
qPartsAttachedTo.description: A query for parts to which sheetMetalEntities are attached (e.g. sheet metal bend line entities are attached to a flattened sheet metal part)

qCorrespondingInFlat.name: qCorrespondingInFlat
qCorrespondingInFlat.description: A query for entities in sheet metal flattened body corresponding to any entitiesInFolded which are part of 3D sheet metal bodies

qSMDefinitionEntityFilter.name: qSMDefinitionEntityFilter
qSMDefinitionEntityFilter.description: A query for sheet metal definition entities in a queryToFilter which match a given EntityType.

qMeshGeometryFilter.name: qMeshGeometryFilter
qMeshGeometryFilter.description: A query for all mesh entities or all non-mesh entities in queryToFilter.

qModifiableEntityFilter.name: qModifiableEntityFilter
qModifiableEntityFilter.description: A query for all modifiable entities in queryToFilter.

qSketchFilter.name: qSketchFilter
qSketchFilter.description: A query for all sketch entities, or all non-sketch entities in queryToFilter.

qParallelPlanes.name: qParallelPlanes
qParallelPlanes.signature: (queryToFilter is Query, normal is Vector, allowAntiparallel is boolean)
qParallelPlanes.description: A query for all planar face entities in queryToFilter that are parallel to a plane specified by the normal vector.

parameters.name: normal
parameters.description: The normal vector to reference when checking for parallelism.

parameters.name: allowAntiparallel
parameters.description: Whether to also return entities that are antiparallel.

qPlanesParallelToDirection.name: qPlanesParallelToDirection
qPlanesParallelToDirection.description: A query for all planar faces in queryToFilter that are parallel to the given direction vector (i.e., the plane normal is perpendicular to direction).

qFacesParallelToDirection.name: qFacesParallelToDirection
qFacesParallelToDirection.description: A query for all faces in queryToFilter that are parallel to the given direction vector e.g. if it is a planar face, the plane normal is perpendicular to direction if it is a cylindrical face, the axis is parallel to direction if it is an extruded face, the extrude direction is parallel to direction

qConvexConnectedFaces.name: qConvexConnectedFaces
qConvexConnectedFaces.description: A query for a set of faces connected to seed via convex edges, flood-filling across any number of convex edges.

qConcaveConnectedFaces.name: qConcaveConnectedFaces
qConcaveConnectedFaces.description: A query for a set of faces connected to seed via concave edges, flood-filling across any number of concave edges.

qTangentConnectedFaces.name: qTangentConnectedFaces
qTangentConnectedFaces.description: A query for a set of faces connected to seed via tangent edges, flood-filling across any number of tangent edges.

qTangentConnectedEdges.name: qTangentConnectedEdges
qTangentConnectedEdges.description: A query for a chain of tangent edges connected to seed via tangent vertices, chaining across any number of tangent vertices.

qLoopEdges.name: qLoopEdges
qLoopEdges.description: A query for a set of edges defining a loop. If the seed has laminar edges, this query will extend to include all laminar loops that contain any seed edges. If the seed has faces, the result will include the loops forming the outer boundary of the joined faces.

qParallelEdges.name: qParallelEdges
qParallelEdges.description: A query to find all linear edges in queryToFilter which are parallel (or anti-parallel) to any linear edge in edges.

qLoopBoundedFaces.name: qLoopBoundedFaces
qLoopBoundedFaces.description: Given a face and an edge, query for all faces bounded by the given face, on the side of the given edge.

parameters.name: faceAndEdge
parameters.description: Should match a face and an edge. If multiple faces and edges match, used the first face and the first edge.

qFaceOrEdgeBoundedFaces.name: qFaceOrEdgeBoundedFaces
qFaceOrEdgeBoundedFaces.description: Given a seed face and bounding entities, matches all adjacent faces inside the bounding entities, expanding from the seed face.

parameters.name: faceAndBoundingEntities
parameters.description: A Query for the seed face, followed by any boundary faces or edges. The seed face must be first, so a qUnion should be used to guarantee the order.

qHoleFaces.name: qHoleFaces
qHoleFaces.description: Given a single face inside a hole or hole-like geometry, returns all faces of that hole.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: A query for a single face inside the hole.

qSketchRegion.name: qSketchRegion
qSketchRegion.description: A query for all fully enclosed, 2D regions created by a sketch.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The feature id of the Sketch being queried.

parameters.name: filterInnerLoops
parameters.description: OptionalSpecifies whether to exclude sketch regions fully contained in other sketch regions. A region whose border has a vertex or edge on the outside boundary is not considered "contained." Default is false.

qUniqueVertices.name: qUniqueVertices
qUniqueVertices.description: A query that filters out duplicate vertices. When duplicates are found, the vertex with the lowest deterministic ID is used.

qMateConnectorsOfParts.name: qMateConnectorsOfParts
qMateConnectorsOfParts.description: A query for all mate connectors owned by parts.

qFilletFaces.name: qFilletFaces
qFilletFaces.description: A query for fillet faces of radius equal to, less than or equal to, or greater than or equal to the input faces. If facesToCompareTo does not match one or more fillet faces, the resulting query will not match any faces. Will find the fillet radius from each face and compare to find faces of all fillets on that body that satisfy the compareType.

qMatching.name: qMatching
qMatching.description: Matches any faces or edges within owner bodies of entities in referenceEntities which are geometrically identical (same size and shape) to the face or edge in referenceEntities.

qPatternInstances.name: qPatternInstances
qPatternInstances.signature: (featureId is Id, instanceNames is array, entityType is EntityType)
qPatternInstances.description: A query for entities created by a specific instance or instances of an opPattern operation.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description:
The Id of the specified feature. 
EXAMPLE
id + "pattern1"

parameters.name: instanceNames
parameters.description: The names of the instances to query for, a subset of the instanceNames passed into the opPattern operation.

qDependency.name: qDependency
qDependency.description: A query for the true dependency of the given dependentEntities. For instance, the true dependency of the extruded body will be the face or sketch edges of the profile from which it is extruded.

qLaminarDependency.name: qLaminarDependency
qLaminarDependency.description: A query for the true dependency of the given dependentEntities, specifically for use with wire edges that have been created from laminar edges. If the immediate dependency is not laminar then it will track back until it reaches a laminar dependency (if there is one).

qContainsPoint.name: qContainsPoint
qContainsPoint.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges, or points) in queryToFilter containing a specified point.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: A 3D point, in world space.

qIntersectsLine.name: qIntersectsLine
qIntersectsLine.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges, or points) in queryToFilter touching a specified infinite line.

qIntersectsPlane.name: qIntersectsPlane
qIntersectsPlane.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges, or points) in queryToFilter touching a specified infinite plane.

parameters.name: plane
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
plane(vector(0, 0, 0) * meter, vector(0, 0, 1))

qInFrontOfPlane.name: qInFrontOfPlane
qInFrontOfPlane.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges, or points) in queryToFilter in front of a specified infinite plane. Entities intersecting the plane will not be resolved. Only entities completely on one side or coincident with the plane will be selected. Use flip(plane) to query entities on the other side of the plane. For example, for the XY plane through the origin with the normal (0, 0, 1), qInFrontOfPlane will resolve the vertices (1, 1, 0) and (1, 1, 1) but not the vertex (1, 1, -1).

parameters.name: plane
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
plane(vector(0, 0, 0) * meter, vector(0, 0, 1))

qCoincidesWithPlane.name: qCoincidesWithPlane
qCoincidesWithPlane.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges, or points) in queryToFilter coinciding with a specified infinite plane.

parameters.name: plane
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
plane(vector(0, 0, 0) * meter, vector(0, 0, 1))

qWithinRadius.name: qWithinRadius
qWithinRadius.signature: (queryToFilter is Query, point is Vector, radius is ValueWithUnits)
qWithinRadius.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges or points) in queryToFilter that are within a specified radius from a point.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: The point from which to check distance from.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The distance away from the point.

qClosestTo.name: qClosestTo
qClosestTo.description: A query for the entity in queryToFilter closest to a point.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: A position vector for the point to find entities closest to.

qFarthestAlong.name: qFarthestAlong
qFarthestAlong.description: A query for the entity in queryToFilter farthest along a direction in world space. In the case of a tie, resolves to all entities within TOLERANCE.zeroLength of being the farthest.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: A vector for the direction to find the entity farthest away.

qLargest.name: qLargest
qLargest.description: A query to find the largest entity (by length, area, or volume) in queryToFilter.

qSmallest.name: qSmallest
qSmallest.description: A query to find the smallest entity (by length, area, or volume) in queryToFilter.

qEdgeConvexityTypeFilter.name: qEdgeConvexityTypeFilter
qEdgeConvexityTypeFilter.description: A query that filters given edges by convexity.

qAxis.name: qAxis
qAxis.description: A query that filters edges and faces into axis-symmetric ones (lines, circles, cylinders, cones, tori, revolved, mate connectors) that have the given axis. The sign of the axis direction does not matter.

qSplitBy.name: qSplitBy
qSplitBy.signature: (featureId is Id, entityType, backBody is boolean)
qSplitBy.description: Given the id of a split feature, get entities of a given EntityType on the front or the back side of the split. For a split by face or part, the front denotes the body in the direction of the split tool's surface normal, and the back denotes the body opposite the normal. For a split by isocline, the front denotes non-steep faces and edges, and the back denotes steep entities.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
id + "split1"

parameters.name: backBody
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
false indicates the entities in the front. EXAMPLE
true indicates the entities in the back.

sketchEntityQuery.name: sketchEntityQuery
sketchEntityQuery.signature: (operationId is Id, entityType, sketchEntityId is string)
sketchEntityQuery.description: Gets the wire body entities created for a specific sketch entity. If the sketch id created multiple sketch entities, will return all the wire bodies.

parameters.name: operationId
parameters.description: Id of the sketch feature.

parameters.name: sketchEntityId
parameters.description: Sketch id.

evaluateQuery.name: evaluateQuery
evaluateQuery.description: Returns an array of queries for the individual entities in a context which match a specified query. The returned array contains exactly one transient query for each matching entity at the time of the call. If the context is modified, the returned queries may become invalid and no longer match an entity.

areQueriesEquivalent.name: areQueriesEquivalent
areQueriesEquivalent.signature: (context is Context, first is Query, second is Query)
areQueriesEquivalent.description: Returns true if the supplied queries evaluate to the same set of entities. This function is order-invariant, so if the two queries evaluate to the same entities, but in a different order, the function will still return true.

isQueryEmpty.name: isQueryEmpty
isQueryEmpty.description: Returns true if query evaluates to nothing. Equivalent to evaluateQuery(context, query) == [] or size(evaluateQuery(context, query)) == 0, but faster than either of those approaches if the query is not empty.

evaluateQueryCount.name: evaluateQueryCount
evaluateQueryCount.description: Returns the number of entities returned by the supplied query. Equivalent to size(evaluateQuery(context, query)), but faster.

evApproximateCentroid.name: evApproximateCentroid
evApproximateCentroid.description: Find the centroid of an entity or group of entities. This is equivalent to the center of mass for a constant density object. Warning: This is an approximate value and it is not recommended to use this for modeling purposes that will be negatively affected in case the approximation changes. Consider using the center of a bounding box instead.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: The entities to take the center of mass of.

MassProperties.name: MassProperties
MassProperties.description: The result of an evApproximateMassProperties call.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: mass
parameters.description: The total mass.

parameters.name: centroid
parameters.description: The center of mass with respect to the given reference frame, or with respect to the origin if a reference frame is not specified.

parameters.name: inertia
parameters.description: The 3D inertia tensor, with units of mass * length ^ 2. Evaluated with respect to the reference frame, or with respect to the centroid if a reference frame is not specified.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Total volume. Only returned for solid bodies.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Total area. Only returned for faces.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Total length. Only returned for edges.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Total count. Only returned for vertices.

evApproximateMassProperties.name: evApproximateMassProperties
evApproximateMassProperties.description: Calculates approximate mass properties of an entity or group of entities. Returns mass, centroid, inertia tensor, and volume/area/length/count for bodies/faces/edges/vertices, respectively. Warning: These are approximate values and it is not recommended to use them for modeling purposes that will be negatively affected in case the approximation changes.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: The entities of which to compute mass properties. Only entities of the highest dimensionality will be considered.

parameters.name: density
parameters.description:
The density of the entities, with appropriate units. 
EXAMPLE
1 * kilogram / meter ^ 3 could be the density of 3D solid bodies EXAMPLE
1 * kilogram / meter ^ 2 could be the density of 2D faces or sheet bodies EXAMPLE
1 * kilogram / meter could be the density of 1D edges or wire bodies EXAMPLE
1 * kilogram could be the mass of each 0D vertex or point body

parameters.name: referenceFrame
parameters.description: OptionalOptional coordinate system. Defaults to the centroid with world axes for the inertia tensor, and world coordinates for the centroid.

evArea.name: evArea
evArea.description: Return the total area of all the entities. If no matching 2D faces are found the total area will be zero.

evAxis.name: evAxis
evAxis.description: If the query finds one entity with an axis -- a line, circle, cylinder, cone, sphere, torus, mate connector, or revolved surface -- return the axis. Otherwise throw an exception.

evBox3d.name: evBox3d
evBox3d.description: Find a bounding box around an entity, optionally with respect to a given coordinate system. There is also an option to use a faster but less accurate method.

parameters.name: topology
parameters.description: The entity to find the bounding box of.

parameters.name: cSys
parameters.description: OptionalThe coordinate system to use (if not the standard coordinate system).

parameters.name: tight
parameters.description:
OptionalGet the tightest possible bounding box. Defaults to true. 
EXAMPLE
true for a bounding box precisely at the extents of the given entities (and no bigger). EXAMPLE
false for a bounding box at least as big as the given entities, using a faster algorithm.

evCollision.name: evCollision
evCollision.description: Find collisions between tools and targets. Each collision is a map with field type of type ClashType and fields target, targetBody, tool, and toolBody of type Query.

evCornerType.name: evCornerType
evCornerType.description: Return the type of corner found at a vertex of a sheet metal model

parameters.name: Return
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: primaryVertex
parameters.description: the vertex that defines the corner

parameters.name: allVertices
parameters.description: array of transient queries for all definition vertices associated with the corner

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.BAD_GEOMETRY
parameters.type: The query does not evaluate to a single vertex

evCurveDefinition.name: evCurveDefinition
evCurveDefinition.description: Given a query for a curve, return a Circle, Ellipse, Line, or BSplineCurve value for the curve. If the curve is none of these types, return a map with unspecified contents.

parameters.name: edge
parameters.description: The curve to evaluate.

parameters.name: returnBSplinesAsOther
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, do not return B-spline curves (to avoid the associated time cost). Default is false.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.INVALID_INPUT
parameters.type: The first resolved entity was not an edge.

parameters.name: GBTErrorStringEnum.CANNOT_RESOLVE_ENTITIES
parameters.type: Input entities are invalid or there are no input entities.

evApproximateBSplineCurve.name: evApproximateBSplineCurve
evApproximateBSplineCurve.description: Given a query for a curve, return its approximation (or exact representation if possible) as a B-spline. The options forceCubic and forceNonRational may be used to restrict the type of spline that is returned, but even if these options are false, a cubic non-rational spline may be returned.

parameters.name: edge
parameters.description: The curve to approximate.

parameters.name: forceCubic
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, a cubic spline will be returned. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: forceNonRational
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, a non-rational spline will be returned. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: OptionalSpecifies the desired approximation tolerance: the maximum distance (in meters) between the original curve and the returned spline representation. Default is 1e-6, minimum is 1e-8, and maximum is 1e-2.

DistanceResult.name: DistanceResult
DistanceResult.description: The result of an evDistance call -- information about the extremal distance and the attaining point / line / entity.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: The minimal or maximal distance.

parameters.name: sides
parameters.description:
An array of 2 maps, containing information about where the extremum was found for each side. Each map has a:
point (Vector) : The position in world space that is closest or farthest to the other side. The distance field is measured between the two values of point.
index (integer) : the index into the line or point array or into the query results, if a query is passed in.
parameter (number or length or array of two numbers) : If the index refers to an edge, the parameter is a number between 0 and 1 (unless extend for that side was passed in). It is in the form that evEdgeTangentLine and evEdgeCurvature consume (with arcLengthParameterization set to the same value that was passed into evDistance).
If the index refers to a point, the parameter is 0.
If the index refers to a Line, the parameter is a length representing the distance along the direction.
If the index refers to a face, the parameter is a 2D Vector in the form that evFaceTangentPlane consumes. If this face is a mesh or a plane, the parameter is a 2D Vector of zeroes.
If the index refers to a Plane, the parameter is a 2D Vector representing the lengths along the plane's x and y axes.

evDistance.name: evDistance
evDistance.description: Computes the minimum or maximum distance between geometry on side0 and geometry on side1. "Geometry" means entities, points, or lines. When the minimum or the maximum is not uniquely defined, ties will be broken arbitrarily.

parameters.name: side0
parameters.description:
One of the following: A query, or a point (3D Length Vector), or a Line, or a Plane, or an array of points, or an array of Lines, or an array of Planes. 
EXAMPLE
qNthElement(qEverything(EntityType.FACE), 0) or vector(1, 2, 3) * meter or line(vector(1, 0, 1) * meter, vector(1, 1, 1) or plane(vector(1,1,1) * meter, vector(0,0,1), vector(1,0,0)).

parameters.name: extendSide0
parameters.description: OptionalIf true and side0 is a query, bodies will be ignored and edges and faces extended to their possibly infinite underlying surfaces. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: side1
parameters.description: Like side0.

parameters.name: extendSide1
parameters.description: OptionalLike extendSide0.

parameters.name: maximum
parameters.description: OptionalIf true, compute the maximum instead of the minimum. Defaults to false. Not allowed to be true if a line is passed in in either side or if either extend is true.

RaycastResult.name: RaycastResult
RaycastResult.description: Map containing the results of one collision between a ray and an entity.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: A query for the entity hit by the ray.

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description: Parameters for where the ray hit the entity. A unitless 2-vector for a face, a number for an edge, else undefined.

evRaycast.name: evRaycast
evRaycast.description: Detect intersections between a ray and the given entities.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: A query for target entities. If bodies are provided, the result will contain intersections for individual entities owned by the body.

parameters.name: ray
parameters.description:
The ray to intersect the entities. Because the passed-in Line is interpreted as a ray, by default, intersections with entities "behind" the ray origin are not detected. includeIntersectionsBehind can be set to true if those intersections are desired. 
EXAMPLE
line(vector(0, 0, 0) * inch, vector(1, 0, 0)) specifies the positive x-axis

parameters.name: closest
parameters.description: OptionalGet only the closest intersection with any of the entities. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: includeIntersectionsBehind
parameters.description: OptionalReturn intersections that are behind the ray origin. Defaults to false. Cannot be set to true if closest is true.

parameters.name: array
parameters.type: An array of RaycastResults for each intersection in front of the ray, ordered from closest to farthest.
