evApproximateBSplineSurface.name: evApproximateBSplineSurface
evApproximateBSplineSurface.description: Given a query for a face, return its approximation as a B-spline, including trim boundaries. The options forceCubic and forceNonRational may be used to restrict the type of spline that is returned for the surface, but even if these options are false, a cubic non-rational spline may be returned.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: The curve to approximate.

parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the returned surface will be a cubic spline. This does not affect the trim curves. Defaults to false.

parameters.description: OptionalIf true, the returned surface will be non-rational. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: OptionalSpecifies the desired approximation tolerance: the maximum distance (in meters) between the original face and the returned spline representation. Default is 1e-6, minimum is 1e-8, and maximum is 1e-4. The tolerance for trim curves is 10x the specified value.

parameters.name: Return
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: bSplineSurface
parameters.description: the underlying 3D surface

parameters.name: boundaryBSplineCurves
parameters.description: array of 2D BSplineCurves representing the trimming boundary of the face. May be empty if the face is the entirety of the surface.

(2) connectionEdges an array of individual queries for edges in connectionEntities. The order of individual edge queries should be synchronized with connectionEdgeParameters.
(3) connectionEdgeParameters array - an ordered and synchronized array of parameters on edges in connectionEdgeQueries

parameters.name: uDegree
parameters.description: The degree of the spline in u.

parameters.name: vDegree
parameters.description: The degree of the spline in v.

parameters.name: isUPeriodic
parameters.description: Whether the spline periodic in u.

parameters.name: isVPeriodic
parameters.description: Whether the spline periodic in v.

parameters.name: controlPoints
parameters.description:
A matrix of control points. See BSplineSurface for specific detail. If u or v is periodic, you may provide the necessary overlap, or provide control points without any overlap. If no overlap is provided, degree overlapping control point rows or columns (corresponding to the first degree control point rows or columns) will be added. (unless you provide a set of knots that show no overlap is necessary). 
EXAMPLE
controlPointMatrix([
    [vector(-1, -1, -1) * inch, vector(-1, 0, 0) * inch, vector(-1, -2, 1) * inch],
    [vector( 0,  1, -1) * inch, vector( 0, 2, 0) * inch, vector( 0,  0, 1) * inch],
    [vector( 1, -1, -1) * inch, vector( 1, 0, 0) * inch, vector( 1, -2, 1) * inch]
])

parameters.name: weights
parameters.description: OptionalA matrix of weights. See BSplineSurface for specific detail.

parameters.name: uKnots
parameters.description: OptionalAn array of knots. See BSplineSurface for specific detail. If knots are not provided a uniform parameterization will be created such that the u parameterization exists on the range [0, 1]. For non-periodic u with n control point rows, you may provide the full set of n + degree + 1 knots, or you may provide n - degree + 1 knots, and multiplicity will by padded onto the ends (which has the effect of clamping the surface to the control points in the first and last rows). For periodic u with n unique control points (and optionally an additional degree overlapping control points), you may provide the full set of n + 2 * degree + 1 knots, or you may provide n + 1 knots, and the periodic knots will be padded onto the ends.

parameters.name: vKnots
parameters.description: OptionalSee uKnots.

parameters.name: boundSpec
parameters.description:
Specifies a min, a max, and a default value. These values are possibly different in different units for the sake of round numbers.
To specify a parameter with different default value or different limits, use a different or custom LengthBoundSpec.

isArea.name: isArea
isArea.description: True for any value with area units.

isVolume.name: isVolume
isVolume.description: True for any value with volume units.

isAngle.name: isAngle
isAngle.description: True for a value with angle units which conforms to the given bounds.

parameters.name: boundSpec
parameters.description:
Specifies a min, a max, and a default value. These values are possibly different in different units for the sake of round numbers.

isForce.name: isForce

isAngularVelocity.description: True for any value with angular velocity units.

isEnergy.name: isEnergy

isDensity.name: isDensity
isDensity.description: True for any value with density units.

tolerantGreaterThan.name: tolerantGreaterThan
tolerantGreaterThan.description: Returns true if greater is greater than and not tolerantly equal to lesser.

tolerantGreaterThanOrEqual.name: tolerantGreaterThanOrEqual
tolerantGreaterThanOrEqual.signature: (greater is number, lesser is number, tolerance is number)

tolerantLessThan.name: tolerantLessThan
tolerantLessThan.description: Returns true if lesser is less than and not tolerantly equal to greater.

tolerantLessThanOrEqual.name: tolerantLessThanOrEqual
tolerantLessThanOrEqual.description: Returns true if lesser is less than or tolerantly equal to greater.

tolerantWithinExclusive.name: tolerantWithinExclusive
tolerantWithinExclusive.description: Returns true if value is tolerantly within the interval (lesser, greater).

tolerantWithinInclusive.name: tolerantWithinInclusive
tolerantWithinInclusive.description: Returns true if value is tolerantly within the interval [lesser, greater].

tolerantEqualsZero.name: tolerantEqualsZero
tolerantEqualsZero.description: Returns true if value is tolerantly equal to the 0 value with the same units as value.

sin.name: sin
sin.description: Sine, the ratio of the opposite side over the hypotenuse in a right triangle of the specified angle.

cos.name: cos
cos.description: Cosine, the ratio of the adjacent side over the hypotenuse in a right triangle of the specified angle.

tan.name: tan
tan.description: Tangent, the ratio of the opposite side over the adjacent side in a right triangle of the specified angle.

atan2.name: atan2
atan2.description: Returns the counterclockwise angle from the vector [0, 1] to the vector [x, y]. The angle is negative if y is negative. This is equivalent to atan(y/x) except the result respects the quadrant of the input and is well-behaved near x == 0.

isAngleBetween.name: isAngleBetween
isAngleBetween.signature: (queryAngle is ValueWithUnits, minAngle is ValueWithUnits, maxAngle is ValueWithUnits)
isAngleBetween.description: Returns true if the provided angle is within the given range (inclusive with tolerance), "winding" the query angle as necessary to put it within a positive full circle turn of the range. Ranges that encompass one or more full circles will return true regardless of the query angle.

parseJsonWithUnits.name: parseJsonWithUnits
parseJsonWithUnits.description: Parse a JSON string into either a map or array. Null values in the JSON are returned as undefined. Throws if the string is not well-formed JSON. Applicable strings are parsed into a ValueWithUnits. For instance, "3 inch" will map to a ValueWithUnits with length units that repreresents 3 inches.

Vector.name: Vector
Vector.description: A Vector is a non-empty array. It should contain numbers or lengths.

isLengthVector.name: isLengthVector
isLengthVector.description: True for a Vector where all members are values with length units.

isUnitlessVector.name: isUnitlessVector
isUnitlessVector.description: True for a Vector where all members are simple numbers.

is2dPoint.name: is2dPoint
is2dPoint.description: True for a single 2D length Vector

is2dPointVector.name: is2dPointVector
is2dPointVector.description: True for an array where all members are 2D lengths.

is2dDirection.name: is2dDirection
is2dDirection.description: True for a unitless 2D Vector that is normalized (i.e. has length 1)

is3dLengthVector.name: is3dLengthVector
is3dLengthVector.description: True for a 3D Vector where all members are values with length units.

is3dDirection.name: is3dDirection
is3dDirection.description: True for a unitless 3D Vector that is normalized (i.e. has length 1)

dot.name: dot
dot.description: Returns the dot product of two vectors.

cross.name: cross
cross.description: Returns the cross product of two 3-dimensional vectors.

angleBetween.name: angleBetween
angleBetween.signature: (vector1 is Vector, vector2 is Vector, ref is Vector)
angleBetween.description: Returns the counterclockwise angle between two 3-dimensional vectors as witnessed from the tip of a third 3-dimensional vector. Values are within the range (-PI, PI] * radian with negative values indicating clockwise angles.

normalize.name: normalize
normalize.description: Returns the (unitless) result of normalizing vector. Throws if the input is zero-length.

parameters.name: vector
parameters.description: A Vector with any units.

perpendicularVector.name: perpendicularVector
perpendicularVector.description: Returns a vector perpendicular to the given vector. The choice of which perpendicular vector to return is arbitrary but consistent for the same input. The returned vector is unitless and of length 1.

rotationMatrix3d.name: rotationMatrix3d
rotationMatrix3d.description: Construct a 3D rotation matrix that represents the minimum rotation that takes the normalized from vector to the normalized to vector. The inputs may have any units.

scalarTripleProduct.name: scalarTripleProduct
scalarTripleProduct.signature: (vector1 is Vector, vector2 is Vector, vector3 is Vector)
scalarTripleProduct.description: Returns the scalar triple product, a dot (b cross c), of three 3-dimensional vectors.

parallelVectors.name: parallelVectors
parallelVectors.description: Returns true if two vectors are parallel (within tolerance).

perpendicularVectors.name: perpendicularVectors
perpendicularVectors.description: Returns true if two vectors are perpendicular (within tolerance).

clusterPoints.name: clusterPoints
clusterPoints.description: Groups points into clusters. Two points farther than tolerance apart are guaranteed to be in separate clusters. A set of points all within tolerance of each other that has no other points within tolerance is guaranteed to be a single cluster.

parameters.name: array
parameters.type: Array of arrays, where each array is a cluster of nearby points, represented as indices into points array.

setAttribute.name: setAttribute
setAttribute.description: Attach an attribute to one or several entities. Will overwrite any attribute previously set on the same entity with the same name.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Entities to attach attribute to. Throws an error if the query resolves to nothing.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the attribute

parameters.name: attribute
parameters.description:
The data to set. Can be any type. If undefined is provided, any existing attribute will be unset (and this entity will no longer resolve in qHasAttribute and similar functions) 
Legacy unnamed attributes: If name is not provided, adds an unnamed attribute to the entities. If more than one unnamed attribute with the same type is set on any entity, throws an error.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Entities to get attributes on. If query resolves to nothing, empty array is returned

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the attribute to get.

parameters.name: attributePattern
parameters.description:
OptionalProviding a map here will also filter out attributes which do not have entries precisely matching the keys and values of attributePattern, similar to qHasAttributeWithValueMatching. 
EXAMPLE
{ "odd" : true } matches all attributes values are maps with a field "odd" whose value is true.Legacy unnamed attributes: If attributePattern is provided and name is not, getAttributes will only return unnamed attributes with the same type as attributePattern, using the same behavior documented in the legacy function qAttributeFilter.

parameters.name: array
parameters.type: An array of all unique attributes on the given entities matching the pattern.

getAttribute.name: getAttribute
getAttribute.description: Get the value of a single named attribute attached to a single entity, or undefined if no attribute of that name has been set.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Query resolving to a single entity to get the attribute from. If multiple entities are resolved, the first resolved entity is considered.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the attribute

getAllAttributes.name: getAllAttributes
getAllAttributes.description: Get the named attributes attached to a single entity, or an empty map if the entity has no attributes.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Query resolving to a single entity to get the attributes from.

parameters.name: map
parameters.type: A map from attribute names to attribute values for all of the attributes on the given entity.

removeAttributes.name: removeAttributes
removeAttributes.description: Has no effect on named attributes, instead use setAttribute with "attribute" : undefined.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: OptionalEntities to remove unnamed attributes from. Default is everything.

parameters.name: attributePattern
parameters.description: OptionalIf provided, will only remove attributes with the same type, using the same behavior documented in the legacy function qAttributeFilter.

defineComputedPartProperty.name: defineComputedPartProperty
defineComputedPartProperty.description: This function takes a computed part property function and wraps it to define a computed part property. It is analogous to defineFeature, except that it is used to define computed part properties. A typical usage is something like:

parameters.name: propertyFunction
parameters.description: A function that takes a context, a part Query that returns a single Part, and a definition, and that returns a value such as a number or a string or a ValueWithUnits.

makeArray.name: makeArray
makeArray.description: Create a new array with given size, filled with fillValue. Note: this is equivalent to assigning each individual array element to fillValue; boxes and builtins will not be deep-copied.

size.name: size
size.description: Returns the size of an array. This counts only direct children; it does not recursively examine containers inside.

isIn.name: isIn
isIn.description: Returns true if value appears in an array, using == for comparison.

indexOf.name: indexOf
indexOf.signature: (s is string, substr is string, startIndex is number)
indexOf.description: Return the index of a substring in a string starting the search at a specified start index, or -1 if the substring is not found.

isValueIn.name: isValueIn
isValueIn.description: Returns true if value appears as the value of a map entry, using == for comparison.

mapArray.name: mapArray
mapArray.description: Returns a new array, with the same size as arr, created by mapping each element of arr through a mapFunction.

parameters.name: mapFunction
parameters.description: A function which takes in one argument (a member of the input array) and returns a value.

resize.name: resize
resize.signature: (arr is array, newSize is number, newValue)
resize.description: Returns a copy of an array with size changed to newSize. If the new size is larger than the original size, the extra values are set to newValue.

append.name: append
append.description: Returns a copy of an array with a single value added to the end.

concatenateArrays.name: concatenateArrays
concatenateArrays.description: Given two arrays, concatenate the contents of the arrays.

mergeMaps.name: mergeMaps
mergeMaps.description: Merge maps at a particular location as specified by the keyList. If either the destination node specified by the keyList or the newNode is not a map, the newNode will replace the destination node.

parameters.name: defaults
parameters.description: A container (array or map) that will be merged at the location specified by the keyList. If defaults is not an array or map and keyList is empty, the result is newNode since a merge isn't possible.

parameters.name: keyList
parameters.description: An array of map keys or array indices that collectively specify a location within defaults to perform the merge.

parameters.name: newNode
parameters.description: A value that will be merged into defaults at the location specified by keyList. If the newNode specified is a map and the node identified by keyList is a map, then this will perform a mergeMaps operation.

intersectMaps.name: intersectMaps
intersectMaps.description: Compute the intersection of the keysets of the input maps. In other words, returns a map whose keys are present in all input maps and whose values are taken from the last map.

reverse.name: reverse
reverse.description: Return a copy of an array with elements in reverse order.

sort.name: sort
sort.description: Return a sorted copy of an array. Current implementation uses merge sort.

parameters.name: compareFunction
parameters.description: A function that takes two values, returns a negative value if the first is before the second, 0 if the two are equal, and positive value if the second is before the first.

tolerantSort.name: tolerantSort
tolerantSort.description: Performs a tolerantSort of entities, ordering by the value returned by mapFunction. Like tolerantSort, the original order will be preserved for values within tolerance for stability.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description:
EXAMPLE
1e-7 * meter

parameters.name: mapFunction
parameters.description:
A function taking in a single entity and returning a sortable number or ValueWithUnits. 
EXAMPLE
function(entity is Query) { return evLength(context, {"entities" : entity}); } to sort entities by increasing length.

filter.name: filter
filter.description: Return the members of an array matching a predicate function, preserving element order.

parameters.name: filterFunction
parameters.description: A function which takes one argument (a member of the input array) and returns a boolean.

first.name: first
first.description: Return the first item in a map

keys.name: keys
keys.description: Returns the keys in the supplied map in map iteration order.

values.name: values
values.description: Returns the values in the supplied map ordered by the map iteration ordering of their associated keys.

subArray.name: subArray
subArray.signature: (input is array, startIndex is number, endIndex is number)

insertIntoMapOfArrays.name: insertIntoMapOfArrays
insertIntoMapOfArrays.description: Inserts value into the array keyed by key, returns the updated map

rotateArray.name: rotateArray
rotateArray.description: Returns a rotated array of the same elements. step less than zero moves elements towards the front. step greater than zero moves elements towards the back.

insertElementAt.name: insertElementAt
insertElementAt.signature: (arr is array, index is number, value)
insertElementAt.description: Returns an array with value inserted at index.

removeElementAt.name: removeElementAt
removeElementAt.description: Returns an array with the element at index removed.

all.name: all
all.description: Returns true if and only if all elements of an array, when passed into the checkFunction, return true.

parameters.name: arr
parameters.description: An array of elements to be checked.

parameters.name: checkFunction
parameters.description: A unary function that returns a boolean.

parameters.name: boolean
parameters.type: true if and only if all checkFunction(element) calls return true.

allCombinations.name: allCombinations
allCombinations.description: Creates all possible combinations from arrays of values for each element.

parameters.name: arr
parameters.description: An array of arrays, where each array represents all possible values for the given array's index in the returned arrays.

parameters.name: array
parameters.type: An array of all possible combinations that have exactly one element from each of the input arrays.

any.name: any
any.description: Returns true if any element of an array, when passed into the check function, returns true.

parameters.name: arr
parameters.description: An array of elements.

parameters.name: boolean
parameters.type: true if and only if at least one check(element) call returns true.

average.name: average
average.description: Returns the average of an array. All array elements must be mutually addable and divisible by a number.

parameters.name: arr
parameters.description: An array of mutually addable and divisible elements.

deduplicate.name: deduplicate
deduplicate.description: Deduplicate an array. Maintains original array order, eliminating all but the first occurrence of a given duplicate.

parameters.name: arr
parameters.description: An array of values to be deduplicated.

foldArray.name: foldArray
foldArray.signature: (arr is array, seed, foldFunction is function)
foldArray.description: Folds an array from left to right with a foldFunction.

parameters.name: arr
parameters.description: An array to fold.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: The initial value of the accumulator to be passed into the foldFunction.

parameters.name: foldFunction
parameters.description: A binary function which takes in an accumulator (the seed for the first iteration, and the result of the previous call for subsequent iterations) and an element of the passed in array.

mapArrayIndices.name: mapArrayIndices
mapArrayIndices.description: Returns a new array, with the same size as arr, created by mapping each index of arr through a mapIndexFunction.

parameters.name: mapIndexFunction
parameters.description: A function which takes in one argument (an index of the input array) and returns a value.

parameters.name: array
parameters.type: The results of calling mapIndexFunction on the indices of all elements in the passed in arr.

mapValue.name: mapValue
mapValue.description: Map a value using a mapFunction and return the result. Particularly useful when using a lambda function inline to dynamically change some value.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Anything that the passed in mapFunction will accept as a parameter.

parameters.name: mapFunction
parameters.description: A function that will be called on the passed in value.

memoizeFunction.name: memoizeFunction
memoizeFunction.description: Memoize a unary (one-parameter) function. Once memoized, if the returned function is called with the same parameter twice, the second return value will be fetched from an internal cache. This can dramatically speed up calculations - particularly when f is called with the same parameter many times. The overhead of memoizing a function is negligible. Note that memoization will not properly work with functions that have side effects, such as modifying a box.

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: A unary function to be memoized.

parameters.name: function
parameters.type: A memoized function that will return the same thing as f.

sum.name: sum
sum.description: Sum an array of elements that are all mutually addable. An empty array returns 0.

parameters.name: arr
parameters.description: An array of mutually addable elements to be summed.

zip.name: zip
zip.description: An alternative way to call zip(array) that facilitates chaining arguments.

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: The first array to zip.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: The second array to zip.

parameters.name: array
parameters.type: An array of length-2 arrays. For the i'th array, the first element is the i'th element of a and the second is the i'th element of b.

DecalData.name: DecalData
DecalData.description: Data representing a decal that is mapped onto a face.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: decalId
parameters.description: A unique id to represent the decal in the context of the face on which it is placed. The id should correspond to the id of the creating feature, or be a sub-id of the creating feature.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: The image that is being mapped.

parameters.name: uvTransform
parameters.description: A post-projection transformation that is applied in UV space. This can be used to further translate, rotate, and scale a projected image.

parameters.name: planeSystem
parameters.description: OptionalA coordinate system representing the plane for the ImageMappingType.PLANAR type. This field must be defined if the imageMappingType field is of type ImageMappingType.PLANAR. The lower-left corner of the image will project to the plane's origin. The right edge of the image is along the positive X direction of the coordinate system. The top edge of the image is along the positive Y direction of the coordinate system. See planeToCSys for deriving a coordinate system from a Plane object.

parameters.name: cylinder
parameters.description: OptionalThe cylinder onto which the decal is mapped. This field must be defined if the imageMappingType field is of type ImageMappingType.CYLINDRICAL.

parameters.name: cylinderSystem
parameters.description: OptionalA coordinate system used in projecting the image onto the given cylinder. This field must be defined if the imageMappingType field is of type ImageMappingType.CYLINDRICAL. The coordinate system's origin must lie on the cylinder's axis with the system's Z axis aligned with the cylinder's own axis. The center of the horizontal extents of the image coincide with the intersection of the coordinate system's x axis and the cylinder. The center of the vertical extents of the image coincide with the projection of the coordinate system's origin on the cylinder. The top edge of the image is along the positive Z direction of the coordinate system projected on the cylinder.

setDimensionedEntities.name: setDimensionedEntities
setDimensionedEntities.description: Tolerant dimensions require multiple pieces of information. This function specifies all of the information required for a dimension that cannot be specified in a tolerant quantity. Tolerant quantities are commonly declared in a feature using the UIHint.CAN_BE_TOLERANT or UIHint.CAN_BE_TOLERANT_DIAMETER UI hints in the annotation of the quantity parameter.

parameters.name: parameterId
parameters.description: The id of the tolerant quantity parameter in the feature definition.

parameters.name: queries
parameters.description: An array of one query (for a radius or diameter dimension) or two queries (for other dimensions). The queries can evaluate to more than one face, but in that case each face should lie on the same underlying surface. See extrude and fillet for examples.

parameters.name: facePairs
parameters.description: Required if queries is undefinedAn array of pairs of queries (a pair is an array of two queries). Used for features where mulitple face pairs are subject to the same constraint but they are not all coincident, for example, a thin extrusion of a square where the thickness is tolerant.

parameters.name: measuresSolidAngle
parameters.description: OptionalUsed to specify which part of a circle an angle dimension refers to. The angle between two planes can be defined by two possible numbers that sum to 360 degrees. If this option is SOLID, then the angle is measured from the first face, in to the part. If this option is VOID, then the angle is measured from the first face, out of the part. If this option is not set for an angle, then the result is consistent but undefined. It is recommended that an option is always provided for angle dimensions.

parameters.name: measurementDirection
parameters.description: OptionalUsed with dimensions of type FeatureDimensionType.AXIS_DISTANCE. If this option is not set then the dimension measures the shortest distance between the axes. If this option is set then the dimension measures the distance between the axes in this direction.

parameters.name: schemaClass
parameters.description: OptionalOn regeneration a dimension with a quantity with tolerance type ToleranceType.DEFAULT will set its tolerances given the nominal value and any default tolerances specified on the part. If this field is not set then the rule used will be either the default linear or angular rule, depending on the dimension type. If this field is set then the dimension will use the custom rule corresponding to the value. This field can also be a ToleranceSchemaClass to use a predefined class from the standard library. For example, you can set this to ToleranceSchemaClass.FILLET_RADIUS to use the same tolerance rules as Onshape's official fillet feature.

parameters.name: tolerances
parameters.description: OptionalContains tolerance and precision information for the specified parameter. This cannot be set if the parameter has been marked tolerant by the user.

parameters.name: nominal
parameters.description: Required if tolerances is not undefinedRequired if setting tolerances, for either an existing or new parameter. For an existing feature parameter, this is usually the value of that parameter.

HoleDefinition.description: Describes the shape of a hole using a series of HoleProfiles.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Description

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: An array of HoleProfiles which define the shape of the hole. The profiles are interpreted in order, from the top to the bottom of the hole. The final profile must have a radius of 0. Each profile must specify a unique name, or all of the profiles must leave their name field undefined. If two or more adjacent profiles in the list end up being identical (in the same position with the same radius) when their final placement is determined in opHole, the identical profiles will be collapsed into a single profile, which uses the name of the first of the identical profiles.

parameters.name: faceNames
parameters.description: OptionalA list of names to assign to the faces created by opHole. Should be the same length as the profiles array, where faceNames[i] is the name of the face created between profiles i - 1 and i, and faceNames[0] is the name of the top cap face (the face before profile 0). If any profiles are collapsed, the names of the faces between the collapsed profiles are skipped. Supplying faceNames allows for the querying of faces by name when using qOpHoleFace.

parameters.name: faceNames
parameters.description: OptionalSee HoleDefinition.

parameters.description: OptionalThe query for all bodies to be brought in from the part studios. Default is all bodies except sketches.

parameters.name: tolerances
parameters.description:
OptionalThe tolerances for variable configuration inputs. Default is 1e-8 meters for lengths, 1e-11 radians for angles, and 0 for numbers. The default tolerances for lengths, angles, and numbers can be specified using the (LENGTH_UNITS), (ANGLE_UNITS), and (unitless) keys, respectively. The tolerance for a specific configuration input can be specified using that input name as the key. 
EXAMPLE
{ (LENGTH_UNITS) : 1e-4 * meter, (unitless) : 1e-8, "count" : 0 } causes length configuration variables that differ by less than 1e-4 meters to be considered identical, as well as numberical configuration variables that differ by less than 1e-8, except that configuration variables named "count" are compared exactly.

makeWrapSurface.name: makeWrapSurface
makeWrapSurface.signature: (context is Context, face is Query, anchorPoint is Vector, spin is ValueWithUnits)
makeWrapSurface.description: Make a WrapSurface for opWrap defined by a planar, cylindrical or conical face.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: A face to use as the definition face for the WrapSurface.

parameters.name: anchorPoint
parameters.description: The anchor point of the WrapSurface. See WrapSurface documentation.

parameters.name: spin
parameters.description:
For a planar face: Angle of a counter-clockwise spin to apply to the plane's x axis about its positive z axis, which is then used as the anchorDirection. For a cylindrical face: Angle of a counter-clockwise spin to apply to the cylinder's canonical anchorDirection at the given anchorPoint about the direction vector from the cylinder axis to the anchorPoint. The canonical anchorDirection at the given anchorPoint is defined as the "rightward" direction when looking at the cylinder in the direction from the anchorPoint to the cylinder axis with the cylinder's zAxis up. In other words: cross(cylinder z axis, direction vector from cylinder axis to anchorPoint). This spun direction is then used as the anchorDirection. For a conical face: Angle of a counter-clockwise spin to apply to the cone's canonical anchorDirection at the given anchorPoint about the normal at anchorPoint. The canonical anchorDirection at the given anchorPoint is defined as the "rightward" direction when looking at the cone from the normal.
See WrapSurface documentation for a description of anchorDirection.

DraftFeatureType.name: DraftFeatureType
DraftFeatureType.description: Types of drafts available for the draft feature.

parameters.name: NEUTRAL_PLANE
parameters.type: Draft by holding the intersection between a set of faces and a neutral plane as a constant.

parameters.name: PARTING_LINE
parameters.type: Draft by holding a set of parting edges as a constant.

PartingLineSides.name: PartingLineSides
PartingLineSides.description: Specifies which faces to draft when drafting with DraftFeatureType.PARTING_LINE.

parameters.name: SYMMETRIC

parameters.name: TWO_SIDED
parameters.type: Draft both of the faces attached to the parting line with separate draft angles.

draft.name: draft
draft.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)

parameters.name: neutralPlane
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is NEUTRAL_PLANE A planar face or mate connector defining both the neutral plane and pull direction of the the draft. The intersection of the drafted faces and the neutral plane remains unchanged. The pull direction of the draft will be the face normal or mate connector z-axis.

parameters.name: draftFaces
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is NEUTRAL_PLANE The faces to draft for a NEUTRAL_PLANE draft.

parameters.name: pullDirectionEntity
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is PARTING_LINE An entity defining the pull direction of the draft. This entity should conform to the ALLOWS_DIRECTION specification in QueryFilterCompound.

parameters.name: partingEdges
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is PARTING_LINE Edges defining the parting line of the draft. These edges will remain unchanged as some adjacent faces, as defined by partingLineSides, are drafted.

parameters.name: hintFaces
parameters.description: OptionalFor Onshape internal use. For PARTING_LINE draft, specifies in advance which adjacent faces of partingEdges should be treated as more along the pull direction. When unspecified, the feature will use a geometric calculation to determine this distinction.

parameters.name: partingLineSides
parameters.description: Required if draftFeatureType is PARTING_LINE Specifies whether to draft one or both faces adjacent to the parting edges, and whether the draft should be symmetrical if drafting both faces. See PartingLineSides.

parameters.name: alongPull
parameters.description: Required if PartingLineSides is ONE_SIDED Specifies which face will be drafted in a ONE_SIDED PARTING_LINE draft. If true, the face which is more along the pull direction from the perspective of the parting edge is drafted. If false, the face which is more away from the pull direction from the perspective of the parting edge is drafted.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description:
The draft angle, must be between 0 and 89.9 degrees. 
EXAMPLE
3 * degree

parameters.name: pullDirection
parameters.description: OptionalWhether the pull direction of the draft should be reversed. In equivalent terms, whether the draft should use -angle as the draft angle (true), or angle as the draft angle (false). Default is false.

parameters.name: secondAngle
parameters.description:
Required if PartingLineSides is TWO_SIDED The second draft angle for a TWO_SIDED PARTING_LINE draft. Must be between 0 and 89.9 degrees. Note that when using TWO_SIDED, angle will be applied to faces that are away from the pull direction, from the perspective of the edge. secondAngle will be applied to faces that are along the pull direction, from the perspective of the edge. 
EXAMPLE
3 * degree

parameters.name: secondPullDirection
parameters.description: OptionalWhether the pull direction of the draft should be reversed for the second angle of a TWO_SIDED draft. In equivalent terms, whether the draft should use -secondAngle as the second draft angle (true), or secondAngle as the second draft angle (false). Default is false.

parameters.name: tangentPropagation
parameters.description: OptionalFor a NEUTRAL_PLANE draft, true to propagate draft across tangent faces. Default is false.

parameters.name: referenceEdgePropagation
parameters.description: OptionalFor a PARTING_LINE draft, true to extend the parting line across connected edges of already included faces and tangent faces. Default is false.

parameters.name: reFillet
parameters.description: Optionaltrue to attempt to defillet draft faces before the draft and reapply the fillets after. Default is false.

extrude.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
extrude.description: Create an extrude, as used in Onshape's extrude feature.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description:
Required if bodyType is SOLIDThe planar faces and/or sketch regions to extrude.

parameters.description:
Required if bodyType is SURFACEThe sketch curves to extrude. 
EXAMPLE

parameters.name: endBound
parameters.description: OptionalThe end bounding condition for the extrude. Default is BLIND.

parameters.name: oppositeDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to flip the direction of the extrude to point opposite the face/sketch normal.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description:
Required if endBound is BLINDA length specifying the extrude depth. For a blind extrude, specifies the depth of the first extrude direction. For a symmetric extrude, specifies the full extrude depth. 
EXAMPLE
0.5 * inch

parameters.name: endBoundEntityFace
parameters.description: Required if endBound is UP_TO_SURFACESpecifies the face or surface to bound the extrude.

parameters.name: endBoundEntityBody
parameters.description: Required if endBound is UP_TO_BODYSpecifies the surface or solid body to bound the extrude.

parameters.name: endBoundEntityVertex
parameters.description: Required if endBound is UP_TO_VERTEXSpecifies the vertex to bound the extrude.

parameters.name: hasOffset
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to add a translational offset from the selected face, surface, solid body or vertex.

parameters.name: offsetDistance
parameters.description:
Required if offset is trueThe translational distance between the selected face, surface, solid body or vertex and the cap of the extrude. 
EXAMPLE
0.5 * inch

parameters.name: offsetOppositeDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
false to offset away from the selected end bound (default) EXAMPLE
true to offset into the selected end bound

parameters.name: hasDraft
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to add a draft to the extrude.

parameters.name: draftAngle
parameters.description:
Required if hasDraft is trueThe angle, as measured from the extrude direction, at which to draft. 
EXAMPLE
10 * degree

parameters.name: draftPullDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
false to draft outwards (default) EXAMPLE
true to draft inwards

parameters.name: hasSecondDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to specify a second direction.

parameters.name: secondDirectionBound
parameters.description: OptionalThe bounding type of the second direction. Can be different from the bounding type of the first direction.

parameters.name: secondDirectionOppositeDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true will flip the second end direction to align opposite the plane/face's normal.

parameters.name: secondDirectionDepth
parameters.description: Required if secondDirectionBound is BLINDA length specifying the second direction's extrude depth.

parameters.name: secondDirectionBoundEntityFace
parameters.description: Required if secondDirectionBound is UP_TO_SURFACEspecifies the face or surface to bound the extrude.

parameters.name: secondDirectionBoundEntityBody
parameters.description: Required if secondDirectionBound is UP_TO_BODYspecifies the surface or solid body to bound the extrude.

parameters.name: secondDirectionBoundEntityVertex
parameters.description: Required if secondDirectionBound is UP_TO_VERTEXspecifies the vertex to bound the extrude.

parameters.name: hasSecondDirectionOffset
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to add a translational offset from the selected face, surface, solid body or vertex.

parameters.name: secondDirectionOffsetDistance
parameters.description:
Required if offset is trueThe translational distance between the selected face, surface, solid body or vertex and the cap of the extrude. 
EXAMPLE
0.5 * inch

parameters.name: secondDirectionOffsetOppositeDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
false to offset away from the selected second direction end bound (default) EXAMPLE
true to offset into the selected second direction end bound

parameters.name: hasSecondDirectionDraft
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to add a draft to the second direction extrude.

parameters.name: secondDirectionDraftPullDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
false to draft the second direction outwards (default) EXAMPLE
true to draft the second direction inwards

parameters.name: defaultScope
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to merge with all other bodies EXAMPLE
false to merge with booleanScope

parameters.name: booleanScope
parameters.description: Required if defaultScope is falseThe specified bodies to merge with.

parameters.name: wallShape
parameters.description: Required if bodyType is THINThe specified planar face or sketch edges defining the thin wall shape.

parameters.name: thickness1
parameters.description: Required if bodyType is THINThe outwards thickness of the thin wall.

parameters.name: thickness2

parameters.name: flipWall
parameters.description:

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description:
Required if patternType is PARTThe parts to pattern. 
EXAMPLE
qCreatedBy(id + "extrude1", EntityType.BODY)

parameters.name: faces
parameters.description: Required if patternType is FACEThe faces to pattern.

parameters.name: instanceFunction
parameters.description: Required if patternType is FEATUREThe FeatureList of the features to pattern.

parameters.description:

EXAMPLE

The distance between each pattern entity. 
EXAMPLE
1.0 * inch to space the pattern entities 1 inch apart.

parameters.name: instanceCount
parameters.description:
The resulting number of pattern entities, unless isCentered is true.

2 to have 2 resulting pattern entities (including the seed).

parameters.name: oppositeDirection
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to switch the direction of the pattern along directionOne.

parameters.name: isCentered
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to center the pattern on the seed. When set to true, instanceCount - 1 pattern entities are created along each direction of directionOne. Default is false.

parameters.name: hasSecondDir
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true if the pattern should extend in two directions rather than one, creating a grid of pattern entities.

parameters.name: directionTwo
parameters.description: Required if hasSecondDir is trueThe second direction of the pattern.

parameters.name: distanceTwo
parameters.description: Required if hasSecondDir is trueThe distance between each pattern entity in the second direction.

parameters.name: instanceCountTwo
parameters.description: Required if hasSecondDir is trueThe resulting number of pattern entities in the second direction, unless isCentered is true.

parameters.name: oppositeDirectionTwo
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to switch the direction of the pattern along directionTwo.

parameters.name: isCenteredTwo
parameters.description: OptionalWhether to center the second direction of the pattern on the seed. When set to true, instanceCount - 1 pattern entities are created along each direction of directionTwo. Default is false.

parameters.name: defaultScope
parameters.description:
OptionalEXAMPLE
true to merge with all other bodies EXAMPLE
false to merge with booleanScope

parameters.name: booleanScope
parameters.description: Required if defaultScope is falseThe specified bodies to merge with.

parameters.name: skipInstances

parameters.name: skippedInstances

Required if skipInstances is trueWhich instances of the pattern to skip. Each is denoted by one index for each direction, either of which may be negative if isCentered or isCenteredTwo respectively is true. 
EXAMPLE
[{ index1: -3, index2: 1 }, { index1: 0, index2: -2 }, { index1: 5, index2: 0 }]

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the feature. Must not belong to a non-query variable feature. If a query variable feature with this name exists, it will be overwritten after this feature.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of the variable. Maximum length of 256 characters.

parameters.name: selectionQuery
parameters.description: If selectionType is SELECTION, query that will be contained in the variable.

parameters.name: createdByFeatures
parameters.description: If selectionType is CREATED_BY, features whose created entities will be contained in the variable.

parameters.name: seedBodies
parameters.description: If selectionType is OWNED_BY or EDGE_CONVEXITY, bodies owning the entities that will be contained in the variable.

parameters.name: seedFaces

parameters.name: seedEdgesOrFaces

parameters.name: boundedFacesBounds

parameters.name: addAdditionalQueries
parameters.description: Whether to include addition queries in the variable.

parameters.description: An array of additional queries to include. Each item's content is analogous to what is contained in the original query. It also contains a booleanOperation field determining how to combine the additional query with the current query.

parameters.name: evaluateOnUse

parameters.name: showSelection

canBeSMAssociationAttribute.description: Association attribute stores attributeId. The association is established by assigning the same attribute to associated entities. Every entity in sheet metal master sheet body has a distinct association attribute.

sheetMetalCornerBreak.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
sheetMetalCornerBreak.description: Sheet metal specific feature combining functionality of edge fillet and chamfer. It calls SMEdgeBlendImpl to apply fillets or chamfers in flat and then change the definition surface accordingly As a result of this change rips corner/bend reliefs are also "baked" into the definition surface and flexibility of sheet metal model is lost. For this reason we recommend that this feature is used after sheet metal flanges, joints and reliefs are finalized.

sheetMetalEnd.name: sheetMetalEnd
sheetMetalEnd.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
sheetMetalEnd.description: Deactivate the sheet metal model of selected parts. Continued modeling on deactivated sheet metal parts will not be represented in the flat pattern or the table.

SMFlangeAlignment.description: Describes the position of a virtual sharp with respect to "flange face", defined as the face that corresponds to the edge selected for flange in the underlying sheet.

SMPartialFlangeChainType.description: Sets the handling for chains of edges while creating a partial flange.

parameters.name: PER_CHAIN
parameters.type: The partial flange conditions will be applied to the ends of each chain of selected edges.

sheetMetalFlange.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
sheetMetalFlange.description: Create sheet metal flanges on selected edges of sheet metal parts. Length of flange may be defined by distance (as measured from the virtual sharp along outer edge of wall) or limiting entity. Bend angle may be flipped using the oppositeDirection flag. When auto-miter is not selected, flange sides are rotated by miter angle.

sheetMetalFormed.signature: (context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
sheetMetalFormed.description: Creates forms of specified dimensions and style, based either on standard forms, or by user-defined forms. Each form's position and orientation are specified using sketch points or mate connectors. For sketch points sketch coordinate system specifies orientation.

parameters.name: BOTTOM_AXIS_POINT

HolePositionReference.name: HolePositionReference
HolePositionReference.description: For a HoleProfile, a reference point along the hole axis to which the position of the profile is relative. To calculate these references, the cylinder of the hole is intersected with the targets of the hole. If the hole cylinder encounters a slanted or otherwise irregular face at the intersection with the target, the reference may by a range rather than a single point. Users may specify that they want the end of this range by using a holeProfile, or the beginning of this range by using a holeProfileBeforeReference; or they may control this behavior directly by setting the beforeReference flag of the HoleProfile.

parameters.name: AXIS_POINT
parameters.type: When calling opHole, the user will supply one or more axes defining where the holes are to be placed. When using this reference, the position of the profile will be in reference to the origin of the axis Line of the hole.

parameters.name: TARGET_START
parameters.type: When using this reference, the position of the profile will be in reference to the closest intersection of the hole cylinder with any target.

parameters.name: LAST_TARGET_START
parameters.type: For each target, find the first intersection of the hole cylinder into the target. When using this reference, the position of the profile will be in reference to the furthest of those intersections. Notably, this means that if certain targets are geometrically constructed such that the hole cylinder enters and exits the target multiple times, only the first of the entrances into the target is considered.

parameters.name: LAST_TARGET_END
parameters.type: When using this reference, the position of the profile will be in reference to the furthest exit of the hole cylinder from any target.

parameters.name: LAST_TARGET_START_IN_DEPTH
parameters.type: For each target, find the first intersection of the hole cylinder into the target. When using this reference, the position of the profile will be in reference to the furthest of those intersections within the hole depth.

parameters.type: Performs a boolean subtraction of the new body from all bodies in the merge scope.

parameters.name: INTERSECT
parameters.type: Performs a boolean intersection between each new body and each body in the merge scope.

NewSurfaceOperationType.name: NewSurfaceOperationType
NewSurfaceOperationType.description: Defines how a new surface from a surface-creating feature (sweep, loft, revolve, etc.) should be merged with other surfaces in the context.

parameters.name: NEW
parameters.type: Creates a new surface in the context with the geometry resulting from the operation.

parameters.name: ADD
parameters.type: Performs a surface union between the new surface and all surfaces used as input.

UIHint.name: UIHint
UIHint.description: List of available UI Hints, which control how a parameter input is displayed in the feature dialog.

parameters.name: OPPOSITE_DIRECTION
parameters.type: For a boolean parameter, display as a toggle button with arrow next to the previous parameter.

parameters.name: ALWAYS_HIDDEN
parameters.type: Do not display this parameter or allow a user to edit it (useful for parameters changed only in editing logic or manipulator change functions).

parameters.name: SHOW_CREATE_SELECTION
parameters.type: For a query parameter, include a button to open the "Create selection" dialog.

parameters.name: NO_PREVIEW_PROVIDED
parameters.type: For a feature, hide the preview slider which controls before/after transparency, and only show the final version.

parameters.name: REMEMBER_PREVIOUS_VALUE
parameters.type: When a user makes a new instance of this feature, set this parameter's default value to the value they set the last time they used this feature.

parameters.name: DISPLAY_SHORT
parameters.type: Two consecutive boolean or quantity parameters marked as DISPLAY_SHORT may be placed on the same line.

parameters.name: SHOW_EXPRESSION
parameters.type: If an expression (like #foo or 1/4 in) is entered, always show the expression, and never the resulting value.

parameters.name: OPPOSITE_DIRECTION_CIRCULAR
parameters.type: Like OPPOSITE_DIRECTION, but with circular arrows.

parameters.name: SHOW_LABEL
parameters.type: Show a label above an enum parameter.

parameters.name: HORIZONTAL_ENUM
parameters.type: Display an enum as a horizontal list of clickable text, rather than the default select control

parameters.name: MATCH_LAST_ARRAY_ITEM
parameters.type: Inside an array parameter, set the default value on a new item to match what is set on the last item.

parameters.name: COLLAPSE_ARRAY_ITEMS
parameters.type: For an array parameter, create new items (and items in a newly opened dialog) as collapsed by default.

parameters.name: INITIAL_FOCUS_ON_EDIT
parameters.type: When an existing feature is edited, the first visible parameter with this UI hint will get focus.

parameters.name: INITIAL_FOCUS
parameters.type: When creating or editing, the first visible parameter with this UI hint will get focus (but when editing, a parameter with INITIAL_FOCUS_ON_EDIT takes precedence).

parameters.name: READ_ONLY
parameters.type: Prevent changes to the parameter from the feature dialog. A read-only parameter can be modified by the editing logic function.

parameters.name: PREVENT_CREATING_NEW_MATE_CONNECTORS
parameters.type: For a query parameter allowing BodyType.MATE_CONNECTOR, only allow preexisting mate connectors, and don't provide a button to allow creating new mate connectors specificaly for this parameter.

parameters.name: FIRST_IN_ROW
parameters.type: Guarantee that, regardless of other layout requirements, this parameter will always be the first parameter in its displayed row.

parameters.name: ALLOW_QUERY_ORDER
parameters.type: Enable reordering of queries in a query parameter.

parameters.name: PREVENT_ARRAY_REORDER
parameters.type: Disable reordering of items in an array parameter.

parameters.name: FOCUS_INNER_QUERY
parameters.type: When adding a new item to an array parameter, focus the driving inner QLV if the parameter is selection-driven, and focus the first inner QLV otherwise.

parameters.name: SHOW_TOLERANCE
parameters.type: For a boolean parameter, display as a toggle button with tolerance icon next to the previous parameter.

parameters.name: ALLOW_ARRAY_FOCUS
parameters.type: Allow focusing an array parameter with no driving or inner QLV, as if it were selection-driven.

parameters.name: SHOW_INLINE_CONFIG_INPUTS
parameters.type: Inline the configuration parameters in the configure dialog for the feature.

parameters.name: FOCUS_ON_VISIBLE
parameters.type: For a query parameter, selects it when it becomes visible during editing.

parameters.name: CAN_BE_TOLERANT
parameters.type: For a quantity parameter, specifies that the quantity can be tolerant.

parameters.name: CAN_BE_TOLERANT_DIAMETER
parameters.type: For a quantity parameter that represents a diameter, specifies that the quantity can be tolerant and should display options to specify hole or shaft fit classes.

parameters.name: PLUS_MINUS
parameters.type: Like OPPOSITE_DIRECTION but indicating whether the associated quantity is positive or negative.

parameters.name: ALWAYS_USE_DEPENDENCIES
parameters.type: Always use the content of this parameter to determine feature dependencies.

parameters.name: NO_QUERY_VARIABLE
parameters.type: Hides the query variable dropdown for the associated query parameter.

parameters.name: ALLOW_FLAT_SKETCH_SELECTION
parameters.type: Allows a feature list parameter to select sketches defined on flat views.

VolumeAccuracy.name: VolumeAccuracy
VolumeAccuracy.description: Level of accuracy to use for computing the volume of a solid body. The values are:

WeldFinishing.name: WeldFinishing
WeldFinishing.description: Enum to determine the weld finishing in ANSI standard.

WeldStandard.name: WeldStandard
WeldStandard.description: Enum to switch the weld symbol representation between ANSI and ISO standard.

WrapType.name: WrapType
WrapType.description: Specifies the type of wrap to execute.

parameters.name: SIMPLE
parameters.type: Wrap around the infinite definition of the destination surface.

parameters.name: TRIM
parameters.type: Wrap around a defined destination face, and trim anything that falls off of it.

parameters.name: IMPRINT
parameters.type: Imprint edges onto a defined destination face.
